articleTitle: Real Time Object Tracking Using OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Object tracking has been widely used in the field of computer vision. The OpenCV Library offers a wide range of Target Tracing Algorithms, which have been shown to be robust and effective. But as technology advances, precision and robust can be improved. In this overview, we look at the latest developments and new developments in OpenCV’s object tracking.The focus is to provide an overview of some of the latest methods used to improve object tracking accuracy and robustness. We discuss the strengths and weaknesses of each approach and evaluate their performance based on standard benchmarks datasets. From our analysis, we observe that deep learning-based methods, coupled with motion models, have recently demonstrated impressive results. We also highlight the limitations and challenges faced in real-world scenarios with complex environments, occlusions, and deformable objects. Finally, we discuss interesting future research directions, including exploring hybrid methods that combine several techniques to improve tracking accuracy and robustness. With the advent of IoT, drones, and autonomous vehicles, object tracking has become increasingly relevant in our daily lives, and thus, the pursuit of accurate and robust algorithms is as crucial as ever. In conclusion, this review provides insights into some of the recent advancements and challenges in object tracking in OpenCV. The review offers a valuable resource for researchers and practitioners working in the field and highlights gaps in current research that require further investigation.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Lighting System for Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Faced with the complex and ever-changing social environment, how to minimize the energy consumption of warehouse lighting has become a current issue that cannot be ignored. Currently, most warehouse lighting still uses ordinary fluorescent lamps with a rated voltage of 220 V and a frequency of 50 Hz, which have weak lighting intensity, high power consumption, high failure rate, short service life, and require regular maintenance, resulting in economic waste. So making the warehouse lighting system more information-based and energy-saving and environmentally friendly has become the key to solving the problem. After discovering this issue, I upgraded the existing warehouse lighting system and added the application of a 51 microcontroller to design a warehouse intelligent lighting system that specifically addresses the above issues. It can adjust the brightness of the lights according to the brightness of the warehouse environment, which can achieve significant energy-saving effects. It also achieves the function of turning off the lights when people walk and turning on the lights when people come, greatly reducing the failure rate.

articleTitle: Simulation of Substation Electrical Main System Based on Internet Interactive Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of the power industry, simulating and analyzing the electrical main system of substations has become a necessary means. However, traditional electrical main system simulation methods have many problems that require the search for new technical means to solve. The application of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and the Internet of Things can greatly improve the accuracy and reliability of electrical main system simulation analysis, ensuring the stable operation of the power system. This article studies the simulation of substation electrical main system based on Internet interactive virtual reality technology (VRT). Firstly, this article introduces the basic structure and working principle of the substation electrical main system. Then, this article proposes a simulation solution based on Internet interactive VRT to address the shortcomings of traditional electrical main system simulation. This solution adopts a combination of VRT, network technology, and interaction technology to achieve real-time interaction between users and the simulation system. Finally, this article verifies the effectiveness and feasibility of this scheme through experiments. The experimental results show that the calculation speed of the electrical system is 146m/s, with a maximum value of 176m/s. This scheme can improve the efficiency and accuracy of electrical main system simulation, providing strong support for the design and operation of substation electrical main system.

articleTitle: Development of "Distributed Photovoltaic + Electric Heating" User Intelligent Service Terminal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Connecting power production and consumption, power grid is an important network platform, the central link of energy transformation, and the core hub of carbon reduction in the power system. In accordance with the requirements of the national "carbon peak, carbon neutral", the State grid has formulated an action plan to support the development of distributed power supplies and electric heating, and accelerate the upgrade of the power grid to the energy Internet. This paper aims at the problem of power outage during the maintenance of distributed power supply and electric heating users, and designs a "distributed photovoltaic + electric heating" user intelligent service terminal. The inspection personnel can remotely control the photovoltaic grid-connected switch on the grid side through smart phones, and check the remote control results by using image recognition technology and electrical parameter measurement, so as to check the operation of the user's photovoltaic power generation equipment and electric heating equipment at any time. Users can easily obtain power supply services such as power outage plan, security alarm and policy consultation through the data display and voice interaction module of the terminal. The application of this terminal not only improves the efficiency of the operation of the photovoltaic power supply grid-connected switch, can better serve the "distributed photovoltaic + electric heating" users, but also provides technical support for the construction of a new power system with new energy as the main body of the State grid company.

articleTitle: Study on Vibration Isolation Characteristics of UHVDC Converter Valve Saturable Reactor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The saturable reactor vibration in UHVDC converter valve is inevitable during operation. Long-term vibration results in equipment damage and even safety accidents. Vibration isolation of the saturable reactor is the key to insure operation safety. A forced vibration model for the saturable reactor vibration isolation mechanism is established based on the damped forced vibration theory of the single⁃degree⁃freedom system. The factors and parameters that affect the saturable reactor vibration isolation characteristics are studied and determined. On this basis, a calculation scheme of for selecting the parameters of the silicon rubber vibration isolator of the converter valve saturable reactor is designed and the elastic modulus and damping ratio of the vibration isolation silicon rubber are determined. Results of simulation analyses and experiments show that the vibration amplitudes of the reactor supporting structure and the supporting steel beam of the pipe are reduced significantly by using the selected silicone rubber vibration isolator, which provide a reference for setting and optimizing the design of the converter valve saturable reactor vibration isolation mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on 3D GIS Data Modeling System Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A method of building a 3D model of a house using data in a geographic information system. Abstraction of point, line and area elements. The batch model is modeled by symbol matching method, rule construction method and triangular network construction method. The RANSAC method is used for denoising, and the point cloud is divided for each part of the building surface. This achieved a preliminary reconstruction of the building's surface. Through the closed-loop processing of 3D reconstruction in GIS, the whole process of 3D reconstruction in GIS is completed. The test results show that the combination of GIS information and 3D reconstruction technology can quickly and effectively carry out 3D reconstruction of buildings. Realize the closed-loop enhancement of GIS data and 3D modeling.

articleTitle: Investigation on Power System Dynamic Monitoring System Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The power system is one of the indispensable infrastructure in modern society, and its stable operation is crucial for the normal operation of society. Therefore, how to monitor the operation status of the power system and detect abnormal situations in a timely manner is a challenge that power system managers and engineers have been striving to solve. This article introduced the application of artificial neural networks in power systems and analyzed relevant algorithms. The model mainly consisted of two parts, namely neurons and decision support vector machines. This article studied a progressive method based on the interaction of factors such as different neural structures, power distribution characteristics, and fault state classifiers. A set of nonlinear systems for describing complex problems was established by using hybrid learning method. This article used fuzzy reasoning theory to analyze the comprehensive diagnosis technology of intelligent knowledge architecture and processing capabilities, and designed a system for power system load monitoring. This article also conducted simulation tests on the performance of the system, and the test results showed that the system’s fault finding time remained within 3 to 5 seconds.

articleTitle: A Multi-Channel Wireless Power Transfer Method for Electric Vehicles Based on Magnetic Field Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of electric vehicles, wireless power transfer technology has emerged as a new way to supply electric energy to these vehicles. However, the traditional approach of one charging station matching one electric vehicle is no longer sufficient to meet the demand for energy supply. In this regard, this paper proposes a multi-channel wireless power transfer method for electric vehicles based on magnetic coupling. This method can meet the energy supply requirements of multiple electric devices with a single charging station. This paper also provides a charging flowchart and power allocation method to enable efficient utilization of the charging station's power capacity and meet the demands of electric devices. Finally, a simulation model is presented and verified.

articleTitle: Research on SDN Network Management Architecture in the Field of Electric Power Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the continuous deepening of the construction of power communication networks, especially the proposal and practice of the concept of ubiquitous power Internet of Things, higher requirements are put forward for the stability, availability, flexibility and intelligence level of power communication systems. A functional or performance bottleneck has been encountered. In order to solve the above problems and effectively support the construction of ubiquitous power Internet of Things, it is necessary to introduce SDN technology into the power communication network. Based on the investigation of the current situation, this paper studies the application of SDN in the field of power communication, and provides technical analysis and application suggestions for the cross-vendor network management construction plan faced by SDN equipment from different manufacturers in actual projects, which will help Centralized management of equipment based on SDN technology can improve the utilization of communication network resources, ensure the efficient operation of power system equipment, and promote the intelligent development of power systems.

articleTitle: Seq-CNN: A Lightweight and Efficient Neural Network for Sentimental Analysis of Text
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Today, numerous smart devices have brought convenience to people's work and life, especially chatbots, which can simulate real-world conversations, adding much fun to people's lives. However, there are few intelligent chatbots suitable for children, especially those with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD). In order to develop chatbots suitable for children with autism, aiming to enhance their social and communication skills, this research serves as a foundational study for an intelligent emotion-perception chatbot, conducting preliminary research on text sentiment analysis. This study optimizes an open-source dataset to make it more applicable to text sentiment analysis tasks for children with autism. A new model, Seq-CNN, combines LSTM and Convolutional Neural Networks cleverly and applies attention mechanisms, offering a concise structure and superior performance compared to existing models like CNN, TextCNN, Bi-LSTM, and so on. This provides a possibility to better realize an emotion-automatic-perception chatbot, aiming to improve the language and social abilities of children with ASD through early intervention. Furthermore, due to the lightweight and high efficiency of this model, it can also be applied to general text sentiment analysis tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Analysis Model of Power Big Data Integrating 3D Data Visualization Scene
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: After determining large-scale power data and spatial scenarios, a new analysis model is constructed for 3D visualization scenarios. In this model, big data mining and 3D visualization technology are organically integrated, information fusion and fuzzy tomographic analysis method are adopted to realize efficient mining of power big data, and 3D rendering algorithm based on attribute reduction is used to improve the real-time performance of power 3D scene rendering. The visual feature reconstruction technology is used to realize the visual reconstruction of the 3D scene of power big data in the distribution network. The experiment shows that the data visualization management method can realize the efficient mining of power big data and real-time rendering of 3D model.

articleTitle: High Misalignment Tolerance and Constant Voltage Output WPT System Based on DSFS-DD Pads
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Compared with traditional contact wired power transfer technology, Wireless Power Transfer Technology (WPT) has the advantages of high security, flexibility, and reliability. However, in the process of static wireless power transfer in electric vehicles, the inaccuracy of manual parking can lead to the positional deviation between the transmitter and receiver, resulting in reduced power and efficiency of the system's power transfer, as well as system detuning and other issues. Therefore, it is expected that wireless power transfer systems can have a greater tolerance for position misalignment. Therefore, a new coupling machine with high misalignment tolerance is proposed in this article. The transmitter of this coupling mechanism consists of two double forward series flat solenoid coils(DSFS), and the receiver consists of a set of double D(DD) coils. Compared with traditional square and double D coils, the proposed new coupling mechanism improves misalignment tolerance in the x and y directions. This article first analyzes the characteristics and magnetic field distribution characteristics of the DSFS-DD coupling mechanism. Then, based on the constant voltage wireless power characteristics of electric vehicles, an LCC-S compensation network with constant voltage output characteristics was selected. Based on this, expressions for system output voltage, transfer efficiency, and output power are derived. To achieve stable system output voltage and power in the case of misalignment of the coupling mechanism, the coupling mechanism parameters were designed. Finally, simulation experiments are established to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on Scientific Recovery Training after Sports Injury with Computer Assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, a virtual rehabilitation system for motor injury and control function of hands and upper limbs in patients with nerve injury was designed. The system collects human limb motion parameters through Kinect to drive the corresponding changes in the virtual scene. After collecting the three-dimensional coordinates of the junction nodes, Kinect represents each pair of adjacent junction nodes in the form of vectors, and takes the time series of vector changes instead of the motion trajectory as the evaluation object. The dynamic configuration of the training scene is realized by analyzing the XML file and establishing the personalized virtual scene. Finally, the data during the movement of the prototype is measured. The simulation results are compared with the experimental data to verify the feasibility of the design scheme.

articleTitle: Event-triggered adaptive FTC for linear systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: An event-triggered adaptive fault tolerant controller is devised for linear system of the same category, with consideration of actuator faults. First, We introduce a linear transformation to transform the original system as two desired subsystems. Then, output feedback strategy is provided to ensure the stability of the closed-loop system. To control the cost of the economy and make better use of resources, event-triggered mechanism is adopted. In addition, state tracker and adaptive estimator are utilized to acquire the unknown states and parameter information. Last, a numerical simulation example is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Pest and Disease Detection Based on Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Pest identification plays an increasingly important role in agricultural production, and effective control measures based on the results can reduce the impact of pests and diseases and ensure higher and more stable yields. Advances in machine learning and deep learning, especially in image recognition, provide a better way to identify pests and diseases. EfficientNet-B3 neural network was used to identify and classify healthy crops and diseased plants with 98% accuracy, and data enhancement technology was used to address the insufficient amount of data.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis and Structural Optimization of a Multi-purpose Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In response to the problem of the single application environment of existing inspection robots, a multi-purpose inspection robot is proposed, which is capable of adapting to complex environments and realizing ground-pole state transitions while realizing basic walking functions. The specific structure of the robot is introduced, and the structural characteristics of the posture-adjusting mechanism that realizes the conversion function are analyzed, its kinematic model is established and the Jacobi matrix of the mechanism is derived. The constraints are determined, and the kinematic inverse solution is used to analyze the reachable workspace and corner workspace of the parallel mechanism based on the numerical search method. The inverse of the Jacobi matrix condition number is used to establish the dexterity performance index, and a dexterity analysis is carried out to produce a contour map of the dexterity distribution of the mechanism. After the constraints are satisfied, the structural optimization problem is transformed into a problem of solving for the maximum value of the dexterity, and the objective function is established. The improvement of robot kinematic performance was verified by comparing before and after optimization.

articleTitle: Research on English Customized Distance Assisted Curriculum System Based on Computer "Internet +" Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This manuscript introduces a new English customized distance education teaching method based on computer network technology. This manuscript first discusses the theory of distance teaching in English classroom based on "Internet +" technology. Establish three levels of online education platforms in English courses. This software is developed based on Mutagen Creator. This manuscript proposes a network "Internet +" technology based on digital image processing technology. A virtual teaching platform that can interact with people has been established using the virtual technology of 3DSMAX. The functions of the simulation device were implemented through VRML programming, and the triggering, data transmission, and page conversion of the demonstration program were implemented based on the response function. Thus, the design of a teaching system based on virtual reality has been achieved. Practice has proven that this method has better human-computer interaction effects than traditional English remote multimedia teaching, and has increased students' learning enthusiasm.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation and Optimization of Electric Carbon Model of Power Grid under the Lowest Carbon Emission Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The carbon consumption calculation model of power system is established by considering the carbon consumption of each link in power system. The first thing to consider is the economy and security of the grid and the carbon dioxide emissions from the grid damage. This paper proposes a cooperation model between enterprises based on fuzzy dynamic clustering. The total carbon emission rate index of network loss is introduced and the carbon emission optimization model of power grid based on quantum genetic algorithm is established. In this model, the objective function value is used as the evaluation basis of individual fitness value. This method can improve the optimization results and avoid the problems of premature convergence and local convergence. The simulation of IEEE57 nodes proves the feasibility of the proposed method in power system.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization method of smart medical wireless sensor network coverage based on improved cuckoo algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to improve the coverage level of smart medical wireless sensor network, a multi-objective optimization method of smart medical wireless sensor network coverage based on improved cuckoo algorithm is proposed. Construct the routing node deployment structure model of smart medical wireless sensor network, adopt the channel balanced scheduling method to realize the structured scheduling and spread spectrum processing of the transmission layer of smart medical wireless sensor network, adopt the multi-sensor fusion tracking identification method to realize the identification of the coverage parameters of smart medical wireless sensor network, adopt the improved cuckoo algorithm to establish the dynamic distribution function of wireless sensor network coverage multi-objective optimization, and randomly scatter several sensors in the area to be monitored. And set a certain number of anchor nodes, initialize the position parameters of the population, calculate the fitness value of the initial population and sort it from small to large. Through the joint parameter identification of the initial position set and the target position set of the mobile node, the multi-objective optimization of the coverage of the smart medical wireless sensor network is realized. The simulation test results show that this method can improve the coverage level of nodes and reduce the network energy cost and transmission error rate.

articleTitle: VSC-HVDC decoupling control strategy for enhancing system inertia and damping
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aming at the frequency stability problem caused by the low inertia characteristics of electronic power system, this paper proposes a self-synchronization decoupling control strategy for active support of system inertia in flexible DC power transmission system from the perspective of exploiting the regulation potential of power transmission link. By analyzing the available energy of the inertia support of the flexible DC system, the feasibility of using its energy margin to improve the level of the receiving-end grid's inertia is quantitatively analyzed. By analogy with the rotor motion equation of the synchronous generator, a self-synchronization control strategy of the converter station taking into account the energy margin of each energy storage element in the flexible DC system is proposed, which can actively support the receiving-end grid inertia while realizing self-synchronization without phase-locked loop. On this basis, considering the influence of DC voltage safety constraint on capacitor energy margin utilization, the decoupling control strategy and parameter design method of DC voltage and submodule capacitor voltage of flexible DC system are proposed, through the adaptive adjustment module input quantity and capacitance voltage reference, implement flexible DC system make full use of the energy storage element energy margin, The recovery strategy and start-up criterion are designed to effectively improve the level of inertia and frequency stability of the receiving power grid.

articleTitle: An Improving Framework for Movie Recommendations with a Fusion of Deep Learning and K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper investigates the application of two improved deep learning and K-nearest neighbor algorithms, respectively named as AutoDeepKNN and DeepKNR, in movie recommendation systems. We conduct experiments on two large-scale publicly available movie recommendation datasets, Movie-lens and Netflix. Detailed settings for experimental parameters, including data size, number of users, number of items, and the ratio of training and testing sets, were established. By utilizing various evaluation metrics such as precision, recall, F1-score, NDCG, and coverage, and comparing with baseline methods and traditional statistical models, the experimental results demonstrate significant performance improvements in all metrics from our proposed AutoDeepKNN and DeepKNR. Particularly, the AutoDeepKNN method, during the evaluation of precision and loss value, surpassed other methods significantly for 80% of the time.Our research not only enhances the accuracy of movie recommendations but also provides new methods and insights for other types of recommendation tasks.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Loss in Coupling Mechanism for Electric Vehicle Wireless Charging System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the loss analysis of the electric vehicle wireless charging system, this paper focuses on the loss of the coupling mechanism in the system, and carries out theoretical analysis and calculation from the three aspects of Litz coil loss, magnetic core loss and aluminum plate loss, and uses the COMSOL software to conduct finite element analysis to obtain the magnetic field related parameters of the coupling mechanism, and calculates the loss distribution of the coupling mechanism. Finally, combined with the loss of other links of the wireless charging system, the error between the theoretical calculation of the total loss and the actual loss measured by the electric vehicle 11KW wireless charging device is about 8%, which has a good accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of New Intelligent Sensor Electronic Equipment in Automobile
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: There is great randomness in multi-sensor acquisition of intelligent unmanned vehicles. There are great differences in the characteristics of the collected information. This paper presents an adaptive multi-sensor data fusion algorithm. The learning machine based on support vector machine regression is applied to the intelligent sensor system of single chip microcomputer. With STC12LE5410AD single chip as the core controller and nRF905 wireless transceiver control chip, the data collected by the sensor is transmitted wirelessly. Experiments show that this algorithm can greatly improve the fusion rate of multi-sensor differential information, increase the amount of effective information, and achieve good results.

articleTitle: Temperature Compensation Strategy of Fiber Bragg Grating Sensor Based on Improved Neural Network Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensors are widely used in the field of transmission line ice monitoring, but the cross-sensitivity of temperature and stress seriously affects their measurement accuracy. To address this problem, this paper proposed a temperature compensation strategy based on the improved back propagation (BP) neural network algorithm. A whale optimization algorithm is used to optimize the BP neural network to improve its performance for eliminating the influence of cross-sensitivity of temperature and stress on FBG sensors. To address the issue of a small sample size, a K-fold cross validation method is adopted to improve the reliability of network prediction. The simulation verifies that the proposed strategy could effectively achieve higher accuracy in monitoring the icing thickness of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Research on Small Program of Smartphone APP Client for Remote Network Display of Rural Cultural Tourism Town Brand
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This project will use WeChat development platform to design rural cultural tourism mini program. The project incorporates web crawler technology to capture scattered data and aggregate it into websites and applets. The system provides users with video introduction of scenic spots, real-time weather broadcast, real-time location query, local food introduction and accommodation query and other functions. Through AI algorithm, users can recommend customized travel plans. The system uses JS+CSS to develop tourism mini programs on the Windows side of WeChat development platform. The system users create a professional, humanized and intelligent platform integrating accommodation, transportation, social interaction, live commentary, audio reading, direct purchase of specialty products, research courses, customized Tours and other services. Through the online test, the system function is stable and in line with expectations.

articleTitle: NCGAN: A Calibrated Oversampling Technique for Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: We introduce a new data oversampling technique, the Negative Calibrated Generative Adversarial Network (NCGAN). In fraud detection, high-quality data oversampling is the key to successful classifications. When dealing with ultra imbalanced data in binary classification scenarios, the similarity of synthetic positive data to negative data is an undesirable property. Our method focus on alleviate such undesirable property by calibrating synthetic positive samples with negative samples. We formulate our NCGAN in mathematical notations and conduct experiments to validate that NCGAN is universally effective for linear models, tree models and deep learning models. Compared with traditonal method, our NCGAN will increase the precision and F1 score for machine learning models.

articleTitle: An Ensemble Transformers Approach to Detect Bullying in Campus Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: One of the vices that is becoming increasingly common on school campuses around the world is bullying. Bullying can manifest itself in many forms, such as physical, verbal or social, and can have serious psychological effects on victims. One way to identify potential victims is to analyze their language use, specifically their frequent use of words or phrases associated with anger or sadness. These emotional patterns can serve as indicators of a student’s risk of becoming a bully or victim of bullying. By identifying these patterns early on, schools can prevent potential incidents of bullying. This paper proposes an architecture of ensemble transformers to predict whether a respondent is being bullied or not by transforming text data into basic emotions. Experimental results show that the structure proposed in this paper has certain advantages over existing algorithms in indicators such as F1-score, indicating that it is expected to detect early signs of potential bullying incidents in texts through this method.

articleTitle: Efficient Internal Model Control Based on Smith Predictor for PMLSM Servo System Considering Time Delay via Extended State Observer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The tracking, positioning and anti-interference performance of Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor (PMLSM) servo systems are affected by time delay. In this paper, an Enhanced Internal Model Controller (EIMC) based on Smith Predictor (SP) with a Synchronous Model Extended State Observer (SMESO) is proposed, which is named the EIMC-SP-SMESO method. In this method, a PMLSM dynamic model considering time delay is established, and a SMESO that matches the control input and system output is designed to achieve accurate estimation and real-time compensation of unknown total disturbances. Considering the approximation error introduced by the time delay expansion in existing frameworks, this paper compensated the time delay of the feedback signal by an SP and derived an EIMC to achieve high-precision control. The experimental results confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed method in improving the accuracy of motion tracking, positioning, and disturbance suppression.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Intelligent ChatGPT in Computer Intelligent Computing System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: An intelligent ChatGPT based Transformer neural network architecture is proposed. It not only has the function of understanding the text, but also has the function of creating the text. The system correlates large data sets. The algorithm in this paper can strengthen the mining of semantic information at sentence level, improve the understanding of specific text information and the learning of text information. It effectively reduces the overall computational complexity of the model. This method can improve the universality of the model under the actual distribution. The convergence rate in the parameter space can be accelerated. Use Rotowire's public data to verify method validity. Experimental results show that the proposed method performs better than the existing data-to-text generation model. The algorithm can be used to automatically convert structured data into continuous text automatically generated.

articleTitle: Research on Planning of Connecting Large-Scale Electric Vehicle Charging Facilities to Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper considers all vehicles in a power distribution system as a "cluster". On the premise of ensuring the safety of distribution system, a new mathematical modeling method of charging strategy is established. Considering the factors such as node voltage, line power flow, distribution capacity and centralized charging power supply balance, the charging power supply of "agglomeration" in low-speed charging is optimized with the aim of minimizing the active power network loss. The voltage fluctuation of the system can be reduced by improving the power supply capacity of the distribution network, using static reactive power compensation device and active filtering. Finally, a mobile Internet oriented EV charging station operation and management system is realized. Based on IEEE33 node system simulation, the effects of different charging station layout on node voltage and network loss are studied. The convergence performance and optimization performance of the proposed method are proved by an example analysis.

articleTitle: Research application of BP neural network algorithm based on genetic algorithm optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, based on the ACS dataset, the original data were firstly preprocessed by excluding abnormal data, classification and interpolation operations to obtain complete, effective, intuitive and concise data. Secondly, the correlation relationship model of hybrid genetic BP neural network was proposed, and the training accuracy reached 0.99994. Then, the unit step method was used to discretize each independent variable in the chemical reaction, and the network relationship after training using BP neural network was obtained by the control variable method, and the data of the dependent variable changed with them were derived separately, and the trend analysis of the dependent variable when the independent variable changed was obtained by the different independent variables on the dependent variable. The prediction error percentage of the nine sample data in the test set was 0.06% at maximum, and the error analysis results were good.

articleTitle: Fault Location Method of Power Cable Based on Distributed Fiber Optic Vibration Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a fault location method for power cables based on distributed fiber optic vibration sensing technology to monitor the damage caused by power cable discharge to the surrounding fiber-optic cables. When the power cable discharge to the ground does not cause damage to the surrounding fiber optic cable, the proposed technology can accurately locate the longitudinal distance between the vibration source and the fiber optic cable, based on distributed fiber optic vibration sensing and positioning technology. When the power cable discharge causes the breakage of the fiber optic cable in the same trench, the proposed technology could achieve the precise fault location of the power cable, based on the lead ball free fall control system. The advantages and disadvantages of the proposed technique and its application scenarios are analyzed through field tests to provide a reference for future cable fault location research.

Author Keywords: The lead ball free fall control system

articleTitle: Intelligent Bidding Method Based on Data OLAP Analysis and Matching Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the tenderer lacks the analysis of the cost estimation data, this topic intends to adopt online analysis and processing (OLAP) method. A new cost estimation method is studied. The model is based on the statistics of similar project cost data. An optimized data analysis model is adopted. This method can estimate the project cost more accurately. This method is applied to project bidding and the data processing of the system is carried out. A concrete example is used to evaluate the accuracy of the method. The result shows that the prediction accuracy is high and meets the need of project bidding.

articleTitle: Power System Stability Assessment System Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article studies a power system stability evaluation system based on big data analysis, which includes a data acquisition module, transmission module, big data analysis module, feedback module, evaluation module, and human-machine interaction module. The output end of the data acquisition module is connected to the input end of the transmission module through communication, while the output end of the transmission module is connected to the input end of the big data analysis module through communication, The output end of the big data analysis module is connected to the input end of the evaluation module, the output end of the evaluation module is connected to the input end of the human-machine interaction module, the output end of the evaluation module is also connected to the input end of the feedback module, and the output end of the feedback module is connected to the input end of the big data analysis module. This article can effectively evaluate the power system and facilitate staff to analyze the working conditions and maintenance of various power equipment.

articleTitle: A Method for Automatic Registration of Realistic 3D Models without Control Points
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to realize the periodic surface monitoring and early warning of the multi-terrain realistic 3D model of the landslide, it is for the unmanned aerial vehicle to use multiphase optical images to measure the ground control points during each phase of image acquisition, and proposes an automatic registration algorithm for the terrain-real 3D model, to automatically establish a realistic 3D model of multiple time series with a unified spatial reference. The experimental results show that the average spatial difference of the realistic 3D model after registration is as low as 0.01m. This method is suitable for periodic dynamic surface monitoring and change detection scenarios of landslides and natural high and steep slopes, and has technical advantages such as high precision, low safety risk, low cost, and non-contact surface monitoring.

articleTitle: Bubble Sort and Its Improved Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Bubble sorting is a simple sorting algorithm, and it is also a stable sorting algorithm. The principle is to repeatedly scan the elements to be sorted and compare each pair of adjacent elements, swapping when the pair of elements is not in the correct order. This process is repeated until no two adjacent elements can be exchanged, indicating that the sorting is complete. This paper describes the basic bubble sort and three improvement methods of bubble sort[1].

articleTitle: Evaluation on Power Equipment Operation Status Monitoring System Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: There are a lot of data information in the monitoring and control system of power equipment. Because of its large size, the traditional monitoring system is not able to monitor the running state of power equipment effectively. For the purpose of improving the monitoring efficiency of power equipment running, this paper puts forward a monitoring and control system based on data mining technique. Through the establishment of the operating state data model, people can realize the comprehensive monitoring of the operation state of the power equipment, and raise the efficiency from 75.34% to 89.8%. Therefore, the data mining technique can increase the monitoring efficiency of the monitoring system.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Power Grid Big Data Information Management System Based on Computer Cloud Security Database Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper designs a new integrated software management system based on cloud computing architecture based on computer cloud security database technology. Firstly, this paper gives the overall structure of the design system and introduces the implementation process of cloud computing architecture. The power parameter analysis module is designed by combining cloud computing architecture, GSM/GPRS communication technology and embedded components. The main structure includes power parameter analysis module, office software management module, transmission capacity calculation module, service management module, electricity charge collection management module, asset management module and so on. All module communication interfaces are connected to the cloud computing architecture to transmit information to the management center to ensure the safe and efficient operation of the system. The experimental results show that the designed system has strong overall performance.

articleTitle: A Zero Trust-based Approach for Secure Terminal Access in Distributed Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The evolving landscape of energy grids towards decentralization and automation, driven by renewable energy integration and emerging technologies like smart grids and 5G, presents new security challenges. Current security strategies for distributed energy grids rely on a "once authenticated, always trusted" approach, which becomes increasingly inadequate as the grid expands. To address these challenges, this paper explores a Zero Trust-based security access method for grid terminals. It focuses on three key aspects: security module, lightweight one-time digital signature authentication, and real-time security detection using data stream classification. This approach aligns with the Zero Trust principle of "distrust and verify everything," providing continuous verification, real-time monitoring and analysis. The proposed method enhances security for distributed energy grids in the face of growing complexity.

articleTitle: Attitude control of a four-rotor drone based on event triggering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of unknown external interference and limited internal communication in the flight of four-rotor UAV, an attitude control algorithm based on event triggering is proposed. Firstly, a nonlinear interference observer is designed to deal with unknown external interference. Then the controller is designed based on the output of the interference observer and the sliding mode control algorithm. The controller is updated to the actuator only when the event is triggered. Lyapunov function is used to prove the stability of the system, and the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Design of Logistics Distribution Scheduling System Based on Computer Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper introduces the logistics distribution management system based on digital twin. The system structure and functional framework of logistics distribution management system are determined. The construction content and realization method of digital twin in logistics distribution management system are given. A twin-based package strategy and interactive adjustment algorithm are proposed. A new design scheme of the box with dynamic interaction is studied. According to the characteristics of limited storage capacity and calculation capacity of embedded devices, the idea of dynamically dividing the map area and the storage structure of vector grid are discussed, and the optimized Dijkstra algorithm and logistics distribution data management function are discussed. It is proved that the system can improve the packing effect and optimize the distribution process reasonably.

articleTitle: Optimizing Portfolios with Modified NSGA-II Solutions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In financial management, portfolio optimization remains a central challenge. From Markowitz’s Mean-Variance Optimization to modern deep learning methods, capturing the multi-faceted nature of portfolio decisions is complex. This paper emphasizes the potential of Multi-objective Evolutionary Algorithms (MOEAs), specifically the NSGA-II. We propose key modifications to NSGA-II, including refined selection strategies, dynamic mutation parameters and optimization for initialization. Initial results showcase enhanced performance and a more comprehensive Pareto front. Additionally, we employ the Monte Carlo Markov Chain (MCMC) for a ten-year portfolio projection. Future avenues include comparisons with other algorithms and expanding our refined NSGA-II’s application to diverse optimization tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Workpiece Sorting System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper expounds the automatic recognition method of parts based on computer vision. The feature database of the processed parts is constructed by using machine learning method. Image preprocessing, threshold segmentation, edge and contour extraction are used to analyze the features of the image of the inspected part to judge whether the inspected part is qualified or not. Aiming at the attitude error generated when the workpiece is placed, a method for positioning the center of gravity and rotation angle of the workpiece based on boundary detection and contour tracking is proposed. Use the similarity measure to determine the characteristics of the object to be processed. Simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: Research on intrusion data monitoring of outsourcing cloud server in large and complex laboratories of colleges and universities
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to improve the ability of monitoring the intrusion data of outsourcing cloud server in large and complex laboratories in colleges and universities, a weighted adaptive algorithm for monitoring the intrusion data of outsourcing cloud server in large and complex laboratories in colleges and universities is proposed. A continuous range detection data distribution set of cloud server objects outsourced by large and complex laboratories in colleges and universities in a distributed environment is constructed, the invasion data characteristics of the cloud server outsourced by large and complex laboratories in colleges and universities are reorganized through the continuous change of the position characteristic distribution of the invasion characteristic points, the joint association rule characteristic quantity of the invasion data of the cloud server outsourced by large and complex laboratories in colleges and universities is extracted, and the support vector machine is dynamically allocated and searched in the data monitoring process through the object range detection results. This paper analyzes the clustering attribute of the intrusion characteristics of the outsourcing cloud server in the intrusion terminal collector, adopts the method based on fusion parameter decomposition and multivariate combination parameter clustering to realize the multi-segment feature reconstruction and segmented monitoring of the clustering sequence of the outsourcing cloud server in a large and complex laboratory in colleges and universities, and realizes the optimization control in the process of intrusion data monitoring under the weighted adaptive learning model to avoid the clustering center falling into the local optimal solution. The simulation results show that this method has high precision in monitoring the intrusion data of outsourcing cloud server in large and complex laboratories in colleges and universities, and the throughput performance of data monitoring and retrieval is good, so it can be competent for data monitoring and detection of outsourcing cloud server in complex laboratories.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Intelligent Home System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper constructs an intelligent home monitoring system based on NI wireless sensor network. The system consists of multiple sensors to collect temperature and humidity, smoke, theft and other environmental data. The NI wireless sensor network node sends the data to the upper PC in the way of wireless network. LabVIEW software is used to judge and control the data on PC. The system has obtained a good man-machine interface. Among them, the software design process of the system is introduced in detail. The intelligent home monitoring system has the characteristics of NI wireless sensor network -- low power consumption, good real-time performance, easy to expand, remote monitoring and so on.

articleTitle: GGDP Global Climate Change Prediction Model Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: GDP is often used to measure the economic status of a country. However, the GDP model, which only focuses on economic gains, ignores the price that Mother Earth silently endures behind the shiny economic data. In order to protect the environment and resources as generous gift to our future generations, deserved people, green GDP (GGDP) model is developed.we first define the replacement of GGDP model to represent the change of a country from the maximum GDP as the development strategy to the maximum GGDP.Then, we normalize the commonly used GGDP and GDP accounting methods by the Cobb-Douglas aggregate model to find the relationship between GGDP, environmental damage factors.We also eliminate the GDP-related terms in the original GGDP model to ensure the independence of the GGDP model, and test the model reliability and reconcile it. In order to solve the climate global change, we grouped 233 countries and regions around the world according to their ability to influence the environment, and derived the corresponding parameters, environmental damage factors of the maximum GGDP model established respectively. The relationship between the damage factors and the main components of the climate parameters is then established by neural network model,and the impact of the maximum GGDP model on the global climate is obtained: the rising trend of the temperature component is effectively curbed, and the water cycle component will be flattened in general.

articleTitle: Application of Data Center Technology in Power Data Resource Sharing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of power industry and Digital transformation, power enterprises have a large number of data resources, including power grid operation data, market transaction data, power equipment operation and maintenance data, etc. How to integrate and share these data resources, improve data utilization efficiency and business decision-making ability, has become an important issue faced by power enterprises. As an advanced data management and service platform, data center technology can effectively solve problems in power data sharing and bring enormous application value. This article conducts research and analysis on the application of data center technology in power data resource sharing, explores the key characteristics of data center technology, the requirements for power data sharing, and the application of data mining technology in power data sharing. Through experimental design and result analysis, the advantages and effects of data center technology in power data resource sharing are verified.

articleTitle: Research on MBTI Testing System Based on the Combination of Flask Framework and ORM Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing personality test system can only give the conclusion of personality type and lacks the consideration of matching personality type with career choice, this paper develops a new MBTI career personality test system. The system uses Flask framework to build the system page, Jinja2 template engine to achieve separation of page display and data transmission, ORM technology to achieve the interaction between the test question bank and the user interface, and finally, Python recommendation algorithm combined with MBTI theory to analyze the tester's career personality. The results of the personality test and the career recommendation are given to provide practical suggestions for the testers. The system test results show that the system can accurately and effectively recommend matching occupations for the tester's personality type, with good matching and high accuracy, achieving the expected purpose.

articleTitle: Research on Wordle Development Based on Multiple Artificial Intelligence Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to conduct a study of Wordle's development, firstly, forecasts were made using an ARIMA time series analysis model, and the data were further processed using a weighted moving average method so that the forecast values would more accurately reflect future short-term trends. A multiple linear regression model was then chosen and the frequencies of each letter and common letter combination were calculated for the entire dataset. Further, a word cloud was plotted in this paper. By training different models, the linear regression model was found to have the smallest error value and a strong correlation coefficient between letters, letter combinations and number of answers was obtained. Using the strong correlation factors as sample features for multiple linear regression, the trained models were used to accurately predict the word 'eerie'.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Real-Time Detection System for Car Surface Damage Based on YOLOv7 and Edge Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper presents a research and design of a real-time detection system for car surface damage based on YOLOv7 and edge devices. The system utilizes the high-performance computing capability and low power consumption of embedded GPUs to achieve detection and classification of vehicle surface damage on edge devices. This improves the efficiency and accuracy of damage assessment, meeting the requirements of digital transformation. The paper includes the following aspects: Firstly, the network architecture and loss function of YOLOv7 model are introduced, analyzing its advantages and applicability in vehicle surface damage detection. Secondly, the characteristics and selection of embedded GPU devices, as well as common types of vehicle surface damage, are discussed. Finally, the paper designs an edge device architecture based on embedded GPUs, including hardware and software aspects, and describes the steps of image preprocessing, feature extraction, object detection, damage classification, and result output.

articleTitle: Research on optical amplification technology in steel ball surface defect detection based on EDFA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: When using fiber optic sensing technology to detect surface defects on steel balls, the conventional method of combining photodetectors with hardware amplification circuits to process detection optical signals requires a heavy workload, and its circuit system is cumbersome and complex. Doped fiber amplifiers have significant advantages for optical amplification. This article utilizes the Erbium-doped Fiber Amplifier (EDFA) to amplify the intensity of the 1550nm detection optical signal in steel ball surface defect detection. The influence of the pumping modes and its own structural parameters on the system gain and noise of EDFA is studied. It is found that there are significant differences in the gain and noise of EDFA under different pumping modes. The structural parameters such as erbium-doped fiber length and pump power have a great impact on the system gain. The simulation of amplifying the low power optical signal of EDFA system is conducted, The designed system achieves an average gain of 36.51dB for input optical signals with powers ranging from -45 to -30dBm, resulting in high gain and low noise. Through further experimental verification, the results indicate that the designed EDFA system has significant optical amplification effect and high gain. Applying EDFA to the steel ball surface defect detection system has optimized the displacement detection performance of the detection system.

articleTitle: Analysis of HEM Parameter Identification Results Based on Experimental Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The oil-paper insulation hybrid equivalent circuit model (Hybrid Equivalent Model, HEM) can effectively reflect the interior polarization of oil-paper insulation system, The parameters of the mixed equivalent model were identified by the remaining three groups of FDS test data with moisture content of 0.244%, 2.7% and 3.63%. For the test object of the same oil-paper insulation structure, the geometric capacitance C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf> is basically unchanged, the insulation resistance R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf> and polarization resistance will decrease with the slow increase of micro-water content of insulating paper, while the polarized capacitance will increase with the slow increase of micro-water content. At the same time, based on the above analysis, the characteristic parameters of HEM that are sensitive to the micro-water content of oil-impregnated insulating paper can be proposed: insulating resistance R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf>, maximum polarization resistance and minimum polarization capacitance of RC series polarization branch, maximum polarization resistance of interior polarization branch is shown in Fig. 1.

articleTitle: Analysis of a 220kV transmission line wind bias trip fault and windproof bias modification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: 220kV transmission line wind bias tripping fault is a common fault type in transmission lines, which has a great impact on the stability and safety of the system, especially in some harsh environmental conditions where 220kV transmission line wind bias faults occur at a higher rate. In this paper, we analyze a wind bias fault caused by sudden windy weather in the transmission line of Tieling Power Supply Company of State Grid Liaoning Province, find out the causes of the fault and propose wind bias prevention and transformation measures to effectively reduce the impact of wind bias fault on the stability of transmission line and improve the safety and stability of the line.

articleTitle: Spiking-Mix: A Modified Regularization Method Designed for Spiking Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The advent of data augmentation attracts a lot of attention on how to handle unstructured data. Data augmentation makes it easier to mine the essential data to extract more useful information. And it benefits the neural network's capacity for generalization. Numerous studies contradict our perspective on data augmentation and a part of them are mature enough. However, relative studies on spiking neural networks still have the potential to grow and develop due to the properties of SNN. To achieve deeper neural networks and modify the data augmentation, the primary challenge is how to adjust data variances within a normal range. CutMix is a member of data augmentation. It adopts the idea of regional dropout and patches cropped images on original images. Owing to the rules of neurons, SNN has a single activation value. So lost information is an important issue that we must address. This shows that regional dropout with rules of neurons may sharpen the problem of lost information. So we propose a method to improve the performance of SNN through CutMix. The accuracy of SNN on CIFAR-10 is 1.39% and 0.95% higher than vanilla ANNs(with ZCA pre-processing) and ANNs(with moderate data augmentation and mean/std normalization). And the accuracy of SNN on Fashion-MNIST is 0.9% higher than ANN. The work of the paper is of great significance to developing deeper SNN.

articleTitle: Forecasting model of total import and export based on ARIMA algorithm optimized by BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Total import and export is an important economic indicator of a country, but because it is affected by many factors, the fluctuation pattern is often difficult to explore. If we can make a more accurate forecast of total import and export, it will be a guide for the policy adjustment of the country and enterprises. The problem of total import and export forecasting is a time series forecasting problem. The previous time series forecasting methods do not take into account the non-linear characteristics and other factors, so the forecasting accuracy of this problem is not high enough. In order to improve prediction accuracy, this paper designs an ARIMA algorithm optimized by BP neural network. After the initial prediction by the ARIMA algorithm, the BP neural network is trained by the extracted features, and the ARIMA prediction is corrected by the trained BP neural network on the test set. After the design of the algorithm, real cases were predicted. The results show that the algorithm designed in this paper performs significantly better than the remaining two algorithms in all three error metrics. Compared to the ARIMA algorithm, MSE, MAE, and MAPE improved by 9.4558 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>, 5.7376× 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> and 0.1051, respectively. Compared to the BP neural network, MSE, MAE, and MAPE improved by 4.1276 ×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>, 1.3469 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> and 0.0361, respectively.

articleTitle: Churn Prediction in Business Using Logistic Regression and Logit Boost
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Customer retention is essential in any industry. However, in the business sector, retaining existing customers has become even more critical due to intensified market competition. To proactively determine the likelihood of customer churn and retain customers, companies need to analyze customer behavior and purchasing patterns. In this study, this paper used the publicly available Churn data dataset from Kaggle and employed two machine learning techniques, namely logistic regression and logit boost, to predict the likelihood of customer churn. The experiments were conducted using the scikit-learn library in a Python environment, and the results were presented using different evaluation metrics such as accuracy, recall, and F1 score. These techniques can help companies identify high value customers who are likely to churn and develop targeted marketing strategies to retain them.

articleTitle: Simulation Test Method Research of Distributed Heterogeneous System Based on Scene
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the limitations of conventional distributed heterogeneous system testing, a simulation test method research of distributed heterogeneous system based on scene is proposed to improve the sufficiency of software testing and meet users using standards. On the basis of studying the characteristics of distributed heterogeneous systems, combined with simulation testing methods and software running scene analysis, this method divides the simulation testing platform into three levels by hierarchical division. Combined with atomic scene and composite scene design, this method not only makes the testing more sufficient and meets users' needs, but also improves the maintainability and portability of the simulation testing platform, and simplifies the test scene design.

articleTitle: Intelligent Curtain System Based on MCGS and PLC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Nowadays, more and more intelligent electrical appliances will replace the ' old electrical appliances ' in our life. Many intelligent electrical appliances have been realized and entered our daily life. This article is mainly aimed at the design and description of intelligent curtains in intelligent electrical appliances. The market of intelligent curtains is also very broad, and both the application prospect and the market prospect have great potential value. The intelligent curtain designed in this paper realizes automatic or manual switch control of the curtain to control the adjustment of indoor brightness. The curtains are provided with multiple layers to adjust the brightness, softness and darkness of the indoor light.

articleTitle: Credit score card threshold optimization strategy based on simulated annealing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: When banks use credit score cards, they need to find the best combination among multiple credit score cards and thresholds to maximize the final revenue. In this study, we propose a credit score card threshold optimization method based on simulated annealing algorithm to address this problem. First, we transform the problem into QUBO (Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization) form and introduce Lagrange multipliers to handle the constraints. Then, a simulated annealing algorithm is used to find the optimal credit scorecard and threshold combination. In addition, we reduce the computational time complexity by an approximation algorithm. This study provides an efficient credit scorecard threshold optimization method for banks, which helps to increase their final revenue and reduce bad debt losses.

articleTitle: Research on English Data Intelligent Retrieval Terminal System Based on Computer 3D Image Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper introduces an embedded software for English information query based on ARM single chip microcomputer LPC2290 and Mini GUI. Integrate the Mini GUI with network communication. Remote access to MySQL using C/S architecture. The hardware and software architecture of English data intelligent retrieval terminal system is presented. The graphical interface of the system and the data extraction of the system are completed based on Mini GUI. Several main implementation links of the system are also explained. This paper presents an intelligent query terminal based on English data, which improves the user interface very well. It can not only realize the intelligent search of English data, but also solve the expensive problem of the traditional intelligent search terminal of English data.

articleTitle: Application of Gray Support Vector Machine Combination Model in Energy Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Energy is very important for the world, so we use the grey support vector machine combination model to predict energy has great research significance. In order to improve the accuracy and scope of the application of grey prediction, we combine the grey prediction model with the support vector machine, and use the support vector machine to calculate the values of parameters a and b of the grey prediction model, the final result of parameter a and b is 0.43528 and 6.9644, so that the grey prediction model has the intelligent effect, which is suitable for large-scale data and reduces prediction error, the range of our prediction results is between [207.4237, 255.2898], and the range of relative error we predict is just between [0.001715, 0.009801].

articleTitle: Power Analysis and Maximum Output Power Design of Wave Power Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Among the renewable environmental energy sources, wave energy is a special form of ocean energy. Wave energy devices do work through the kinetic and potential energy of wave energy and convert the work into the electrical energy we need. Improving the conversion efficiency of wave energy devices to wave energy is the key to the effective use of wave energy. In this paper, the relationship between the dynamic model of floats and oscillators in motion and the optimal damping coefficient of linear dampers and the maximum average output power of PTO system is obtained by studying different forms of floats and oscillators in motion.

articleTitle: Research on Game Analysis and Prediction Based on ARIMA Time Series Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the improvement of people’s living quality and technology level, video games have become the product and trend which formed by the gradual evolution of people’s entertainment forms. The New York Time currently offers a popular puzzle called Wordle everyday, where each player gets 6 chances to guess a 5-letter word<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. A scatter plot has been drawn about the number of reported results varies over time according to the data file, fitting the curve. Therefore this passage finds that the number of reported results had risen sharply over time first in a short time, then it declines slowly over time. Its influence has been declined. Then the ARIMA time series model<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup> is used to predict the interval for the number of reported results on March 1, 2023, that is, [10409, 10446]. At the same time, the word attribute is defined, which includes the frequency of word in books, the repetition of letters in a word and the part of speech. For the frequency of word, the data from Goole Books Ngram Viewer<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[3]</sup> has been found, standardized method is considering the number of occurrences per million words as frequency of word. The passage establishes the Pearson model<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[4]</sup> to analyse the correlation between attributes of words and the percentage of scores reported that were played in Hard Mode. The three attributes of the word do affect the percentage of scores reported that were played in Hard Mode and the the frequency of word has the greatest influence. Then, The TOPSIS model<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[5]</sup> was used to classify the words according to their difficulty, which is divided three types:hard, moderate difficulty, easy. Categorize each word by giving it an overall score. The wore"EERIE"belongs to the hard, which conform the result studied before. Hence the accuracy of the model is high. The above can help game developers or decision makers make more accurate decisions, thus increasing the popularity of the game.

articleTitle: Distributed Computing and Data Processing Technology under the Power Data Middleware Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the establishment and development of integrated monitoring platforms and communication information platforms for intelligent substations, the data volume of the power system is showing explosive growth. However, existing data centers have poor processing capabilities for massive amounts of data, making it difficult to meet the multiple service quality requirements of users. How to effectively manage massive and complex data, fully utilize the value of data, improve service quality, reduce operational costs, and achieve rapid response to users is an urgent problem to be solved.
