Therefore, based on the actual needs of power enterprises, this article proposed a cloud computing power data middleware architecture based on distributed technology, which effectively managed, cleaned, converted, and evaluated power data sources through cloud computing platforms. This article mainly analyzed the shortcomings of traditional power data processing platforms and the feasibility of cloud computing based power data platforms. Finally, through load balancing bias comparison and pressure testing experiments under different task numbers, it was proven that cloud computing systems outperformed traditional power data processing systems in terms of utility value, completion time, and load balancing. Moreover, in the pressure testing experiment, under the condition of 10 concurrent users and 673 system request transactions, 91.3% of the interface response time in the cloud computing system was within 50ms. Therefore, cloud computing systems have certain advantages in processing power data.

articleTitle: Research on hypertension prediction model based on XGBoost algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Hypertension is a common chronic disease, and accurate prediction of hypertension occurrence is crucial for early diagnosis and disease prevention. To overcome the subjectivity and uncertainty of traditional clinical experience-based predictions, as well as the limitations of linear models in terms of predictive generalization, this paper conducts modeling and prediction of hypertension using the XGBoost algorithm on a dataset of hypertensive patients from Hospital L. Cross-validation is performed to optimize the model's hyperparameters. The results show that the XGBoost algorithm exhibits better predictive performance in predicting the incidence of hypertension in patients compared to traditional methods. The average error rate of the predicted results is 12.7%. The research findings have certain reference value for early diagnosis and prevention of hypertension.

articleTitle: Research on Navigation Algorithm of Mobile Robot Based on Laser SLAM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Localization technology is a critical issue in robot technology, encompassing navigation control and path planning. The traditional approach to localization involves the utilization of the Global Positioning System (GPS), which presents significant challenges in achieving precise positioning and navigation. Therefore, non-GPS-based localization and navigation methods have become a hot research topic in robotics. This paper proposes a point cloud information frame matching method based on laser radar data collection. It incorporates an improved algorithm for pose estimation of laser point cloud data and combines it with nonlinear optimization techniques for calibration and optimization, thereby achieving accurate localization of a mobile robot in unknown environments. A simulation experiment platform was constructed using the ROS robot operating system to design the program and verify the improved algorithm. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved frame-matching algorithm exhibits better robustness and localization accuracy in terms of mapping and positioning effects. At the same that can satisfy the engineering requirements and based on the raster map to complete the autonomous navigation of the mobile robot.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional point cloud segmentation and inverse parametric modeling method based on comprehensive features
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of 3D point cloud data segmentation and inverse parametric modeling, this paper proposes a segmentation algorithm and inverse parametric modeling technology using the spatial, geometric and statistical features of the point cloud. The algorithm divides the point cloud data by measuring distance, calculating curvature and estimating normal vector, and designs corresponding anti-parametric modeling techniques for different subsets. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm and technique can achieve good results on multiple data sets and have good generalization ability. Through this research, it is expected to promote the development of 3D point cloud processing technology, and provide more accurate and efficient solutions for computer vision, automatic driving, reverse engineering and other fields. Future research directions include optimization of algorithm performance, improvement of generalization ability, and extension to support more geometric models.

articleTitle: Research on E-Commerce Digital Information System Based on Computer Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper adopts the method of combining JSP and JavaBean to realize the script of the system. A user terminal was developed by using the Android software development platform, and the online purchase function of the mobile phone user terminal was completed by matching with the database of the user terminal. Combining semantic similarity with commodity classification theory, a commodity semantic association model based on commodity classification is constructed. Combining it with existing item-based collaborative filtering algorithms. According to the records of items purchased by users and the sequence of items, dynamic user preferences can be obtained. Items are then mapped to the same low-dimensional vector space. Experimental results show that compared with the best standard model, the algorithm proposed in this paper can improve the effect by 95.66 times. The results show that compared with the common online trading system, this system has stronger mobility and stronger cross-platform.

articleTitle: Production Security Evaluation Strategy of Power Data Center Based on Data Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper studies the task scheduling strategy of cloud data center based on data warehouse. Combined with the characteristics of power data center, a multi-qos evaluation model for power data center is defined. In this paper, a neural network algorithm is used for task scheduling with QoS overall effect value as the target. Then this paper establishes the overall technical architecture and hardware and software system of the big data center of the electric power company, and studies the key technologies such as data access and preprocessing, data integration and storage, data computing and processing, data mining and analysis, data security and management. Finally, taking the transformer equipment status evaluation experiment center as an example, the tasks of fault diagnosis, status evaluation, overhaul and maintenance are simulated and scheduled, and the Cloud Sim platform is used for simulation test. The results show that this algorithm can meet the multi-qos requirements of power users to the maximum extent and effectively improve the efficiency of power data center operation.

articleTitle: Propensity Index Drives Information Spreading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a propensity index based on the propensity of individuals to disseminate public opinion information, and investigates the influence of the propensity index on the process of information dissemination and the density of infection in the network. The results show that the propensity index affects the process of information dissemination and the change of infection density, the higher the propensity index of an individual, the faster the information dissemination in the network, and the information dissemination method with a dynamic propensity index is more in line with the information dissemination law in reality.

articleTitle: Research on High Resolution Deformation Monitoring System Based on Computer Time Series
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper presents an automatic deformation monitoring system for time sequence monitoring of the rail transit engineering construction process. The double difference is obtained by combining the exact prior bit relative to the reference point. The displacement vector can be obtained by using the variation of the double difference between the reference point and the observed data. This project intends to obtain the ground object information with high consistency and accuracy through the combined detection method of multi-feature information and realize the inversion of elevation changes through the DInSAR time-series DInSAR data during the collection period of DINSAR images. Through the analysis of the measured data, the correctness of the algorithm's theoretical basis and mathematical model is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Ammonia Detection System Based on NB-IOT Networking Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to meet the demand of real-time monitoring of pollutants in the air, an intelligent ammonia detection system based on narrowband Internet of Things (NB⁃IoT) communication technology is designed. The system consists of multiple monitoring nodes, remote monitoring platform and Android mobile terminal. STM32 is used as microcontroller for monitoring node. Collect air quality related parameters at the location. It is sent to the remote monitoring platform through the NB-IoT communication module to realize intelligent monitoring and management of ammonia gas in a large area. Time division multiplexing differential modulation (TDM) technique is proposed to eliminate the background noise caused by the fluctuation of laser light source in a single optical path detection system. The stability of ammonia samples with a concentration of 500g/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> was observed for 10h, and the fluctuation of the detected data was less than ±5.72%. The good stability of the system is characterized.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Gateway Based on State Grid Main Control Chip
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The smart lighting gateway, developed based on State Grid Corporation China’s SCM801[1] and SCM325[2] main control chips, enables the autonomy of core devices in city-wide wide area wireless networks, reducing deployment costs and increasing access quantity. With the support of smart cities and the background of dual-carbon energy conservation, rapid promotion and application of SmartChip company’s main control chips and communication chips in the field of smart cities can be achieved. The core processor chip adopts SCM801[1], a self-developed 4-core 32BIT ARM® Cortex® A7 architecture multi-core high-performance processor by SmartChip company, with a high frequency of up to 1GHz, supporting various peripheral interfaces and hub operating systems. The wireless communication module’s transmit and receive modules are designed and implemented based on SmartChip’s self-developed SCM325[2], meeting the requirements of long communication distance, low power consumption, and secure data transmission.

articleTitle: Research on distribution network fault zone location method based on improved matrix algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, the scale of distribution networks has gradually expanded, and how to accurately determine distribution network faults from complex distribution networks is an important research direction in this field. The purpose of distribution network fault location is to discover faults and find the specific location of faults by suitable data analysis techniques. In this study, an improved matrix algorithm considering the causal relationship between "feeder segment state" and "switch node alarm" is proposed for interphase short circuit fault. The algorithm is able to locate faults quickly and accurately in both open-loop and closed-loop states of power distribution.The example of "a complex distribution network with single power supply and multiple T connections" shows that the improved matrix algorithm has good adaptability, accuracy, effectiveness and real-time.

articleTitle: Common causes of long time to deal with 10kV capacitor defects and corrective measures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As a static reactive power compensation equipment, power capacitors are one of the important equipment in substations, its main function is to provide reactive power for the power system and improve the power factor. Its safety and reliability are of great significance to the safe and economical operation of the power grid. This paper is based on the time-consuming problem of Benxi Company to deal with 10kV capacitor bank defects, combined with years of maintenance experience, analyzes from many aspects, and puts forward Relevant countermeasures to shorten the processing time of capacitor bank defects and improve the safety and reliability of power supply.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Cavity Filter Design Based on SR-BP Neural Network Surrogate Model Optimized by Slime Mould Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming to solve the issues of large time cost, low efficiency, and high computational complexity in the design of cavity filters using traditional approaches, a multi-objective design approach for cavity filters based on the Slime Mould Algorithm (SMA) optimized Sparse Regularized BP neural network (SR-BP) surrogate model is proposed. This method first utilizes BP neural network to construct a surrogate model for cavity filter. Subsequently, a regularization term is added to its cost function, enabling further sparsity in the standard fully connected neural network. This achieves the reduction of model computational complexity and mitigates the risk of overfitting. To tackle the challenges of global optimization and control of sparse regularization intensity, the SMA is draw into the SR-BP neural network to optimize initial connection parameters and the sparse regularization factor. Finally, the optimized SMA-SR-BP surrogate model for the cavity filter is integrated with the multi-objective bionic intelligent optimization algorithm to solve the optimization design problem of multi-objective cavity filters.

articleTitle: Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in CAD Industrial Drafting and Design Platform System: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper discusses how a 3D drafting system is developed to accommodate complex human-machine interface characteristics. An object-oriented multi-level structured test case design method is proposed. An Oracle-based distributed project management database is constructed. A new 3D CAD surface model search method is given. A 3D CAD surface model retrieval algorithm based on distance-curvature shape distribution is proposed. The method can effectively solve the collaboration problem of multiple parallel programs. The designed software platform is proved to be complete, scalable and open through practical applications. Finally, it can effectively achieve human-to-human collaboration and resource sharing.

articleTitle: An Empirical Investigation into the Performance of OFDM-IM Systems Using Matlab
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: During the early stages of communication evolution, the usage of a single signal for transmission in a channel was commonplace. However, this approach resulted in significant underutilization of channel resources. To rectify this, Weinstein and his team introduced a system that employed Fourier Transform and its inverse to amalgamate the original solitary signal into multiple orthogonal carrier signals for transmission. This revolutionary system, termed Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM), allowed for efficient usage of channel bandwidth, thereby conserving precious channel resources. Fast forward to the present, a novel multi-carrier technique, exponential modulation OFDM or OFDM-IM, has emerged. This ingenious system extends beyond constellation symbols to include the indices of active sub-carriers for information transmission. Our research, encapsulated in this paper, aims to present an in-depth examination and simulation of the OFDM and OFDM-IM systems through Matlab. Our objective is to evaluate their performances across various parameters and provide a foresight into their prospective developments in the upcoming generations of wireless technology, such as 5G and 6G.

articleTitle: An innovative multi-factor prediction algorithm construction and importance analysis model based on GBDT-LightGBM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of machine learning and artificial intelligence, the research of prediction models is becoming more and more popular. This paper aims to propose a general prediction model and analyze the importance of features. First, this paper builds the GBDT(Gradient boosting decision tree) and finally, the LightGBM (Light Gradient Boosting Machine) algorithm based on the Bagging Ensemble algorithm. MAPE and R2 were set as test indicators, and 31 groups of data from 1992 to 2022 were selected for training and learning. The results show that: (1) The GBDT-LightGBM model constructed in this paper has good robustness, with MAPE of 9.658 and R2 up to 0.899. (2) GBDT-LightGBM prediction model can better evaluate the influence of independent variables on dependent variables. This study provides an effective and general methodology for forecasting models.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Allocation System of Intelligent Rural Power Consumption Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a user-oriented intelligent information interaction system and method for intelligent rural electricity service resources based on computer big data technology. The key technical modules such as intelligent monitoring terminal, monitoring resource library, registered rural electricity resource library, user demand library and rural electricity service resource interaction center are efficiently integrated. Rural electricity users can customize the rural electricity service resources according to their own needs, and complete the real-time interaction and effective connection between the users and the power grid system. This paper presents an optimal distribution problem of rural power system with some limiting factors. The effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm is verified by example analysis and software implementation based on geographic information system.

articleTitle: Research on Interface Design System of Multimedia Color Course Based on Computer 3D Visual Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper discusses a new idea of graphic visual expression design based on user experience. Using computer image and image processing technology to complete the plane visual communication design. Improve the visual communication of graphics and the user's feelings. This project constructs a spatial-temporal distribution model of visual features of graphic design based on multi-dimensional perspectives, and weights its spatial attributes based on the mean gradient and information entropy of images. Taking the farthest point of the contour line as the core, the multidimensional Angle segmentation is carried out. The proposed algorithm is combined with the conventional algorithm to realize the automatic recognition based on the location of specific feature points, and the processing speed is good. The correctness of the proposed algorithm is proved by experiments.

articleTitle: The mechanism design of new concept rotor micro aircraft
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to improve the overall stability of the ornithopter and eliminate the fuselage instability caused by the flapping of the traditional ornithopter as far as possible, a new type of ornithopter UAV is designed. Its basic flight principle is to install the rotor above the wings of the traditional ornithopter. The rotor is responsible for providing the power when rising and advancing, while the rotor mainly provides the lift when hovering in the air. After kinematics and aerodynamics analysis of the flapping mechanism, the results show that the maximum flapping amplitude of the wing is 43.28°; When flapping down, the maximum angular velocity is 18.59 rad⁄s and angular acceleration is 341.1 rad⁄s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>; When diving up, the maximum angular velocity is 12.38 rad⁄s and angular acceleration is 716.4 rad⁄s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, which is closer to the flapping data of birds in real flight state. Therefore, the flight structure of the new type of flapping wing UAV has better aerodynamic characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on optimal train operation control strategy based on dynamic programming algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Energy-saving train operation is an important means to reduce the energy consumption of rail transit system. This paper mainly aims at the problem that different driving strategies will produce different energy and time consumption during train operation, and establishes a mathematical model to study the optimal train driving strategies in different running processes. Firstly, the train dynamics model is established, and the running parameters of the train under different road conditions are obtained by Euler method. Then, optimization models of single objective programming and multi-objective programming are constructed according to different road conditions, and then dynamic programming algorithm is used to solve the models, and the optimal train control strategy under different objectives and different road conditions is obtained, and the relevant parameter sequence curves are obtained.

articleTitle: Research on extracting customer complaint work order's abstract in mobile customer service based on the combination of extractive and generative methods
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of text mining technology, how to quickly summarize and form a complaint work order's abstract based on long hotline voice transcription text, which has become a key point to improve the efficiency of agent service processing. Although online companies have a massive amount of hotline transcribed text data, there is no research on automatically generating work order's summary in mobile customer service. To reduce the cost of manual order creation, this paper proposes three methods: extractive methods (including Lead3, Tf-idf+score sorting, TextRank), generative methods (including Seq2Seq, PGN), and the combination method of extractive and generative(including Spaces, Unilm, and T5 models) . The Rouge-l value is up to 0.5071, which indicates that the method proposed is effective.

articleTitle: Application Research of Image Processing Technology in Safe Driving Distance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, a new vehicle distance detection technology based on image processing is proposed to solve the traditional ultrasonic vehicle distance detection errors, many blind areas and other problems. The binocular vision sensing system was used to collect real-time images in front of vehicles. The vehicle in front of the collected image is identified through template matching, and the parallax principle is used to calculate the vehicle distance after confirming the presence of the vehicle. Experimental results show that this method can detect the distance between different angles and different positions with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Diagnosis of Membrane Fouling Based on the Gramian Angular Field Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Because of the complex formation mechanism of MBR (Membrane Bioreactor) membrane fouling, the existing membrane fouling diagnostic model lacks the performance of spatiotemporal multi-feature fusion, making it difficult to judge the membrane fouling diagnosis under complex working conditions accurately. Therefore, this paper proposes a diagnostic model based on ResNet learning architecture and Gramian Angular Field aiming to improve the accuracy and reliability of membrane fouling diagnosis. First, the contaminated data are transformed using the Gramian Angular Field (GAF) method, and the effective features of the temporal series in them are analyzed and preserved. Then, the processed images are fed into ResNet incorporating the spatiotemporal attention mechanism for feature extraction. Finally, the fault codes are output using the SoftMax classifier and the performance of the model is compared with other networks. The experimental results show that the ResNet model incorporating the Gramian Angular Field method has high comprehensive performance and provides a new solution for membrane fouling failure analysis.

articleTitle: Dual-channel Text Classification Based on the Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Text classification can realize information organization and induction, information retrieval and search, sentiment analysis, spam filtering, automated text processing, intelligence collection and security. As the text information to be processed becomes increasingly complex, using traditional convolutional neural networks and recurrent neural networks alone is far from satisfactory for addressing the allocation of text information weights. Based on this, this paper improves the text classification model by replacing the convolutional neural network with a bidirectional convolutional neural network as one channel, replacing the recurrent neural network with a bidirectional long short-term memory network as another channel, and injecting attention mechanisms into the two channels respectively. Bi-LSTM channels can more effectively extract contextual information from news texts, while Bi-CNN channels can more effectively extract local feature information from news texts. After both channels undergo individual attention mechanism processing, the features are fused. The fused result is then passed to the softmax function to accomplish the final news text classification task. This paper conducts performance evaluation on two publicly available datasets, namely Today's Headlines and THUCNews. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed Bi-Modal Text Fusion Network (BiCTFN) outperforms other classification models and exhibits superior classification performance for long text classification tasks.

Author Keywords: bidirectional long and short-term memory network

articleTitle: Optimization and Control of Composite Energy System Based on NSGA2 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of economy and society, people have higher and higher requirements for quality of life. It also brings serious environmental problems, such as global warming and ozone layer destruction. To solve these problems, countries all over the world are actively exploring new technologies to achieve sustainable development. Among them, distributed power generation has attracted much attention as a new type of clean energy utilization. However, because of the intermittent, fluctuating and non-dispatchable characteristics of distributed power sources, their grid connection will bring certain impact on the safe and stable operation of the power system. Therefore, how to effectively improve the access capacity and power quality of distributed power sources has become an urgent problem to be solved. In this paper, we use the improved NSGA-II algorithm to solve the problem by establishing a mathematical model to improve the performance of the composite energy system.

articleTitle: Migration Deep Learning Model for Malware Detection in Power Information Network Security
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a deep learning-based approach to solve the malware classification problem. This method first uses image processing technology to convert the signature file of malware into a grayscale image. Then use, the convolutional neural network classifies the photos to achieve malware detection. First, this paper converts the feature file of the sample into a grayscale image and then uses the image classification method to judge the malware. This method is simple and easy, and image samples are more conducive to training deep-learning models. Secondly, this paper uses a convolutional neural network to solve image classification tasks. This model performs well in image processing and can automatically learn image features to improve classification accuracy. Finally, this paper uses data preprocessing techniques in critical steps, such as invalid data filtering and normalization, which can enhance the model’s generalization ability. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper achieves a high classification accuracy, and the loss and acc indicators also show sound convergence effects. This method can effectively detect malware and provide a guarantee for the security of the power information network. Further work will select a more appropriate model, increase the amount of data, optimize hyperparameters, and feature engineering to improve classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Tracking and Calculating Model of Branch Carbon Flow in Power Grid Based on Dynamic Carbon Factor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This project is to build our country's carbon emission trading pricing model by using the Index Generalized General Advanced Generalization, EGARCH (EGARCH) method. The bounds of each membership function are determined according to the optimal solution of each single objective. Using the method of maximum value, the optimal intermediate scheme is selected. Based on the carbon flow distribution principle, the carbon flow distribution characteristics of each node and branch under the action of carbon capture power station are obtained. The results of IEEE 6-machine 30-node system verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed model. The research results of this project can provide an important scientific basis for the multi-objective cooperative optimization of carbon capture power stations and related research on electric carbon characteristics.

articleTitle: An Equivalence Evaluation Method of Target Simulation Based on Improved Correlation Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the existing weapons and equipment related to the space field, it is difficult to find real targets as test objects, so it is necessary to simulate the real targets through equivalent methods, so that the simulated targets can truly reflect various characteristics of the actual targets as much as possible. This paper analyzes the problems existing in the existing equivalent evaluation methods for simulation characteristics of targets. An improved correlation coefficient evaluation method for target simulation equivalence is proposed. Through theoretical calculation, simulation analysis and experimental verification, the effect of the improved correlation coefficient evaluation method for target simulation equivalence is compared with the existing methods, and it is concluded that the proposed method can more truly reflect the consistency between target simulation and actual target data.

articleTitle: Elevator Operation Safety Online Monitoring System Overall Functional Framework Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: An analysis of the basic features of the system has been conducted, and a research and development plan for a fully automated safety protection and fault handling online monitoring system applied to elevator operation scenarios has been proposed. The hardware architecture of the system adopts a modular design approach, including processor units, door lock safety circuit units, floor area signal detection units, and communication units, among others. The reliability of parallel redundant topology is elaborated upon and applied to the hardware design of the system, greatly enhancing its safety and stability.

articleTitle: Research on Data Operation Monitoring and Analysis System of Computer Intelligent Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes an application anomaly detection and bottleneck identification system (AAD-PSC) based on cloud platform service components. The system can monitor and analyze applications on multi-layered cloud platforms with customized index values. The embedded Ethernet interface is composed of MCU and Ethernet control chip W5500. The three-layer architecture of "cloud server, device, sensor and controller" is adopted to realize no difference monitoring at any time, place and terminal. The monitoring module dynamically adjusts the sampling period so that the sampling points are concentrated in the period when the resource usage of the application system fluctuates greatly. Use UDP/IP protocol to exchange information between the local and the cloud, and analyze and process the data in the cloud. The test results show that the system has the characteristics of low cost, small size, low power consumption and high data transmission accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on software system for high performance hydrogen storage management system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The high-pressure hydrogen storage management system is an important part of the hydrogen-fueled vehicle, and the temperature, pressure and concentration of the hydrogen in the hydrogen storage cylinder will directly affect the safe driving of the vehicle. According to the analysis of the analog data collected by the hydrogen management controller, the data characteristics are obtained, and the collected temperature, pressure and concentration analog quantities are processed using different filtering algorithms. Based on the filtering algorithm, each analog quantity collected is independently collected, filtered, calculated, and limited, etc. Finally, the stability and reliability of the data are verified through experiments, so that in the event of an abnormal state of the hydrogen cylinder, the hydrogen management controller can provide timely warning and alarm to ensure the effective implementation of the safety control strategy. The controller provides timely warning and alarm to ensure the effective implementation of the safety control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on cleaning integrated mechanical system based on artificial intelligence algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Cleaning integrated mechanical system plays an important role in industrial production. However, the traditional cleaning methods have some problems such as low efficiency and waste of resources. In order to solve these problems, a new cleaning integrated mechanical system is proposed based on artificial intelligence algorithm. In the daily table tennis exercise, the surface of table tennis is often sunken or stained. The existing table tennis cleaning method is only manual cleaning, and the cleaning efficiency is low, and the high-efficiency cleaning cannot always be guaranteed after long-term work. In addition, the table tennis with sunken surface can only be restored by hot water shower, which will cause waste of water resources. At the same time, the efficiency is also very inefficient. The integrated cleaning mechanical system based on artificial intelligence algorithm has obvious advantages, which is of great significance for improving cleaning efficiency and saving resources. Therefore, a table tennis recovery and cleaning integrated device is proposed to solve the above problems.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Ship/Unmanned Vehicle Collaborative Warfare Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Ship/unmanned vehicle collaborative combat simulation has gradually become an important research direction in the field of ocean combat simulation. Based on the analysis and research of the current status of unmanned vessel equipment at home and abroad, important models and simulation architectures in the process of ship/unmanned vessel collaborative combat simulation were studied, including a route planning model for surface ship/unmanned vessel collaborative combat, a formation control model for surface ship/unmanned vessel collaborative combat, and an Agent-based simulation architecture for surface ship/unmanned vessel collaborative combat. A ship/underwater unmanned vehicle collaborative combat simulation system was implemented. This study has important reference significance for building similar simulation systems.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Controlled UAV HD Image Technology in Sports Broadcast
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper introduces the design and construction of 5G network relay system for sports game broadcast video and audio signals. The main functional components of the system, the new technology of 5G wireless transmission, and the high-definition image of UAV are described. A full-duplex UAV measurement and control and high-speed data transmission system based on distributed software radio architecture is designed and implemented. In this paper, the estimation method of point spread function under different motion blur conditions is proposed, and the Wiener filter restoration algorithm is used to estimate the image, and an image restoration scheme suitable for UAV imaging guidance system is given. The design of the system is based on modularization and standardization. It has good expansibility and maintainability.

articleTitle: Optimization Research on Radar Signal Processing Technology Based on MTI-MTD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Due to the continuous development of radar signal processing technology, the MTI-MTD (moving target detection) technology is deeply studied in this paper. This article introduces the principles and properties of MTI and MTD filter banks and analyzes their advantages in clutter suppression, signal-to-noise ratio improvement, and target velocity measurement. Therefore, a radar signal processing system based on MTI-MTD technology, including an acquisition, preprocessing, and target recognition module, is designed. First, the acquisition module receives the radar echo signal and performs analog-to-digital conversion. Second, the preprocessing module is responsible for some operations on the echo signal, such as MTI filtering and Keystone distance migration correction. Third, the target recognition module is responsible for MTD filtering of the preprocessed signal and uses the neural network model to classify and locate the target. Through the verification of three sets of experimental data, the effectiveness and feasibility of this method are high. In addition, we compare it with the traditional method. The experiment results show that the radar signal processing method based on MTI-MTD technology can detect moving targets at various distances, speeds, and signal-to-noise ratios. It improves the ability of radar signal processing technology to detect moving targets in clutter.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Storage System Based on Computer Big Data Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper uses ORACLE database, Unity engine, TCP Socket for data transmission. Build a digital twin architecture based on ORACLE. Create a virtual scene, model it and map it to real data. The storage digital twin modeling is established by using data-driven multi-dimensional fusion modeling technology. The mathematical model of space allocation is constructed with the efficiency of delivery, the degree of goods correlation and the stability of shelves as the optimization index. A new intelligent ant (IACO) algorithm is introduced and optimized. Simulation results show that this method can optimize the operating efficiency of the digital twin system.

articleTitle: Tool wear prediction method based on KPCA and GWO-LS-SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To improve the real-time and accuracy of detecting tool wear status, a new tool wear prediction method based on Kernel Principal Component Analysis (KPCA) and Grey Wolf Optimized Least Squares Support Vector Machine (GWO-LS-SVM) was proposed. This method uses cutting force signals to extract multiple features correlated with tool wear from time domain, frequency domain, and wavelet domain, and performs dimensionality reduction processing through kernel principal component analysis, then uses the gray wolf to optimize the LS-SVM to achieve prediction of tool wear. Through experimental comparison and verification, it is found that this method can accurately predict the value of tool wear, and has good real-time performance.

articleTitle: Research on grounding distance protection of grid-connected photovoltaic power station based on adaptive branch coefficient
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: When photovoltaic power generation access to high voltage transmission network, the short circuit characteristics will cause the grounding distance protection branch coefficient is uncertain, which leads to the protection refusal or malfunction. In this paper, the relationship model between the equivalent impedance XG2 and the branch coefficient Kf of a photovoltaic power station is established by using the sequence component principle. The equivalent impedance XG2 is calculated by using the DC side voltage and current of the photovoltaic inverter and the AC side voltage and current, and the relationship curve between the power generation P and XG2 of the photovoltaic power station is drawn based on the measured data. The curve fitting method is used to solve the relationship model between the two. According to the relationship between XG2 and Kf and the relationship between P and XG2, the relationship model between P and Kf is derived, and the impedance setting criterion of the grounding distance protection II section is established by using the adaptive principle. Finally, taking a regional power grid as an example, the correctness of the relationship model between P and Kf and the practicability of the established criterion are verified.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Management Strategy for Team Resources of Air Traffic Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: There has always been ambiguity in the understanding of human error levels among controllers, and the setting and conversion of daily duty modes are mainly based on empirical judgment, which leads to waste of human resources and unreasonable risk management in dynamic flight flow changes. Based on the flow information within the approach control zone and the probability of human error under different duty modes, a dynamic management strategy for controller team resources has been designed, which can optimize the use of human resources while effectively controlling risks. The effectiveness of human resource management strategies was verified through numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Intelligent Lock Control System for Data Center Based on Biometrics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of integrated management of electronic lock with high security and high convenience in application scenarios such as data center network cabinet, a lock control system based on biometric technology is designed, which integrates electronic lock, network controller, collector and lock control platform. Platform management is used for system integration. By constructing dual MCU system of electronic lock ESP32-C3FH4 and network controller CH32V307VCT6, and integrating system data into biometric electronic lock, electronic lock adopts modular design to meet different functional requirements. The lock-control system realizes face and fingerprint template transmission, authentication information and event management through wireless and wired network communication. The existing Modbus TCP communication protocol is upgraded, and MODBUS protocol is extended to UDP communication, so as to realize the transmission of large throughput data. Through the test of the lock-control network management platform, the network controller can realize the centralized management of 8 lock information, and realize the authentication and permission change of operation and maintenance personnel through the collection and uploading of biometric information such as face and fingerprint. The test face module prosthesis resistance rate of 100%, face in vivo detection reception rate of 99.71%, from trigger to single face, fingerprint recognition, unlocking time is less than 2.5 seconds. The system expands the application of biometric electronic lock in industrial field.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Risk Early Warning Monitoring Model Based on KPCA-LightGBM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of less integrated learning research and many redundant data in dynamic risk early warning monitoring, this paper proposes a dynamic risk prediction regression algorithm based on KPCA-LightGBM. Firstly, the dynamic monitoring case data is collected, and the KPCA method is used to reduce the dimension of the case data.Then, the LightGBM method is used to iterate the data after dimensionality reduction, and the importance ranking of influencing factors and the optimal parameter set of the algorithm are obtained to realize the effective prediction of dynamic risk.The results show that in the risk early warning monitoring, the KPCA-LightGBM method has higher accuracy than the traditional KPCA and LightGBM methods. At the same time, the method can better identify the feature indicators and improve the monitoring effect of various risks, which further expands the algorithm library for the dynamic monitoring algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on SIR Dynamic Analysis on Team Resource Management of Air Traffic Controllers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the daily work of controllers, they need to receive and process a lot of information, and the decisions they make are very important to the flight safety of aircraft. But under the affection of high-intensity workload, the fatigue degree of controllers will gradually increase, and the probability of human factors will gradually increase, which seriously endangers flight safety. In this regard, the mechanism of human factors of controllers is analyzed, and the attention resources of controllers are taken as the standard to judge the probability of human factors. Based on SIR model, the dynamic equations of controller attention resources and air residual command are constructed, and the stability of equilibrium point is analyzed. The dynamic characteristics of the system and the stability of the equilibrium point are verified by numerical simulation. Aiming at the workload prediction and team resource management of approach control area controllers, the practical application of the model is verified and analyzed.

articleTitle: Used sailboat price prediction based on GBRT algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Brokers often face the situation of diverse variations and too many factors to consider when pricing used sailboats, which may lead to subjective influences. Prediction of complex problems is difficult because the direct relationship between used sailboat prices and their associated characteristics is often not linear, and the relationship between prices and characteristics is difficult to capture. Also, the price movement patterns of monohull and catamarans sailboats are often different and need to be considered separately when forecasting the prices of both types of sailboats. To this end, we combined market data and machine learning to develop a GBRT(Gradient Boosting Regression Tree)-based used sailboat price evaluation model, aiming to assist brokers in pricing the used. The experiments show that the prediction model built based on the GBRT algorithm has better prediction accuracy. Further, MSE, MAPE, and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> were used to quantify the prediction performance, and the results showed that the GBRT algorithm also has better prediction performance compared with the multiple linear regression algorithm, BP neural network algorithm, and XGBoost algorithm.

articleTitle: Security Strategy for Microgrid Distributed Power Dispatch and Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: While facilitating power distribution and management, microgrid distributed power dispatch and control system encounters diverse network security challenges. These threats stem from the intricate interconnectedness, system complexity, and the handling of sensitive data. To uphold the dependability and security of microgrid systems, it is imperative to implement a comprehensive array of security strategies and measures. The article presents security strategies to counter unauthorized access, mitigate denial of service attacks, and safeguard against data tampering in microgrid distributed power dispatch and control system.

articleTitle: Price prediction model for different types of sailboats based on XGBoost algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Sailboats are a popular type of luxury goods whose values vary depending on a range of factors, such as their age, condition, and market conditions. Further, monohull and catamaran sailboats are two types of sailboats. The characteristics of these two types of sailboats are often different. Due to their more features, the process of predicting their prices is more complicated. For this reason, this paper builds a full-flow model based on XGBoost from data pre-processing to data prediction in order to predict sailboat prices in a comprehensive and integrated way. Experiments show that the model designed in this paper has the best MSE for both single and twin boats in the comparison algorithm. And the accuracy gap is the smallest and the robustness is the best when predicting for single and double boats.

articleTitle: Research on distortion correction of fisheye image based on improved linear feature model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The fisheye lens is a kind of ultra-wide angle camera, which has the characteristics of short focal length and large angle of view. It is widely used in video conference, security monitoring, intelligent transportation and other fields. However, the large viewing angle advantage of the fisheye lens is at the cost of very serious distortion. In order to obtain effective scene information in the picture, it is necessary to correct the distorted image to a distortion free linear perspective projection image. This paper studies the characteristics of nonlinear imaging models and proposes a distortion correction algorithm of fisheye image based on improved linear feature model. The algorithm uses Taylor polynomial to approximate the general model of fisheye lens, proposes the method of backward coordinate mapping for distortion correction. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has better performance in terms of qualitative characterization of pixel error and re-projection error.

articleTitle: Based on the combination of CNN and LSTM, long and short sentence network education public opinion analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, the importance of education has been balanced in the “national economy and people’s livelihood”. The Internet has provided a convenient way for the public to express their opinions and demands, and people’s attention to education has continued to increase. Online education public opinion and real education influence each other, and have a far-reaching impact on education. By making full use of online education public opinion, education administrators can make more scientific decisions and enhance the public’s ability to supervise education. Emotional tendency is the vane of online education public opinion, which truly reflects the opinions and attitudes of all social strata. These emotional information play a decisive role in the development of online education public opinion, so how to accurately mine the emotional semantic information in the text of online education public opinion has become a research difficulty in the field of sentiment analysis. Deep learning technology is an effective method that can automatically perform the emotional feature generation stage to mine the emotional feature information of the text. This paper takes two different texts, short text comments and long news texts generated in online education public opinion, as the practical application background, and combines deep learning technology to study the sentiment analysis methods of different length texts. Existing short text sentiment analysis methods cannot comprehensively extract the emotional features of text, and rely heavily on a large amount of language knowledge and emotional resources, so it is necessary to make full use of these unique emotional information to make the model achieve the best performance. This paper proposes a novel text sentiment analysis model that combines the advantages of convolutional neural networks and LSTMs. The model first uses the multi-head attention mechanism to learn the dependencies between words and capture emotional vocabulary in short texts. Next, LSTM is used to extract the emotional features of different granularities of the text. Then, the features are fused and the instance feature representation of the text is obtained through the global average pooling layer. Finally, judge the emotional category of the text based on the properties of the capsule. Experimental results show that the model performs well on the short text sentiment classification task and outperforms other baseline models.

articleTitle: Design of interface unit for microwave test equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Microwave technology is one of the important supporting technologies in the modern information society. With the explosive development of the communication industry and the large-scale production of products, coaxial and microwave switches are widely used in the interface unit of the special test equipment for signal routing between the instrument and the measured part (DUT). The main work and achievements of this paper are based on the impedance matching and level balance characteristics of the transmission system in microwave network theory, confirm the characteristics of the module to be tested and its parameters to be tested, select appropriate microwave devices, develop the interface unit based on single chip microcomputer applied to the special test equipment, make the physical object and realize the RF signal switching and routing under the established calibration working conditions. Complete the testing of professional testing equipment.

articleTitle: Research on cargo shipment strategy based on hybrid genetic simulated annealing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the deepening of economic globalization, import and export companies often need to transport goods sold through cargo aircraft. In this paper, the maximum volume utilization of cargo aircraft is considered, which has a very positive practical significance to improve transportation efficiency, reduce transportation costs, enhance corporate profitability and reduce pollutant emissions. Under the given data, one aircraft of each type, large, medium and small, is required to be loaded with cargo directly so as to leave no empty space. Considering the constraints of cargo hold volume, maximum load, smoothness and cargo placement position and orientation, an optimization model of cargo hold volume utilization is constructed, combined with a three-space partitioning heuristic algorithm to perform spatial partitioning and spatial merging to generate the initial loading scheme, and a hybrid genetic simulated annealing algorithm is used to control the start and end of the hybrid algorithm with the initial and end temperatures of the simulated annealing algorithm to find the optimal loading scheme The optimal shipping solution for the three aircraft is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Altitude Control of Tandem Twin-rotor UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the altitude control problem of tandem twin rotor UAV, a PID controller based altitude control method is proposed in this paper. First of all, the dynamic and kinematic analysis of the UAV is conducted, and then a model is built in MATLAB/Simulink, and the parameters of the PID controller are optimized to achieve precise control of the UAV's altitude. The simulation results show that the proposed control method has high control accuracy and robustness, and can maintain stability even when facing external disturbances. This study provides a feasible PID control solution for altitude control of tandem twin-rotor UAV, which has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Energy and Efficiency Analysis of the Wireless EV Charging System Based on LCC-LCC Resonance Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: IPT system is widely used in wireless charging of EVs. In this paper, a simulation model of typical IPT system based on LCC-LCC resonant network is established. By conducting simulations and analyzing the energy and efficiency traits of the system when exposed to varying load resistance, adjustable coupling coefficients, and frequency fluctuations, we obtain energy and efficiency curves for the system across different operational scenarios, which is of reference significance for the design of IPT system based on LCC-LCC resonant network.

articleTitle: Influence of Radius of Photoacoustic Cell and Background Gas Type on Photoacoustic Spectroscopy Gas Measurement System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The gas detection performance of photoacoustic spectroscopy devices can be effectively improved by optimizing the photoacoustic cell (PAC) structure. In this paper, the frequency response of PACs with multiple radius and background gases were simulated. The results show that the sound pressure decreases as the modulation frequency increases. The smaller the radius, the greater the sound pressure value. The sound pressure intensity inside the photoacoustic cell increases as the gas heat capacity ratio increases, especially for a PAC with a radius of 3 mm. Three different background gases (He, N2 and SF6) are filled in the PAC. The results show that the background gas has an effect on the sound pressure signal. The sound pressure signal will also increase as the heat capacity ratio of the background gas increases, the sequence of the PA signals’ intensity is He>N2>SF6. The research results provide reference method and idea for the optimal design of photoacoustic cells.

articleTitle: Applied Research on Attribute-Based Encryption Scheme with Two-level Encryption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This study addresses the issue of sensitive data protection in cloud computing environments and proposes a solution that combines Attribute-Based Encryption with the Rivest-Shamir-Adleman encryption algorithm to safeguard the data. The proposed solution enables efficient two-way encrypted communication using this two-level encryption approach. The advantages of this solution include enhanced access control, ensuring that only users with appropriate attributes can access the data, and strong security achieved through the combination of Attribute-Based Encryption (ABE) and Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) algorithms, effectively defending against man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks and data leakage risks.

articleTitle: Design and Development of an Access Point Based on Secure Chip
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Digitization has penetrated into every aspect of life, and network security has become one of the main focuses of future security. China has independently developed security chips with intellectual property rights, and the commercial cryptographic algorithm of China (SM algorithm) has been widely promoted and used for many years. At the same time, China also has its own wireless local area network standard called WAPI. This article introduces the basic principles and applications of security chips, and elucidates the construction of a high-information security Access Point (AP) based on domestically developed products.

articleTitle: Experimental study of corona noise suppression on AC transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: High-voltage transmission line corona noise triggered by the frequent complaints of neighbouring residents, the current management of corona noise lacks a better economic solution. This paper tests a new type of wire wrapped corona noise suppression technology to carry out corona cage test research on corona noise suppression effect of high voltage transmission lines. Through the use of a high thermal conductivity insulating material, wrapped in the AC transmission conductor, to achieve the purpose of reducing the surface field strength, corona noise suppression. The test is carried out in the corona cage, by loading different voltages to make the surface of the wire to achieve the required field strength, observing the number of UV discharge photons and testing the audible noise to verify the effect of noise reduction.

articleTitle: Stock Prediction Using Evolutionary Attention-based LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Stock prediction is an important research issue that has attracted extensive attention from both academia and the industry. In previous studies, advanced deep learning models have shown better performance in predicting stock trends using time series data compared to traditional statistical time series models such as ARIMA and machine learning methods such as SVM. This study proposes a new deep learning method called Evolutionary Attention-based LSTM (EA-LSTM), which has not yet been used to predict stocks. Simulations were conducted on the famous stock index Dow Jones Index (DJI) to compare the prediction efficiency of EA-LSTM with other deep learning models including RNN, GRU, and LSTM as baselines, which are popular time series prediction models. The experimental results using RMSE and MAE as evaluation indicators indicate that the performance of EA-LSTM is superior to other methods.

articleTitle: A Numerical Computer Simulation System for the Influence of Physical Fitness Training Loads on Basketball Players
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technology is used to develop a set of basketball load effect simulation system. The perceptual interaction subsystem uses the virtual environment producer to build a 3D training load to affect the scene, and then uses the view module in the model calculus subsystem to draw the picture in the 3D scene. The logic module will deduce the physical state of the player, and then feed the inferred results to the visual interaction system through the interface, affecting the generator. The interaction of basketball load on it is shown. The experimental results show that this system can simulate the physical strength decline of basketball very well. It has good load capacity. It can improve the load effect of physical exercise on athletes and the simulation efficiency of competition. After use, it can improve the performance of basketball players.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Analysis of Insulation Damp Defect in a 220kV Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As the core equipment of power grid, current transformer undertakes the key functions of power system measurement, control and protection. In this paper, a 220kV oil-immersed current transformer has a metal expander toppling defect, and the test analysis of insulation resistance, DC resistance, dissolved gas in oil, high voltage dielectric loss and partial discharge is carried out. It is initially suspected that the current transformer has insulation damp defect. Through the disassembly analysis of the current transformer, combined with the dielectric loss measurement between capacitance screens, infrared spectrum analysis and other tests and production process troubleshooting, it was determined that the cause of the fault was that the cutting fluid of the primary guide rod was not cleaned up during the manufacturing process of the current transformer, which led to the high water content of the zero screen insulation paper, partial discharge under the action of the operating voltage, and continued to produce hydrogen, methane and other characteristic gases. Ultimately, it caused the current transformer metal expander to overshoot. This diagnostic analysis shows that dissolved gas analysis in oil, high-voltage dielectric loss, capacitance screen dielectric loss, and infrared spectroscopy analysis can effectively diagnose insulation damp defects of current transformers.

articleTitle: Reasons and rectification measures for information disclosure of material nameplate
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper designs a device to prevent material nameplate information disclosure, aiming at solving the problem of confidentiality of sensitive information in the process of power material sampling. Firstly, the paper analyzes the confidentiality requirements in the power material sampling task, and discusses the limitations and challenges of the existing technology. Based on this, we put forward a design scheme to prevent the leakage of material information nameplate. The device includes a monitoring and alarm system for nameplate information of materials. By scanning and identifying the nameplate information of materials, the device can monitor the access behavior of nameplate information in real time and give an alarm when unauthorized access or copying behavior is found. Through experiments and tests, we verified the performance and feasibility of the device. The results show that the device can accurately monitor the access and dissemination of nameplate information and give an alarm in time to prevent potential information leakage.

articleTitle: ADMM two-dimensional angle estimation based on L-type arrays
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the base mismatch in the process of applying the traditional Compressed sensing theory to estimate DOA, an improved algorithm for two-dimensional DOA estimation of L-shaped array based on the alternating multiplier method (ADMM) has been proposed in this paper, so as to transform the two-dimensional angle estimation problem into the two-dimensional angle estimation problem. Based on this, by combining the azimuth-elevation information in each array, the target information can be extracted accordingly; In addition, based on the signal model, the signal spatial overcomplete expression can be established to estimate the azimuth and pitch angles by means of the ADMM method. Overall, this method can be used to avoid the complex computational complexity in the two-dimensional joint estimation process, thereby greatly reducing the complexity of the correlation. Based on the improvement of the convergence accuracy and success probability of DOA recovery, the convergence rate of ADMM algorithm can be improved. In fact, the simulation results indicate the superiority of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Cloud-Based Digital Three-Dimensional Scanning System for Denture Digitization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This study delves into the design of a cloud-based digital three-dimensional scanning system for denture digitization. Addressing the requirements of digital denture manufacturing, this article presents a multi-tiered system architecture comprising a user interface, cloud servers, data transmission module, data processing module, and data storage module. Through this system, patients can upload oral model scanning data via the user interface, achieving precise three-dimensional reconstruction and personalized denture design facilitated by cloud server processing and storage. The article also outlines data transmission protocols and security measures, ensuring secure data transmission and privacy protection. Employing a comprehensive array of techniques, including data encryption, end-to-end encryption, data anonymization, and access control, the system safeguards patient privacy and sensitive data. This design furnishes patients with enhanced denture solutions while providing medical professionals with an efficient platform for data sharing and collaboration.

articleTitle: Establishment of second-hand sailboats price prediction model based on random forest and exploration of influencing factors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The price of used sailboats is always in flux and the variety of factors that affect their value makes it difficult to value them. The purpose of this paper is to develop a model for predicting the listing price of sailboats in order to help brokers estimate the value of used sailboats, with the expectation that we can provide them with some advice on pricing so that they can price used sailboats reasonably and scientifically and avoid unnecessary losses for both sides of the transaction. In order to improve the accuracy of the prediction for the price of sailboats. In this paper, a prediction model based on random forest is established for the prediction problem of used sailboat prices. And the method of hypothesis testing is applied to explore the degree of association between different features and the prediction model. The results show that the used sailboat price prediction model based on random forest established in this paper has high prediction accuracy and can better reflect the real price of used sailboats. And through the exploration, it can be learned that for the price of used sailboats, the brand has the greatest influence on the price of sailboats.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment method for distribution networks considering mains-distribution coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article proposes a reliability evaluation method for distribution networks that considers the coupling of main distribution systems. Firstly, the influence of main-distribution coupling on distribution network reliability assessment is analyzed. Then, a main-distribution network coordination evaluation model based on the negative weight coefficient and a reliability index-oriented assessment model are established. Then, various types of reliability indicators of the system are obtained by solving the model and using the mechanism of optimisation search. Finally, the accuracy and effectiveness of the method are analyzed through examples.

articleTitle: Design of STEM Teaching Network Publishing Framework Based on Web Interactive Programming Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of e-learning, collaborative learning platforms such as Web-Based Education Domain are gradually being promoted in subject education. However, with the deepening of the application of platform environments, the problem of time lag in learning interaction in virtual classrooms has gradually been exposed. The traditional one-way collaborative education platform has been difficult to meet the demand for real-time interaction in smart classroom teaching. Based on this, the research was inspired by programming education and introduced a Web-based interactive programming environment. Through segmented programming technology, real-time interaction between teachers and students in the virtual classroom was realized, and animation media resources were finally generated and published to the learning network. middle. In the environment design, the study introduced four dimensions of environmental learning goals (entry skills, primitive skills, emotional skills and wisdom skills) to analyze learners, and based on the analysis results, a corresponding teaching case for the interactive programming environment system framework was designed, discuss how to use this framework to implement subject teaching ideas and practical methods to promote real-time interaction in virtual classrooms.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Digital Twin Technology in Intelligent Information System of Modern Logistics Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A 3D warehouse digital twin modeling system is constructed on the platform of Siemens PDPS system. The business logic and control signal in the process of loading and unloading are designed. The "end to end" reinforcement learning algorithm is used to realize the cooperative optimal of inventory management and distribution decision for emergencies. In this way, a balance is found between maintenance costs and the stability of the logistics system. The process optimization and simulation test of the system are carried out by using Siemens auxiliary software. The feasibility of the digital twin model is verified, and the operation cost of the warehouse is effectively reduced. It improves the efficiency of maintenance and debugging.

articleTitle: Design of an Electric Vehicle Modeling and Visualization System Based on Industrial CT and Mixed Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This study explores the design of an electric vehicle modeling and visualization system based on industrial CT and mixed reality technology. Firstly, the principles of CT technology and the composition and data processing methods of industrial CT systems are introduced. Then, the imaging principles and calculation methods of CT are discussed in detail, including the Beer-Lambert law and data reconstruction algorithms. Subsequently, a method utilizing OpenGL for modeling and visualization is proposed, encompassing the overall design of the visualization system and its operational workflow. Through this research, a novel approach is established, combining CT and mixed reality technology, to provide fresh insights and methods for the related field.

articleTitle: Research and application of encrypted data transmission based on IPSec
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to solve the security problem of data transmission between networks, Internet practitioners have been trying various solutions, trying to make data can be transmitted in multiple complex network environments, while security is also satisfied. The most classic solution is to use an encryption algorithm to encrypt and transmit data.
