The encryption algorithm includes international algorithms such as RSA<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> and AES<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>. There are also SM1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[3]</sup>, SM2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[4]</sup> and SM4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[4]</sup> in China to fill the vacancy of the encryption algorithm, but the above solutions are all aimed at encrypting the data itself. This article tries to solve the problem of data security transmission from another angle. Even if the data itself is not encrypted, it can still ensure that both the sender and receiver of the data can transmit the data safely. The idea of this article is to try to establish a proprietary encrypted channel at the sending and receiving ends of the data. Based on this encrypted channel, the security of data transmission can be guaranteed even though the data passes through multiple devices in the Internet environment. The data sender and receiver can base on the Site-to-Site<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[5]</sup> VPN<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[6]</sup> channel established by IPSec<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[7]</sup>, cooperate with the domestic encryption algorithm, which not only ensures the security of the data, but also avoids the risk of using foreign algorithms, and realizes the encryption of the data packet during the transmission process. This method has the characteristics of safety and wide applicability, and can be used as a new idea for safe data transmission.

articleTitle: Research on Mid-Platform Scenario Operation and Maintenance System of Computer Cloud Platform Based on Enhanced Risk Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: It adopts micro-service architecture to create a safe, efficient and agile intelligent operation and maintenance integrated service platform. The system has the functions of low voltage topology recognition, intelligent anomaly research, accurate automatic order sending, auxiliary power grid planning and so on. Combined with some classical theories of situational awareness model, a situational awareness algorithm model based on improved fuzzy clustering algorithm is established. The overall operation and maintenance service platform builds the operation and maintenance service system based on the cloud computing and middle-desk architecture to realize the unified standardization and integration of the whole-domain management resource data. A trial of the system in a power company showed a 0.3% drop in the error rate.

articleTitle: The Design of Intelligent Epidemic Prevention Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, the global epidemic situation continues to deteriorate, and China's epidemic situation has experienced many repeats, so the role and advantages of intelligent epidemic prevention tools are becoming more and more obvious. Under the epidemic situation, medical staff and volunteers have a very large workload and can not rule out the risk of infection. The emergence of epidemic prevention vehicles and their input into practical work can greatly reduce artificial non-essential consumption. At the same time, it helps the society to make more rational use of human resources. The transmission path of the epidemic is mainly person-to-person, and the epidemic prevention car can avoid personnel entering high-risk areas for disinfection, thus greatly reducing the possibility of infection, and finally improve the overall elimination probability on the premise of ensuring the safety of medical personnel.

articleTitle: Parallel Classification Method of Library Borrowing Data Based on Bayes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on the parallel classification of library borrowing data, the dynamic management and service ability of library borrowing information are improved, and a parallel classification method of library borrowing data based on Bayesian is proposed. According to the borrowing reports of user groups and individuals, a sampling model of library borrowing data is constructed, and a comprehensive borrowing index analysis model for users' personal construction system is established. Bayesian classification model is used to realize the feature mining and classification of borrowing data, and the correlation between different types of literature resources is mined according to the results of spectral feature extraction. Combined with the borrowing intensity between users with different attributes and different book classifications, Naive Bayesian classification algorithm is used to fully explore the internal relationship between fields. Based on the causal relationship between influencing factors, a dynamic model of parallel classification of library borrowing data is constructed, and the library borrowing data is matched according to certain rules. After weighted calculation, the reading behavior is quantified in the form of comprehensive index to realize parallel classification of library borrowing data. The test results show that the parallel classification of library borrowing data by this method improves the mining efficiency and accuracy of borrowing data, and the parallel processing efficiency is high.

articleTitle: A Fault Warning Model Based on Big Data Cluster Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article proposes a sector model early warning method based on ELM theory, with the background of big data processing cluster technology. A fault early warning model is established using naive Bayesian algorithm combined with time series similarity fault matching. The model adopts collected data such as relevant electrical quantities, switching values, event sequence information, power grid topology, and data obtained from fault recording devices during line faults. The naive Bayesian algorithm is used to mine the occurrence index of potential fault occurrence factors (i.e. fault factors), and then combined with time series similarity fault matching to perform fault warning on the line.

articleTitle: Research on Service Security Reinforcement Scheme Based on Application Gateway
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to realize the network security of open platform SaaS applications, avoid user data leakage and data tampering, and improve the security protection ability of application services, this research uses the application gateway based on Spring Gateway and Spring Security to build a user rights model by using RBAC principle, and realizes the technology-controllable link encryption and digital signature scheme by SM2, SM3 and SM4 national secret algorithms. The application gateway records access logs uniformly, and forms an application gateway with certain security protection ability, which has user authentication, controllable access rights, data transmission encryption and traceability after access. By introducing this application gateway, the network security capability of the open platform can be enhanced, and at the same time, the development intrusion of platform services can be avoided. It is compatible with business micro-services with different architectures and different development languages, which is conducive to the formation of unified service security protection.

articleTitle: Research on glass composition analysis based on K-means algorithm and Lasso regression algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper aims to study the relationship among weathering, color, species and ornamentation of glass relics by means of data preprocessing and statistical analysis. At the same time, the logistic regression model was used to classify the high potassium and lead barium glass. The K-means clustering algorithm is used to cluster the glass, and the chemical composition content rules of each class are found, and each class is regarded as a sub-class. Through the established K-means clustering algorithm to determine the central components of high-potassium and lead-barium glass, it is found that the central components of high-potassium glass are K2O and CaO, while the central components of lead-barium glass are SiO2, PbO and BaO. Through LASSO regression model based on Lars algorithm, 14 chemical elements were screened, and the main related elements of the two types of glass were obtained. It is found that SiO2 is strongly correlated in these two types of glass, while PbO and BaO are strongly correlated in lead-barium glass, but the correlation with high-potassium glass is very weak. This study is of great significance to elucidate the characteristics and classification of glass relics.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Research on Cold Chain Logistics Control System for Quality of Fresh Agricultural Products under Computer Intelligent Temperature Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: According to the special requirements of fresh agricultural products on temperature and humidity, a set of temperature and humidity monitoring system for low temperature fresh agricultural products was developed with ARM9 and ZigBee gateway as the core. The temperature and humidity of cold storage are controlled by microcomputer, and the data are collected. It realizes display and adaptive adjustment and alarm functions. A wireless sensor network based on 6 LoWPAN is proposed. The introduction of IPv6 in WSN ensures reliable data delivery. Practice has proved that the implementation of this project can not only effectively improve the information management of cold storage enterprises, but also promote the development of fresh agricultural supply chain enterprises from "storage type" to "logistics type".

Author Keywords: cold chain logistics temperature and humidity

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in Cultural Confidence Online Open Course Platform System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: An intelligent learning system based on online resource open course was proposed based on Semantic Web ontology technology. The system mainly includes experimental content, online test, video on demand, teaching forum and other modules. Firstly, according to the characteristics of the learning behavior data collected by the online resource open course platform, the characteristics of learners are selected. Then, a knowledge tracking model is constructed based on Bayesian network, model parameters are set based on empirical probability, and the difficulty of problems is introduced into the model. Finally, we define the positive characteristics of students’ attitude and build a learning attitude tracking model based on classification algorithm. The design of the system is reasonable, the operation is simple, the maintenance is convenient, the operation is stable, the security is high, and the teaching method of the basic course of computer application is optimized, and the computer application ability of the students is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Research on Fast and Corresponding Multi-Stream Data Management System of Power Pretraining Based on Central Weighted Data Stream Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To solve the anomaly detection problem of power big data stream, this paper combines the clustering algorithm of power big data stream with power big data stream. In view of the existing stream data clustering algorithm is not easy to store all the data, power data easy to lose and other problems and the stream data clustering algorithm for offline stage clustering algorithm real-time response requirements from the data integrity, security and low time complexity of the stream data clustering algorithm to improve the CLU Stream data clustering algorithm. At the same time, a central-weighted data stream clustering algorithm is proposed. In the online phase, Redis cluster is used to buffer stream data, and node time attenuation strategy is designed. Increases the percentage of valid heartbeat messages. The offline stage clustering algorithm is optimized. The optimal distance method is used to determine the initial clustering center and reduce the number of iterations. Finally, the proposed central-weighted data stream clustering algorithm is used to detect the abnormal behavior of users. The experimental results show that the algorithm can detect the abnormal behavior of users well.

articleTitle: STM32 Microcontroller-Based Voice-Activated Anti-Throttle Mis-Stepping System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of drivers mistakenly stepping on the throttle as the brake, this paper summarizes the advantages and shortcomings of the existing related designs and proposes a design scheme for an intelligent control system for automotive throttle mis-stepping without changing the original operation structure. This paper proposes a throttle mis-stepping judgment model, which uses the voice recognition bundle to identify the screaming sound of the car owner, while judging whether the throttle acceleration is greater than the threshold value, so as to determine whether the throttle is mis-stepped. This paper also uses the model to design a throttle mis-stepping hardware system with STM32 microcontroller as the main control, which consists of a voice signal processing module and an execution module, and Bluetooth is used for information transmission between the modules. The hardware system designed in this paper has high real-time and intelligence, which can assist the driver to drive safely and finally achieve the purpose of ensuring driving safety.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Digital Denture Polishing System Based on Improved RRT Path Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This study addresses challenges in traditional denture polishing processes, such as color matching, motion planning, and degree of freedom optimization. An intelligent digital denture polishing system is proposed, based on an improved Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) path optimization algorithm. The system integrates the HSI color model, color calibration using structured light, and the improved RRT path optimization algorithm. A bio-inspired digital polishing robotic arm with seven degrees of freedom is developed, and a color matching approach based on a tooth enamel color database is introduced. Through this system, precise tooth color matching, efficient and accurate robotic arm motion planning, and unprecedented progress and potential are achieved in the field of dental restoration.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Prediction Model Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, based on the open source UC dataset, the original dataset was first subjected to data preprocessing operations such as logarithmic transformation, outlier and missing value processing, and dimensionality reduction to obtain complete, valid, intuitive, and concise data. To avoid multicollinearity among variables, the variance expansion coefficient of each variable was calculated and found to be less than 5, so there was no multicollinearity. Then lasso regression feature extraction was performed to reduce the number of variables to 13, thus reducing the complexity of the model. A random forest prediction model was constructed, and its average relative error was 0.04217 according to the model evaluation criterion 0.99157, with an error precision of 1. The model has good precision and is useful for prediction research in other fields.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Research and application of on-site debugging technology for intelligent distribution gateway
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, the requirements of field debugging of intelligent gateway of power distribution are studied, and the on-site simulation cloud testing technology and signal injection method of different types of terminals are proposed. According to the results we got, the automatic closed-loop debugging of "End, Edge and Cloud" is realized through the field debugging. For the field debugging of primary and secondary fusion DTU/FTU, an independent electromagnetic/ electronic signal output channel and high-precision output technology are designed, and the automatic closed-loop debugging is conducted in cooperation with the analog power distribution master station. The software architecture of debugging tool and the automatic test flow of intelligent terminal are also described in this paper in detail. The debugging tool based on this technology has been tested on site and proofed it is with high-performance.

articleTitle: Risk Prediction of a Domestic Regional Transportation Aircraft Based on Composite Models
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To study the aviation operational risk status of a certain type of domestic regional transport aircraft, a risk prediction index system is established by considering factors such as event level, event type, event quantity, event stage, and event cause. Based on the unsafe event data of aircraft in the past 6 years, the Time Series Analysis and Prediction Model (ARIMA) is applied to reflect the seasonal characteristics of risk and fit the linear relationship of risk data. The BP neural network is used to reflect the sudden characteristics of risk and fit the nonlinear relationship of risk data. The risk prediction results calculated for each model are weighted using CRITIC objective weighting method to output the combined prediction results. The results show that the combination of ARIMA and BP neural network models fits the historical sequence of risks well, and the prediction accuracy is acceptable. This study can provide data support for analyzing the safety and operational trends of airlines, and also provide assistance for airlines to develop targeted risk prevention and control measures.

articleTitle: Precision Irrigation Decision Model Analysis Using Deep Learning and Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This study innovatively uses deep learning-based image processing methods to make crop fertilization decisions. Herein, we examined the images of tomato leaves captured by an embedded system camera using Raspberry Pi. We also considered the on-site classification of tomato leaf deficiencies and the extraction of information after the leaf segmentation, using the expert knowledge base and the crop fertilizer model. The study provides appropriate fertilization recommendations to improve fertilizer utilization. The convolutional neural network model trained in this study for tomato leaf deficiency recognition achieved 95% verification accuracy. The average pixel accuracy of leaf segmentation and mean intersection-to-union ratio achieved were0.89 and 0.76, respectively.

articleTitle: An Improved Attention Transfer Teacher-Student Model for Edge Deployment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Large-scale deep learning models have done really well in things like understanding language, recognizing images, and other areas. However, these models also bring challenges, including computational complexity and storage requirements, which will induce the difficulty to implement large-scale deep learning models on edge computing devices. This paper proposes an improved attention transfer teacher-student model and related distillation loss function and training strategy, which is a teacher-student model knowledge distillation method for attention transfer through class activation maps. Not only does the teacher model change its predictions, but it also shares its attention with the student model, the goal is to make sure the student model works like the teacher model, so that the former can successfully learn the teacher model and be deployed at the edge of resource constraints device. The test results on open source datasets initially show that this method can further compress models and is suitable for deployment on resource-constrained devices.

articleTitle: Multi-strategy Collaborative Optimized YOLOv5s and Its Application in Distance Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The increasing accident rate brought about by the explosive growth of automobiles has made the research on active safety systems of automobiles increasingly important. The importance of improving the accuracy of vehicle target detection is self-evident. To achieve the goals of vehicle detection and distance estimation and provide safety warnings, a Distance Estimation Safety Warning System (DESWS) based on a new neural network model (YOLOv5s-SE) by replacing the IoU with DIoU, embedding SE attention module, and a distance estimation method through using the principle of similar triangles was proposed. In addition, a method that can give safety suggestions based on the estimated distance using nonparametric testing was presented in this work. Through the simulation experiment, it was verified that the mAP was improved by 5.5% and the purpose of giving safety suggestions based on the estimated distance information can be achieved.

articleTitle: Application of Intelligent Automated Settlement Monitoring in Surface Subsidence of Salt Caverns Based on GNSS Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The application of GNSS technology in surface subsidence monitoring at smart construction sites is becoming increasingly widespread. This technology utilizes the surface position information provided by the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) to continuously monitor and understand real-time changes in surface subsidence. By deploying GNSS receivers and wirelessly transmitting monitoring data to a central server, an automated monitoring system for surface subsidence is established, enabling management personnel to have real-time insights into surface subsidence, alerting potential risks, and optimizing construction and operational management at the construction site. Taking the surface subsidence monitoring of the underground gas storage facility in the Yicheng Compressed Air Energy Storage Power Station as a practical case study, the effectiveness and feasibility of the system in surface subsidence monitoring of smart construction sites for salt caverns are validated, which is of great significance for salt cavern stability assessment, resource management, and planning.

articleTitle: Priority Task Offloading Decision Optimization Based on Multi-Objective Grey Wolf Algorithm in Internet of Things Edge Computing Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In Internet of Things (IoT) application scenarios, the traditional method of prioritizing task offloading based on scalar information such as maximum tolerable latency fails to meet the processing requirements of urgent tasks. To ensure the prioritized handling of urgent tasks, this paper proposes a priority task offloading decision optimization strategy based on the multi-objective Grey Wolf Algorithm. The research focuses on the problem of priority task offloading decision and considers the edge server task processing program cache. The optimization objectives, including minimizing overall latency, social loss rate, and load imbalance, are established to formulate a multi-objective optimization task offloading decision model. The multi-objective Grey Wolf Algorithm is employed to solve the problem. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed multi-objective Grey Wolf Algorithm effectively reduces overall latency and social loss rate, optimizes load balancing among edge servers, and outperforms other algorithms significantly.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Security Power Grid Model Simulation System Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, a model of active distribution network safety monitoring system based on big data mining platform is established. This model combines multiple detection techniques and uses three-stage detection methods in the analysis equipment engine. A fuzzy encryption processing model of power flow information is proposed, which can improve the computing efficiency of static security analysis of power system under cloud computing environment on the premise of ensuring power flow information security. Through the simulation analysis of the fault diagnosis example, the results show that the proposed fault diagnosis algorithm is fast, accurate and effective.

articleTitle: Research on Self-driving Vehicle Driving Status Monitoring and Trajectory Tracking Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Considering the research of driving state monitoring and trajectory tracking technology of autonomous vehicles in roads under low permeability conditions is an important technical means to alleviate traffic problems and ensure traffic safety, which is of great significance to improve the safety and robustness of autonomous driving. However, the traditional trajectory tracking algorithm has the problem of insufficient data accuracy and cannot effectively obtain the holographic traffic trajectory state. Accordingly, this paper proposes a forward vehicle state prediction algorithm based on the combination of the Auto-Regressice Moving Average (ARMA) model and Kalman filter to achieve accurate prediction of vehicle trajectory. At the same time, this paper also proposes a spatiotemporal fusion strategy based on the topological statistical distance of vehicle network data and roadside wide-area radar data and constructs a spatiotemporal correlation mechanism of the absolute position of vehicle GNSS and relative position information of millimeter wave radar detection to realize continuous and accurate location tracking service of vehicles and provide reliable data support for intelligent traffic control.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Power Consumption Monitoring Based on LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the continuous development and update of social energy-using technologies, energy consumption is also increasing in a stepwise manner. Given the limited and tense energy resources, the country has proposed relevant policies for controlling energy consumption, mainly targeting high-energy-consuming and high-polluting industries, to save energy and reduce consumption. The supervision of energy consumption of enterprises has become a major issue. Traditional energy consumption monitoring mainly relies on a large number of data collection units and manuals to collect various types of energy data for aggregation, which requires a lot of manpower and material resources in terms of equipment investment and operation and maintenance costs. This article selects the monthly energy consumption data of enterprises with a capacity of over 5000tce in Chongqing from 2019 to the first quarter of 2022, as well as monthly electricity consumption data, and uses an LSTM (Long Short-Term) model to predict enterprise energy consumption data. The traditional ARIMA time series model is introduced for comparison and verification. Experimental results show that the LSTM model is always superior to the ARIMA model, not only in terms of the fitting of prediction results but also in performance on multiple evaluation indicators. This also points out a meaningful research direction for short-term enterprise energy consumption prediction and enables faster and more efficient implementation of enterprise-level energy consumption monitoring.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Monitoring and Defect Identification Method of Oil and Gas Pipeline Based on Faster R-CNN Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: For the problems of oil and gas pipelines in complex environments, such as difficulty in defect detection, high false alarm rate, and inaccurate positioning, this paper proposes a defect recognition algorithm based on Faster R-CNN. First, according to the Faster R-CNN model, RPN is established to obtain the confidence and coordinate system number of image features and effective anchor points. The information of the prediction box and target box is generated. Second, an ROI Pooling strategy is proposed to eliminate the size inconsistency between the prediction and target boxes. Third, concerning the defect characteristics of oil and gas pipelines, a classification regression model considering the influence of category and location is constructed to describe the defects more accurately. Finally, an oil and gas pipeline safety monitoring system based on the Faster R-CNN algorithm is built. Simulation and experiment prove the effectiveness of the proposed defect recognition algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Scheduling Algorithm of Microgrid Energy Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the increasing scale and complexity of the power system, the traditional large power grid can no longer meet the requirements for power quality and reliability. In order to solve these problems, distributed power generation technology has emerged and developed rapidly. However, due to the random and fluctuating nature of distributed power generation, there are many problems in the actual operation of microgrid, such as poor voltage stability, uneven power distribution and large energy loss. Therefore, how to realize the coordinated control among distributed power sources in microgrid and various loads in microgrid is one of the urgent problems to be solved. Combined with the game analysis method, a multi-level microgrid optimization allocation model based on game theory is proposed for the design and construction of microgrids in future distribution networks.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of Mobile Visual Emergency Command Hall Based on Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Accidents and disasters occur frequently worldwide every year, causing relatively serious losses to personnel and property. Emergency command halls are a necessary response mechanism in the event of accidents and disasters. Traditional emergency command methods have problems such as poor convenience, immobility, and high cost. By combining the advantages of strong immersion, good interactivity, portability and mobility of virtual reality technology in the new generation of artificial intelligence, a mobile visualization emergency command hall is developed based on virtual reality technology. It combines existing virtual reality development platforms, helmets, glasses, handles, and other software and hardware to achieve the goals of real-time rescue, mobile visualization command, and ensuring the safety of the life and property of the public.

articleTitle: Used Sailboat Price Prediction: Based on Feature Split and Cascaded Tree Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of the economy, the trading market for used sailboats is becoming increasingly important, and price prediction plays a significant role for buyers and sellers. Inspired by the residual concept, this paper proposes a cascaded tree model price prediction method based on a ‘unorthodox residual’ idea to improve the accuracy of used sailboat price prediction and explain the importance of feature factors on sailboat prices. Bayesian optimization is used by the model to enhance regression fitting and improve performance. Data on used sailboats, including length, displacement, beam, sail area, regional GDP, throughput, and per capita GDP, were collected from websites. After processing the raw data and handling missing values, the features were split into boat features and regional features. The hull features were input into Bayesian-optimized XGBoost for preliminary price prediction, and the output was concatenated with regional features and input into Bayesian-optimized LGBM for final price prediction. After the model performance was evaluated using cross-validation, the MAE has a 8% decrease compared to XGBoost model. The results demonstrate that the Bayesian-optimized cascaded model, combined with the residual concept, outperforms other prediction models.

articleTitle: Predicting Wildfire Severity Classes Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Over the past twenty years, the wildfire crisis in the United States has increased in severity due to a variety of factors, leading to considerable interest in monitoring, analyzing, and predicting wildfires. This paper aims to explore the benefits of machine learning and deep learning to predict wildfire size severity given a variety of environmental conditions. After gathering environmental feature data from four sources and going through a rigorous data preprocessing procedure, a new dataset was created to train the machine learning and deep learning models. The five models used, the Decision Tree, the K-Nearest Neighbors, the Feed-Forward Neural Network, the Recurrent Neural Network, and the Convolutional Neural Network, are trained on a total of ten feature data columns — max daily temperature, minimum daily temperature, average daily temperature, precipitation, fuel moisture content, absolute wind speed, latitude, longitude, Federal Information Processing System(FIPS) coordinate, and date — as input to predict whether or not wildfires are small, medium, or large based on Heinselman's typical fire size classifications. The strongest model, the Decision Tree, achieves high accuracy on all five evaluation metrics used: accuracy, R-squared, precision, recall, and F1. With a model accuracy of 96.55% and an R-squared score of 0.62, the Decision Tree surpasses previous works.

articleTitle: Sailboat Pricing Model Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper qualitatively analyzes the correlation degree between price and feature by Person correlation, and then simplifies the original 14 features into 4 features by PCA, that is, brand service life and service area; Then the paper constructs a stochastic forest regression model to explain the pricing problem of sailboat and finds out the main factors that affect the usage price. Then the data are clustered into three categories according to the economic level and coastal degree and visualized by TSUE algorithm. For each category, the change of the usage price of sailboat is regarded as the dependent variable, and it is concluded that the usage price of sailboat is negatively correlated with GDP per capita and positively correlated with coastal degree.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Network Security Management Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, network security issues are becoming increasingly prominent, and traditional security management methods are no longer able to meet practical needs. Artificial intelligence, as an emerging technology, has powerful data analysis and intelligent decision-making capabilities, showing broad prospects for application in network security management. This article, through the study of key technologies of artificial intelligence in network security management, including network security detection methods based on clone selection fuzzy clustering algorithm and network security trust management model, provides valuable references for improving the level of network security management.

articleTitle: A Radar Field of View Analysis Algorithm Based on Data Cleaning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Ground-to-air missile weapon system is the main equipment for air defense operations. The system can search and track air targets by radar. Terrain undulation can block the propagation of electromagnetic wave, and then affect radar search range and target tracking ability. It is very important to quantify the influence of terrain undulation on radar detection range. In order to ensure the accuracy of the analysis results, it is usually necessary to obtain large amount of DEM data or improve the accuracy of DEM data by up-sampling. In this paper, a radar field analysis algorithm based on data cleaning is proposed, which can efficiently analyze the radar range of a given altitude based on DEM data and provide support for the decision-making of air defense command.

articleTitle: LED Lighting Modern Furniture Decoration System with Computer 3D Modeling Technology: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A monitoring system of LED upholstery lights based on TCP/IP and DMX512 is a common feature. The objective of the paper is to describe a hardware circuit design of the device, and its main software process. The issue here is that lighting system of the LED street light is optimized from the perspectives of the light source of the street light, the control circuit, the optimal tilt angle of the battery components, and the volume size of the battery components and batteries. The review of the existing literature and systems is used as a methodology for the studies. The LED light can be turned on and off and the brightness can be adjusted according to the surrounding environmental conditions. The device can achieve wide dimming range, high power output, and good signal transmission performance. As a result, while ensuring smooth and reliable operation of the system, it reduces the size and cost of the system as much as possible.

articleTitle: Carbon Emission Distribution Prediction Based on BP Neural Network and Probabilistic Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Carbon emissions from the power system have always accounted for a large proportion. The addition of distributed generation can reduce the carbon emission in the power system, but the instability and high wave quality of distributed generation also lead to the instability of carbon emission in the power system. Therefore, a method based on back propagation(BP) neural network and probabilistic flow is proposed to predict the probability of carbon emission distribution. First, a BP neural network model is established to predict the power of distributed photovoltaic (PV) and load, and the carbon emission distribution is predicted according to the PV output and load power combined with carbon emission flow (CEF). Secondly, the cumulant method combined with Cornish-Fisher series expansion method is used to calculate the probability flow of carbon emission and obtain the distribution probability of predicted carbon emission. Finally, in Matlab, the IEEE-13 system and Xiamen factory data are used as examples for simulation. The results verify the accuracy of the predicted carbon emission data and the probability of carbon emission distribution, and relevant carbon emission policies can be adjusted according to the probability distribution of carbon emission distribution.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Network Database System Based on Computer Image Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper presents a remote network database system based on image-visual communication technology. Access to remote databases is realized based on network programming core Windows Sockets and client/server mode. SQL Server.NET, the ActiveX Data Object (ADONET) data provider, implements the connection between the server and the database server. The server translates the client’s instructions into SQL Server statements and sends the returned results to the database server. ADONET can easily maintain and modify the system, which improves the scalability and interoperability of the system. The system can be used in the enterprise network database system.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Bidirectional DC/DC Converter Power Allocation Strategy for Super-capacitor and Battery Hybrid Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to prolong the service life of the battery, a composite power divider is designed, and the key components of the divider, bi-directional DC/DC converter and power distribution strategy are designed, and the main components of the bi-directional DC/DC converter, inductor and filter capacitor, are designed. The power output characteristics of the battery and the supercapacitor during the driving process and the effect of the supercapacitor on the output power of the battery are analyzed by simulating the supercapacitor-battery composite power system model. The experimental results show that the ripple voltage and current of the bidirectional DC/DC converter meet the design requirements, the parameters of inductor and filter capacitor in the bidirectional DC/DC converter are reasonably designed, and the battery can distribute the output power according to the power of the composite power supply. The super capacitor can play a good "peak-shaving" effect on the battery output power, and the super capacitor can assist the battery output power under continuous multiple UDDS conditions, which can protect the battery very well. The performance of the bidirectional DC/DC converter meets the design requirements, and the bidirectional DC/DC converter can realize the power distribution control of the composite power supply.

Author Keywords: Super-capacitor and battery hybrid energy storage

articleTitle: Data-driven multi period operation optimization of active distribution networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Traditional physical models are difficult to model and analyze the uncertainty factors of the power grid, and have weak adaptability to changes in ADN structure and new elements. This paper proposes a data-driven active distribution network operation optimization strategy, which uses data-driven replacement process simulation to directly obtain control strategies from real-time environmental operation information. The implicit internal logic between the optimal operation of the operation scenario and the state of the control equipment can be explored through extreme learning machine, so the mapping relationship between the operation control strategy and distribution network operation scenario can be established. The data-driven reactive power optimization method proposed in this article does not rely on actual system power flow calculations, achieving optimized scheduling of active distribution networks under data-driven conditions, and providing a foundation for control strategies of active distribution networks.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of a Metal Object Detection Method for Wireless Power Transfer Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: There will be eddy current effect while foreign bodies inevitably enter the gap between the transmitting coil and the receiving coil in the process of magnetic field induction radio energy transmission, which could lead to the high temperature and inefficiency of the system or even significant security risks. In this paper, a detection method of metal foreign bodies in the auxiliary coil perpendicular to the energy coil is designed. The magnetic coupling mechanism model based on MAXWELL software was built to obtain parameters of the magnetic coupling mechanism by simulation. On this basis, the Simulink circuit simulation model of radio energy transmission system is established, and its energy transmission characteristics are analyzed. Based on the designed radio energy transmission system, a detection coil perpendicular to the energy coil was designed, and its MAXWELL 3D simulation model was established to obtain its coupling characteristics. The experimental prototype is built and the metal foreign body detection experiment is conducted. The results of experiment are consistent with that of the simulation, which verifies that the vertical detection coil proposed in this paper is a feasible method for the detection of metal foreign bodies in the radio energy transmission system.

articleTitle: Research on the Whole Process Information System of Cold Chain Supply in Artificial Intelligence Logistics Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Combining RFID technology and GPRS communication technology to develop a set of real-time monitoring and control system suitable for cold chain logistics. This system uses STM32F103 as the control chip of the vehicle terminal. The vehicle-mounted terminal uses GPRS technology to transmit data to a remote server, while the management terminal uses SOAP technology to process data on the server so as to achieve the purpose of real-time monitoring of the refrigerated transportation process. The accurate location of objects in the supply chain is realized by using the adaptive weight and characteristic quantity of the Bhattacharya coefficient. The experiment proves that the developed system can realize the real-time monitoring of each link in the cold chain logistics, and can well realize the information transmission and identification of each link.

articleTitle: Application of Coleoptera Elytra for Protection of Winged Drones
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Small UAVs are used in a multitude of contexts, including surveillance or transportation of goods. Fixed winged drones in certain environments risk damage to flight components, but no well-utilized solution has been created. Multirotor copters can use enveloping cages but a solution for winged drones is more complex. The purpose of this research is to determine the viability of using Coleoptera elytra as an inspiration for a protection mechanism. The general framework for conducting this research centered around fabricating numerous prototypes, improving on the shortcomings of the previous ones. Early prototypes centered more on individual mechanisms while later prototypes focused on integrating all components. Simulations and tests were conducted on each prototype to determine durability and flight characteristics. The elytra in most tests even with low impact-tolerance plastics showed effective protection capabilities. However, the unoptimized aerodynamic qualities of wing surfaces and the body and unoptimized weight prevented the drone from becoming airborne. This research shows promise in using beetle elytra as an inspiration for protection of winged drones. At a smaller scale, elytra are a viable option, but needs to be optimized more in terms of materials usage and shape and tested further with larger scale prototypes.

articleTitle: Research on Artificial Intelligence Digital System Based on GPT Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A GPT deep neural network algorithm with good function and strong practicability is proposed. First, complete the overall system framework and system database design. Through the design of data processing module and recommendation algorithm module, the main functional modules of the system are designed and implemented. Deep residual learning neural network is used to continuously train samples to improve the accuracy of product design judgment. Finally, the GPT based deep neural network intelligent product development decision method is tested and simulated to verify the correctness and feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Surface Defect Detection in Submersible Pump Impellers Based on the Novel MXNet Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In industrial production, surface defects of submersible pump impellers often have a significant impact on equipment performance and lifespan. However, the current defect detection is mainly performed manually, which is time-consuming, inefficient, and prone to human errors. Furthermore, the existing mainstream automatic detection methods have limitations, such as limited accuracy, complexity of the model, and low generalization, which make them difficult to promote widely. Therefore, an automated technology that can improve the efficiency and accuracy of the detection process is urgently needed. This study aims to develop an automatic defect detection method based on a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) called MXNet to ensure superior product quality and reduce manual labor. This model, derived from the Xception architecture, has been specifically tailored for the task with custom convolutional and fully connected layers for precise classification, data augmentation techniques and an incorporated attention module to highlight vital regions in input images, coupled with the utilization of binary cross-entropy loss and custom callback functions, and a strategy for dynamically adjusting the learning rate. To demonstrate the superiority of this model, we compared it with four mainstream defect detection models. Experimental results show that the average accuracy and average recall rate of MXNet on the validation set reached 99.23% and 98.95% respectively, outperforming the comparative models in all performance indicators with shorter runtime and fewer parameters. This suggests that MXNet can not only achieve high-accuracy defect detection but also has high practicality, and is expected to have broad application potential in future in-dustrial production practices.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Customer Service System for Power Industry Based on Semantic Understanding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of the electric power industry and the growth of user demands, it has become an important task to improve the efficiency and quality of the electric power business customer service system. This paper proposes an intelligent customer service system for electric power business based on semantic understanding, which aims to use natural language processing and artificial intelligence technology to understand user intentions and semantics, and provide intelligent service support. The system is trained by deep learning and natural language processing technology to accurately identify users' problems or needs, provide corresponding answers or suggestions according to the preset knowledge base and business rules, and give timely feedback to users. Through the research of this paper, we provide an intelligent and personalized customer service solution for the power business, and look forward to the future development direction and improvement potential of this field.

articleTitle: Research and application of improved Faster R-CNN model for pest identification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low recognition accuracy of traditional pest detection methods in complex environments, this paper introduces dense convolutional network (DenseNet) and scale-transfer module technology into the Faster R-CNN model to optimize the structure of the Faster R-CNN model and improve the accuracy of the Faster R-CNN model in identifying pests. First, DenseNet169 and scale-transfer module technology are used to extract the feature map of pest image, and then the target bounding boxes is generated through Region Proposal Networks (RPN) network to obtain accurate pest feature information, and then the feature information in the target bounding boxes is input into the full connection layer to identify the target type. This experiment uses 600 pictures for training. Experimental results show that the improved model improves the recognition accuracy of the Faster R-CNN model, and the recognition accuracy reaches 93.4%, providing a new idea and method for pest identification. The improved model is applied to the early warning cloud platform for pest identification and analysis to identify agricultural and forestry pests. The model has an accuracy rate of over 90% for the identification of large individual pests, and has achieved relatively good application effects.

articleTitle: Research on the Everity Model of Grid Risk Assessment Based on Effect Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The current methods for grid risk assessment have limitations as they do not sufficiently consider the importance of different devices and loads, as well as the impact of secondary system performance. There is a need to introduce more accurate evaluation models and methods to enhance the accuracy and reliability of the assessments. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved method for assessing static safety risks in power grids based on the effect theory. The method takes the importance of different primary devices, loads, and the performance of the secondary system on the assessment results into account. Firstly, the influences of three types of devices, including hidden faults in relay protection, on risk assessment are analyzed, and corresponding risk assessment models are established. Next, an importance factor is introduced into the severity model based on the theory of effects to quantify the importance of different parts of the system, and an improved method for evaluating risk indicators is proposed. Finally, the improved method is applied to assess the risks in the IEEE-RTS79 test system, and the results validate the effectiveness of the proposed model and method in identifying weak points in power systems. The research findings demonstrate that the proposed method is more aligned with real-world system conditions compared to traditional risk assessment methods, providing valuable references for power system operation, maintenance, and risk control.

articleTitle: A Study on the Development of Wordle Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper builds a Wordle Word Difficulty Assessment Model based on Machine Learning which achieves input 5-letter English words, can output the predicted the percentage of different tries times on the specified date, and the word difficulty level (difficult, average or easy). First, the Regressor Chain is applied to correlate a set of independent variables (percentage of different tries) and dependent variables (frequency of each letter, word frequency, lexical properties, number of common letter combinations, number of repeated letters, date) in a certain order. Then, based on the Decision Tree, build Wordle Word n-tries percentage Prediction Model. The final implementation: input 5-letter word, output n tries percentage. Second, Using the optimized KNN clustering algorithm with percentage of n tries as a variable, three difficulty levels -"difficult", "medium" and "average" were classified. Next, the KNN Regression Model was optimized using the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to build Wordle Word Difficulty Assessment Model. This model can classify the difficulty level of any 5-letter English word. By this model, it can also provide a solution to better enhance the user experience and increase the popularity of the game. In a way, this scientific analysis of Wordle historical data, which can better guide the future innovation and ideas of this popular game.

articleTitle: Segment anything model for subgrade distress detection with GPR
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The detection of distresses with ground-penetrating radar (GPR) images is a highly challenging task due to their complex structure, blurred boundaries, and varying scales. The Segment Anything Model (SAM) has demonstrated impressive performance in natural image segmentation tasks with its zero-shot segmentation capability and high efficiency, which effectively reduces annotation time. However, the applicability of SAM for GPR image analysis remains till now. To this end, we construct a GPR image dataset comprising 395 samples with segmention, which are jointly confirmed and annotated by multiple domain experts. We comprehensively evaluate the performance of various mainstream deep learning image segmentation models and different SAM models on this dataset, and analyze the results in detail. Our experiments confirm that SAM's performance in detecting underground radar distresses is limited or even completely inadequate. These findings demonstrate that SAM's current zero-shot segmentation capability is insufficient for direct application in subgrade distress with GPR data.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Network Mass Event Preplanning Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Effective management of 5G resources requires careful arranging of working numerology lists and range conveyance as per the necessities of the ongoing traffic. To lessen signal above, any reconfigurations made to oblige the ongoing traffic design should be kept to a base. This paper proposes the pre-arranging of numerology profiles as a solution for this issue and fosters a numerical improvement model for their pre-arranging. By looking at the prerequisites and limitations that are much of the time present in a specific remote correspondence climate, it is expected to make numerology profiles. One of the profiles will then, at that point, be utilized in accordance with the ongoing clients and traffic design. The model empowers the enhancement of blended numerologies in future 5G organizations under any remote correspondence situation, with explicit assistance necessities and weaknesses, and under any traffic situation. By involving attainable rate execution as one of the key qualities, we look at the blended numerology and small scale space methods in different settings. We employ Cyclic Prefix-Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (CP-OFDM) as a suitable benchmark and show that Universal Filtered Multicarrier (UFMC) outperforms CP-OFDM. When compared to a non-optimized technique, the proposed optimisation model can achieve satisfaction levels of 60–100% while reducing the overall number of numerology indexes in use.

articleTitle: Exploration on Artificial Intelligence Technology in Power System State Estimation, Monitoring and Early Warning System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A modern dispatch center requires the ability to quickly, accurately, and comprehensively grasp the actual operation status of the power grid, predict and analyze the operating trend of the system, take corresponding measures to address problems that arise during operation, and provide decision-making for the next step of operation to ensure the safe and economic operation of the power grid. Therefore, developing new microcomputer monitoring and analysis methods has become an urgent task for the power grid dispatch department. The purpose of this article is to study the monitoring and warning system for power system state estimation based on artificial intelligence technology. In this design, the main technologies used include the Java platform, Document Object Model technology, Hibernate persistence technology, etc. On this basis, the data communication and analysis function module, state estimation and early warning monitoring module, and data viewing function were designed, and the entire monitoring system architecture was ultimately implemented. After the design was completed, the system testing was completed using black box as the main testing method. The test structure showed that the upgraded and optimized OPEN 3000 overcame the drawbacks of the original operation monitoring, and eliminated all functional bugs to 0, achieving its set concept.

articleTitle: The optimization study of energy conversion efficiency of supercapacitor energy storage device based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As a power source with special properties between traditional capacitors and batteries, supercapacitors play a role in suppressing power fluctuations in the power grid, energy saving, and consumption reduction while storing energy. Supercapacitor energy storage system has strong nonlinear characteristics, and circuit electrical parameters have uncertainty, affecting the improvement of conversion efficiency and affecting the energy-saving effect of energy storage devices. By optimizing the control strategy of the supercapacitor energy storage device, the energy utilization rate of the energy storage device can be effectively improved. To this end, this paper investigates an intelligent optimization control strategy for supercapacitor energy storage devices, realizes adaptive adjustment of the control parameters of the energy storage device, and thus keeps the dynamic and steady-state performance of the supercapacitor energy storage device and the energy conversion efficiency in an optimal state at all times.

articleTitle: Research on multi-connection network selection algorithm based on SACM-FA
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The proposed algorithm in this paper is called the Step-Adaptive Firefly Algorithm (SAFA), which is based on the Cubic Chaotic Mapping and SACM-FA. This algorithm combines the firefly algorithm with chaotic optimization theory. It utilizes chaotic sequences to randomly generate initial positions for fireflies, ensuring the randomness of initial individuals. It also introduces an adaptive search step to enhance the diversity of the population. The algorithm performs optimization operations while satisfying the QoS guarantees of users and obtains the optimal allocation of wireless resources through multiple iterations. The SACM-FA algorithm optimizes bandwidth allocation and power control problems in the uplink environment of ELWA (Enhanced Land Mobile Wireless Access) systems with multiple coexisting service types. It improves user utility and satisfaction. The simulation results demonstrate that the SACM-FA algorithm can improve the throughput of wireless systems and effectively enhance network performance in ELWA systems with multiple coexisting service types. Compared to traditional network selection algorithms, the improved algorithm can effectively balance network load and significantly improve user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Application and Research Based on RFID Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In our country, the modernization degree of the Internet of Things can already be applied in various aspects and systems of living. Internet of Things technology is an important technical support for the construction of modern anti-theft interactive system. This paper introduces the application of RFID (Radio Frequency I-dentification, and radio frequency identification, commonly known as electronic tag) technology in anti-theft system. Because RFID can read a large number of unique characteristics, in the field of anti-theft can play a huge advantage. This paper proposes the anti-theft interactive system, which is based on RFID architecture. The design principle of the system is to connect the RFID system with the front-end customer operating platform and the back-end large database system through 5G technology and RFID technology middleware. And the RFID anti-theft technology is extended to small and medium-sized items, more practical for common objects to provide anti-theft solutions, can play a role in tracking and supervision.

articleTitle: Research on the Technology of Generating Parametric Continuous Images of Comic Strip in Virtual Reality Environment Based on Machine Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This thesis explores the feasibility of parametric continuity image generation for comic strips by combining virtual reality technology with machine learning algorithms. In order to promote the development and inheritance of comic strips, we propose to establish an intelligent database of continuous virtual images of comic strips, and use virtual reality technology to apply and experience real users. At the same time, the flexibility and adaptability of machine learning algorithms enable them to be deployed in the analysis, classification and discovery of comic strips by integrating differentiation and acquisition biometric methods. Through the parametric continuous image generated based on machine learning algorithm, we can adjust different parameter settings to achieve the generation of different styles and effects to meet the personalized needs of users. This study holds that the combination of virtual reality and machine learning provides an indispensable path for the modern application of excellent traditional culture, so as to protect and inherit the treasures of Chinese comic strips. Keywords: machine algorithms, Virtual reality, computer vision, parameterization, continuous images.

articleTitle: Intelligent detection and recognition of pulley paying-off defects based on improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Detection and identification of conductor defects during tension pay-off can ensure the construction quality of transmission line erection and avoid leaving hidden dangers, which is of great significance for ensuring the safe and reliable operation of the power grid. An improved YOLOv5 algorithm is proposed for the detection of typical conductor defects in pulley pay-off, aiming at the identification of conductor defects with small targets and similar defect characteristics. Firstly, a CA attention module is added to the Backbone end of the original algorithm to emphasize target information, while the FPN+PAN structure of the Neck portion of the original algorithm is changed to a BiFPN structure to improve the efficiency of multi-scale feature fusion. Finally, the CIOU loss function in the original algorithm is changed to an EIOU loss function to improve convergence speed and detection accuracy. Use the images taken in a pulley setting out project to conduct model training and extract some images for algorithm effect verification. The final experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can quickly and accurately detect multiple types of defects in the wire, and its average detection accuracy is superior to the detection results of current multiple target detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Metal Image Defect Recognition Based on CLIP and Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The classification of metal defect image plays a very important role in actual industrial production. Most of the previous work has used fully supervised models for classification, and these methods require a large number of labeled samples. However, it is difficult to collect a large number of specific images, and labeling images is expensive and time consuming. In this paper, a method of metal defect image classification based on CLIP model is proposed. The method does not need training set, but only needs pre-training test set to test directly. During the test phase the GEDT module and the OPT module were used. The GEDT module makes full use of the relevant information between features. OPT uses Transductive manner to achieve the final classification. Experiments are carried out on a proposed dataset. The results show that this method is significantly better than other existing methods on one-shot and five-shot. On the common setting, the method achieves an average improvement of 8. 25% and 12. 51% on one shot and five shot over the next best method. On cross-domain Settings, the method achieves an average improvement of 11% and 9% on one-shot and five-shot over the next best method.

articleTitle: Application and Improvement of LSTM in Power System Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In previous power system predictions, the accuracy of predicting extreme electricity consumption peaks was often insufficient. This study aims to explore the differences in power data prediction among three models: BiLSTM, BiLSTM with self-attention mechanism, and self-attention BiLSTM optimized by WOA. By analyzing and predicting three years of continuous power data, this paper compares the prediction accuracy and stability of these three models and provides a detailed comparison and evaluation of their performance. The BiLSTM model with the self-attention mechanism performs better in terms of prediction accuracy and stability in power data prediction, according to experimental findings. This model can better capture the long-term dependency relationship of time series data and automatically adjust attention, thus predicting future power loads more accurately. In addition, this study found that the self-attention BiLSTM model optimized by WOA can further improve prediction accuracy and stability, and its performance is better than that of traditional BiLSTM models. The experimental findings of this study demonstrate that the WOA optimization and self-attention mechanism play a significant role in enhancing the performance of BiLSTM models in power data prediction, and can increase the accuracy to over 80%. These results can provide reference for future deep learning-based power load prediction and valuable guidance for other time series prediction tasks.

articleTitle: A Clustering Algorithm for Health Care Big Data Governance System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to optimize the cause of people's health and improve the quality of people's healthcare. Aiming at the current problem of health care big data governance, the author designs a medical information system information security detection method supported by improved K-means clustering algorithm, by conducting research and understanding more than 12 million pieces of health and medical big data from more than 10 medical institutions in S city, A province, and analyzing the diversity, multi-source, and heterogeneity of these data, consolidate and summarize into the same database, make preliminary preparations for data governance, establish a unified data storage mode, and convert wrong data, according to the unified encoding and matching of various heterogeneous data optimization standards, the data structure is stored in the Hive database, after simulation experiments, it is shown that: The detection method designed by the author generates a delay of around 0.1 seconds, which is compared to the other two detection methods, the security detection method designed by the author generates a shorter delay time, and the actual detection process requires the shortest detection time. Based on the above experimental results, it can be concluded that the detection method designed by the author has the highest actual detection rate, the lowest false alarm rate value, and the least actual detection delay time, making it suitable for use in the actual detection process. It has realized the special feature engineering of medical big data, solved the integration and fusion of multi-source heterogeneous data, improved the efficiency of information matching, and realized the multi regional data governance project of medical data quality management.

articleTitle: Deep Koopman-VAE Based Process Monitoring for Industrial Biosystems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Industrial biosystem (IBS) applies biological principles and technologies to the industrial sector, encompassing bioreactors, fermenters, and biosensors. It is extensively employed in the pharmaceutical, food, and chemical industries. Ensuring the stability of IBS is crucial to maintaining production quality, and thus, real-time and accurate monitoring is necessary. Generally, monitoring involves detecting changes in the quantity of molecules to determine whether the system is relatively stable. However, due to the complexity, non-linearity and remarkable intrinsic uncertainties of IBS, process monitoring can be challenging. To tackle this issue, we propose an innovative, entirely data-driven detecting and monitoring technology that combines Koopman theory and deep neural networks to effectively analyze the nonlinear dynamical system. We use the spectral decomposition of the Koopman operator, often through Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD), for state prediction. Additionally, we employ a neural network to identify nonlinear observation basis functions. The optimal residual sequence is analyzed using probability graphs to enable real-time monitoring. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated through testing on two canonical gene expression systems, characterized by intrinsic stochastic dynamics, providing a unique benchmark for comparing performance across diverse process monitoring algorithms, thereby extending the contributions of this paper.

articleTitle: Link prediction of directed knowledge network based on patent co-citation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, the link prediction for knowledge network is mainly based on literature data, and rarely considers patent data, leading to the omission of key information and other problems. Therefore, this paper explores the method of link prediction for knowledge network based on patent co-citation. By comparing the collection of e-commerce patent data from different patent databases, 50 groups of co-citation data were selected to establish a co-citation network and its eigenvalues were visualized. Four machine learning methods, random forest, Knn, XGBoost and support vector machine, were used to predict the link of the network. AUC means are used to compare their performance on Adamic/Adar(AA) values and Common Neighbours(CN) values. The results show that XGBoost algorithm has the best performance, and the average AUC of AA and CN values are 0.804 and 0.791, respectively. Random forest is second; KNN algorithm and support vector machine (SVM) algorithm are unstable on this data set.

articleTitle: GDEMO-HAT: Knowledge-guided Medical Text Classification Using Heterogeneous Graph-based Dependency Modeling with Hierarchical Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The medical texts contain rich information about the health status of patients, including personal demographic details, examination items, diagnostic narratives, and corresponding outcomes. There is often an underlying dependency between a patient and multiple medical texts. Such dependency has a substantial influence on the accuracy and reliability of the patient's comprehensive diagnostic outcomes, thus necessitating the modeling of dependency. Most of the existing studies on medical text classification focused only on textual content and often overlooked the inherent dependency between the patient and medical texts, leading to the loss of relevant contextual information. To address the above problems, we propose an approach for medical text classification using heterogeneous Graph-based DEpendency MOdeling with Hierarchical ATtention (GDEMO-HAT), which accounts for patient-notes dependency and retains the contextual information. We model the dependencies between the patients and their medical texts via heterogeneous graphs. To facilitate medical text mining, we incorporate domain knowledge into the construction of a Patient-Notes-Physician (PNP) graph. Based on the constructed PNP graph, we introduce the hierarchical attention mechanism for classification that assigns different levels of importance to nodes based on distinct semantic contexts and thereby effectively captures the intricate interdependencies among these nodes. The representations of dependencies are integrated at the semantic level, thereby enabling a more comprehensive understanding of textual data.
