To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach, we conduct a classification task of the diagnosis of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases based on medical text. The classification accuracy rate achieves 94%, which is significantly higher than the performances of the other compared models, such as Bert.

articleTitle: Aerodynamic analysis and piloted flight simulation of a single-rotor helicopter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the aerodynamic modeling and simulation system development of single-rotor helicopters. The helicopter aerodynamic model mainly adopts the idea of object-oriented and component modeling to establish the main rotor aerodynamic model. The aerodynamic modeling method of the propeller and Bailey theory are used a simplified aerodynamic model of the tail propeller. The data interpolation method is mainly used for the aerodynamic modeling of the fuselage. With the open source OSG osgEarth as the rendering engine, we developed a large-scale flight simulation terrain spanning 5 degrees of latitude and longitude with accurate geographic information. In terms of 3D modeling, it mainly studies 3D modeling and material mapping of aircraft, the dynamic blur of high-speed rotors, and terrain. It mainly looks at data preparation, processing, special effects, and rendering based on osgEarth terrain. With the dynamic model as the background support, OSG and osgEarth conduct flight simulation visual rendering and establish a single-rotor helicopter flight simulation system with dynamic output meeting the flight mechanics tool.

articleTitle: Measures to Reduce the Risk of Public Opinion of Power Customers Based on Computer Network Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper introduces measures and methods for using computer network monitoring to reduce the risk of public opinion of power customers. By combing through 28 records of public opinion on power supply services received and handled promptly by State Grid Corporation of Liaoning Province in the fourth quarter of 2021, the paper finds that 9 reasons for the risk of public opinion of power customers are insufficient active service by the personnel, inadequate publicity by customer service personnel, lack of training by service personnel, few early warning reports by personnel, lack of business dedicated handling personnel, lack of clear system standards, lack of accurate ledgers, lack of system monitoring and the long warning time in manual mode. It also found 7 measures to use computer networks to carry out proactive services, apply computer networks to strengthen publicity, use online learning platforms to strengthen customer service personnel training, use computer networks to strengthen early warning analysis, establish a sound public opinion management system, improve the work plan for early warning of service public opinion and major service events based on computer networks, and establish a power supply service public opinion ledger. Its field application substantially reduces the risk of public opinion of power customers.

articleTitle: Application of LSTM-CNN model to forecast the rise and fall of CSI 300
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Stock price prediction has always been a focal issue in the field of quantitative finance. By analyzing historical data related to stock prices, researchers attempt to infer the patterns of stock price changes in order to achieve excess returns. However, due to the influence of multiple factors, traditional linear forecasting models often struggle to provide effective predictions. In recent years, non-linear predictive models using machine learning and deep learning methods have been widely used in quantitative investment. Compared to linear models, these models possess stronger predictive performance, learning ability, and adaptability. This paper conducts an empirical analysis from the perspectives of individual models (CNN model, LSTM model) and the combined CNN+LSTM model. It aims to predict the change of the stocks in the CSI 300 Index and compares the accuracy of their predictions. The results demonstrate that the combined CNN+LSTM model outperforms the individual models in predicting the directional movements of stocks in the CSI 300 Index.

articleTitle: Research on single-dual power supply scheme based on Prim greedy algorithm planning and reliability analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Distribution security and stability are very important for customers' daily electricity consumption. In this paper, the method of planning the main supply line of 10kV distribution network with 100 customer transformers and 2 power substations by using one-dimensional linear regression is presented for single-supply and dual-supply scenarios, and the method of planning the branch lines of distribution network with 50 customer transformers by using P rim’s greedy algorithm is introduced. The main power supply line of two power sources is connected with a liaison line for a given total investment or a given lower reliability limit, and the main power supply line structure in the form of a double-loop network can significantly improve the reliability of customer transformers.

articleTitle: CNN and TOPSIS Based Wordle Development Study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Recently, an anagram game called Wordle has become popular. To better understand the game’s current status and provide constructive suggestions for its next development, this paper examines both the number of results classification and the word difficulty of the game based on relevant public data on the Internet. To begin with, the distribution of seven attempts (from 1 to X, where X indicates greater than or equal to 7, i.e., failed challenge) as the output, and finally obtains a model that can predict the percentage distribution of attempts for any five-word word. The average deviation of the model is 6.0450%. Taking EERIE as an example, after extracting the features and inputting them into the network, we obtained its percentages of attempts from 1 to X as follows: 4%, 7%,11%,14%, 18%, 21%, and 25%, respectively. ton order to build a classification model based on word difficulty, the 12 attributes of words were subjectively classified into two categories: memorability, and complexity. The TOPSIS method was adopted to find the weights of the 12 indicators. The scores of word difficulty were calculated separately from the two dimensions (i.e., memorability and complexity). Further, based on the distribution of words in the two-dimensional plane, the words were divided into four categories according to their difficulty: O, C, M, and H, using their mean values as the boundary.

articleTitle: Wood defect detection based on YOLOV5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the process of wood processing, improving the detection accuracy of wood defects is of great significance to improve the safety and utilization rate of wood use. At present, convolutional neural network is mainly used to detect wood, but it has shortcomings such as inaccurate detection of small targets, weak ability to capture global feature information and low detection efficiency, which leads to the occurrence of wrong detection and missing detection in the detection process. In response to the above problems. In this paper, based on the YOLOV5 network structure, a small target detection network module is introduced to solve the problem of inaccurate detection of small targets, ensure that fine-grained information is not lost, and make the feature fusion mode simple and effective. Then, a high-precision detection network module is introduced to realize the combination of convolutional neural network structure and transformer structure to solve the problem of weak ability of the original network to capture global feature information.In this paper, CBAM attention mechanism is introduced to reduce and suppress the influence of similar interference features on network detection, so that the network can distinguish the defect features correctly. In addition, the lightweight network structure of YOLOV5S guarantees real-time monitoring performance. The experimental results show that compared with the original network, the average detection accuracy of the improved algorithm is increased by 6.623%, which can effectively improve the detection accuracy of network structure and improve the detection ability of small target defects.

articleTitle: KG-IGNN: Knowledge Guided Inductive Graph Neural Network for Detecting Misinformation from Social Media
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Since the emergence of social media, people have been affected by the misinformation from social media. In some areas of health, the lack of expertise in their respective fields leads to a weak ability to distinguish between genuine and spurious information. Detecting misinformation without professional knowledge continues to be an ongoing obstacle. To solve this problem, we design a Knowledge Guided Inductive Graph Neural Network (KG-IGNN) for detecting health misinformation on social media, which utilizes the professional information from a knowledge graph to enrich the semantic features of social media text. The method optimizes the feature representation by using the neighbor nodes of the article with an inductive graph neural network. We use a real-world dataset to demonstrate the effectiveness of our model. Experimental results show that KG-IGNN achieves significant improvement compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation of Photovoltaic Cell Model Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the process of photovoltaic system converting solar energy into electric energy, the PV model is established. The parameters of the model have a large impact on the conversion performance and efficiency. For the purpose of accurate identification of circuit model parameters, an improved optimization algorithm based on particle swarm optimization is adopted, which combines the optimization strategy and hybrid algorithm proposed in recent years, It makes up for the fact that traditional particle swarm algorithms tend to be stuck in local optimal solutions and search efficiency decreases in multi-dimension. such as easy to fall into the local optimal solution and the decline of search efficiency in multi-dimensional. The improved algorithm is applied to the parameter identification of PV models with a single diode, and the accuracy of the algorithm is verified. The original particle swarm optimization algorithm and the optimization algorithm are simulated and the difference between the simulation data and the experimental data is calculated. The experiment shows that the Root-mean-square deviation (RMSE) of the optimized algorithm is far less than that of the original Particle swarm optimization algorithm, the measurement results of current and voltage are closer to the true values, and the parameter identification is more accurate. Satisfied the needs of practical applications.

articleTitle: Java-based Development of a Vehicle Speed Recommendation Model for Assisted Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of assisted driving technology, it has become especially critical to solve the problem of difficulty in determining the speed of assisted driving vehicles at intersections. In this paper, we propose a speed recommendation model based on multi-factor considerations, aiming to provide accurate speed recommendations for assisted driving vehicles to help them pass through intersections quickly and smoothly. The speed recommendation model integrates several key factors, including intersection type, traffic flow, and weather conditions. By combining and evaluating the effects of these factors, the model can determine the appropriate vehicle speed to ensure safe and efficient driving at the intersection. To verify the effectiveness of the model, we conducted simulation experiments using Java back-end development project and validated the model using simulated traffic data. The experimental results show that the speed suggestion model is able to provide accurate speed suggestions for assisted driving vehicles in different types of intersection scenarios, solving the problem of difficulty in determining vehicle speed at intersections. At the same time, the model has the potential to adapt and optimize, and can flexibly adjust the speed recommendations under different road conditions and traffic situations to meet the actual driving requirements. This has a positive impact on improving road safety and promoting the popularity of assisted driving technology.

articleTitle: Incorporating text and emoticon features in sarcasm and irony detection: A deep learning-based approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Emotions play a crucial role in social media interactions, and sarcasm and irony often convey complex emotions that can be challenging to detect accurately. This study focuses on automating the recognition of sarcasm and irony in Chinese through various computational methods using machine learning algorithms. This study utilizes both text and emoticon/emoji feature to improve detection accuracy. The study employs a combination of linguistic rules, word embeddings, and neural network models for detecting irony in Chinese microblog comments. The results highlight the advantages of deep learning techniques and pre-trained word embeddings in enhancing the accuracy of irony detection. Furthermore, the study demonstrates the viability of the proposed models by focusing on microblog posts related to social events. These contextualized experiments show promising results and pave the way for future studies to explore other domains and data sources. Overall, this study has made significant contributions to the field of irony recognition research and laid the groundwork for more complex models in the future, with practical implications for enhancing sentiment analysis in various fields.

articleTitle: Analysis and research of retail customer consumption behavior based on support vector machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, with rapid economic development, customers' consumption levels have significantly increased and surpassed previous levels. This has placed enormous pressure on enterprise customer relationship management systems, especially for large-scale retail businesses. Faced with expanding data resources and massive volumes of static customer information and dynamic transactional data, traditional database technologies are no longer capable of meeting the analytical needs of modern requirements. Discovering the rules, relationships, and valuable insights hidden within vast amounts of data has become a focal point and challenge for businesses' future research. With the continuous improvement and introduction of data mining methods such as Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Decision Trees, they can provide certain assistance in this regard. This article introduces Support Vector Machines and applies them to the analysis and research of customer consumption behavior in the retail industry. Firstly, a Support Vector Machine-based model, known as the DCSS model, is proposed and constructed for analyzing customer consumption behavior. The model utilizes a cloud-like processing mapping mechanism and non-deterministic reasoning, combined with the probability distribution function of SVMDT, to apply an improved Sequential Minimal Optimization (SMO) algorithm for generating classification results on customer consumption data. Subsequently, through the analysis and research of instances, the SMO algorithm based on the DCSS model is compared with other algorithms. The results demonstrate that the efficiency and accuracy of the algorithm in this article are relatively high, making it suitable for application in customer classification scenarios in the retail industry.

articleTitle: Blockchain Encryption Algorithm Based on Aggregated Signature
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As the concept of blockchain continues to the hype, an increasing number of industries join the ranks of using blockchain, which also leads to privacy leaks becoming a potential hidden danger. Therefore, more secure and private algorithms should be adopted to protect the privacy of users. The issue of network security will be placed at a strategic level. For this reason, a blockchain-based aggregation signature algorithm is proposed. Compared with other signature algorithms, this algorithm reduces the computational overhead in transaction and verification and does not require storage. No need to forget every time you use it, can the user verify by using the public key, which can ensure the fairness and privacy of the user's use. The final results show that the algorithm not only greatly saves the overhead but also improves the communication efficiency between nodes. The most important thing is to solve the problem of personal privacy leakage that users have been worried about. The algorithm can solve the problem of transaction privacy in the blockchain. It can trace the token to each account corresponding to each person, and with the aggregation encryption algorithm, each transaction of each user can achieve the purpose of mixed currency transaction.

articleTitle: Research on individual-based standardization model of energy economy coupling system
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to better adapt to the new form of complex power energy system, the corresponding modeling and simulation methods should be able to reflect various changes in the process of energy system transformation. Based on the description of diverse individuals and complex scenarios in the complex power energy system, this chapter carries out the individual-based standardized model research. Based on the theory of simulation modeling and object-oriented thought, the description of standard model is realized by defining the elements and interfaces of individual-based model. The model can be compatible with the main simulation types and concepts of simulation elements on the premise of detailed and non-redundant description of research objects.

articleTitle: Multi-view fusion adaptive key view enhancement based on structural similarity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to enhance or highlight key perspectives while maintaining other perspectives to achieve efficient multi-view fusion, a new view strategy is proposed. Firstly, an adaptive parameterless inverse optimization strategy is designed to obtain the analytical solution of the model and accelerate the convergence of the model. Secondly, based on the embedded graph optimization strategy and multi-view fusion adaptive learning algorithm, the model obtains a unified structural similarity. Finally, based on structural similarity and key view enhancement, an adaptive multi-view fusion method is proposed. The results show that the AMF method can effectively integrate multiple views through structural similarity and key view enhancement, and is superior to other methods in most cases. Among them, the AMF method has the most significant enhancement ability for the recognition of boldface characters, followed by underline.

articleTitle: Enhancing Autonomous Driving with Grounded-Segment Anything Model: Limitations and Mitigations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Recent advancements have been observed in the domains of object detection and semantic segmentation, notably with the introduction of the Grounding DINO and Segment Anything Model (SAM). In the realm of autonomous driving, an effective model is crucial to accurately perceive the road environment, thus warranting the exploration of these innovative models. The Grounded-SAM, known as Grounded Segment Anything Model, is an advanced machine learning model that has been designed for object detection and semantic segmentation. This feature makes it an invaluable tool in domains like autonomous driving, where accurate real-time object detection and understanding of the driving environment are critical for safe and efficient operation. In this paper, we first work on exploring limitations of Grounded-SAM in autonomous driving, where we identified its weakness in differentiating objects in fine-grained tasks. To mitigate this limitation, we leverage zero-shot and pre-trained classifiers to perform traffic signs and vehicles detection to enhance the precision of Grounded-SAM in autonomous driving.

articleTitle: CloneBAS: A Code Clone Detection Method Based on Abstract Syntax Tree and Simhash
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Code clone, which is one of the common “code smells”, is the duplicate code that exists in the source code. In this paper, we present CloneBAS, a code clone detection method based on Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) and Simhash. First, code block is considered as the detection granularity. Second, a fixed-length fingerprint with the AST of each code block is generated. As a result, multi-type clone detection capabilities are achieved. Third, based on the Hamming distance restriction, clone fingerprint groups and their corresponding clone code block groups are attained. Source codes from four projects are selected as subjects and the clone detectors of CCFinderSW and Deckard are compared with CloneBAS in our experiments. In terms of clone quality, the lowest accuracy of over 86% is achieved, which is better than the highest accuracy of 74% of the two comparators. In terms of clone quantity, Deckard is outperformed by CloneBAS in three projects.

articleTitle: Rolling bearing fault classification method based on data simulation collaborative drive and transfer learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The simulation data is complete, but the measured data is unbalanced or missing, which makes it difficult to apply the data-driven model. In addition, there are many adjustable hyperparameters and artificially adjusted random factors in the data-driven model, which leads to the final result of the model. Insufficient precision. Therefore, this paper proposes a rolling bearing fault image recognition method based on hyperparameter optimization and transfer learning.First, build a simulation model to generate some samples, and then screen the network through noise resistance, select a network with strong robustness, and then input the network with strong noise resistance with simulation data. In this paper, AlexNet depth volume is selected. A neural network is integrated and the model is tuned through hyperparameter optimization techniques. Finally, this paper constructs a model by migrating the evaluation model from the simulation domain to the measured data domain through feature projection to make up for the scarcity of samples. It is verified by experiments that the actual measurement data of rolling bearing faults from Case Western Reserve University is used, and the overall accuracy of the model is improved by means of the hyperparameter optimization method. In addition, this paper also uses transfer learning and feature projection methods to solve the problem of scarcity of measured fault samples, and has a good transfer effect and high accuracy after transfer. The above results have verified the improvement effect and good noise immunity of the above method.

articleTitle: Multi-Task Learning-based Research on the Problem of Conversational Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Emotion Recognition in Conversations (ERC) can determine the emotion state of a conversation by analyzing text or speech information in the conversations, which has led to its widespread interest. Many approaches also exist dedicated to contextual understanding through deep learning. The paper proposes the novel Multi-Task Learning Network for Emotion Recognition in Conversations (DialogueMTLN). Two networks are built separately, and the two tasks proceed in parallel using a multi-task learning approach. The respective loss functions are weighted and summed by an adaptive method and then back-propagated to train the network, establishing the critical process of emotion cue inference, achieving a complete understanding of the conversational context, and finally accomplishing an accurate classification of the emotion in the conversations. In extensive experiments, the proposed model is shown to be effective and superior on two public benchmark datasets.

articleTitle: Table of Contents
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent System of 3D Software Cultural and Creative Product Design Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a development scheme of 3D animation visual mobile application based on virtual reality technology. Use camera equipment to collect image data. The image-real technology is used to process the images and other contents that need to be made. The processed data is established, combined with sound effects and other technologies, and input into the Unity3D engine to generate a 3D virtual picture at last. Establish a database of cultural and creative pictures. Quantitative description of the artistic style of cultural and creative products is carried out, and artificial features such as composition and splicing edge features are extracted. The advanced semantic properties are studied by simulated annealing method. Research the stitching method of artistic cultural and creative commodity pictures. Simulation experiments show that the proposed method can effectively complete the intelligent design of three-dimensional creative products.

articleTitle: Applications and Challenges of Inter-domain Routing Security Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The inter-domain routing system based on BGP is the cornerstone of global network space connection. Due to initial flaws in the BGP protocol design, numerous routing incidents (BGP leaks and hijacks) affecting availability were reported, demonstrating the insecurities and fragility of the inter-domain routing system. Although a number of techniques for addressing routing security challenges have been proposed by industry and the engineering community, none of these techniques alone address routing's various challenges either by design or in practice. There are also several challenges that hinder the deployment of available techniques for improving routing.

articleTitle: Application of Carbon Emission Flow of Power Information Management System Based on Big Data Intelligent Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the increasing awareness of environmental protection, reducing carbon emissions globally has become an urgent task. As one of the industries with the highest carbon dioxide emissions, the power industry also urgently needs to adopt advanced technologies to reduce carbon emissions. This article aims to study a power information management system based on intelligent big data analysis to reduce carbon emissions and improve power efficiency. The system achieves rapid processing and accurate analysis of power information through big data analysis algorithms, and monitors, analyzes and optimizes carbon emissions based on real-time data. At the same time, the system can comprehensively manage the maintenance and operation of power equipment, further improving power efficiency and reducing carbon emissions. In conclusion, the power information management system based on intelligent big data analysis is an effective means to achieve automation and intelligence in the power system. It can improve power efficiency, reduce environmental pollution, and also promote the development of the power industry.

articleTitle: A Measures to Reduce Flashover Failure in Birds
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In recent years, with the economic development and social progress, the electric power industry in our country has developed rapidly, and the social from all walks of life put forward high requirements for transmission efficiency and quality, strengthen the construction and maintenance of the grid is becoming important. 220kV transmission lines are the important part of power grid in our country, playing an important role in ensuring power grid stability, but it is easy to be disturbed by bird hazards, which cause faults and the tripping phenomenon to occur. In this paper, by sorting out the common types of bird flashover and analyzing the situation of bird damage fault of transmission lines in Fushun area, the design scheme of intelligent flashover device is put forward. After successful development, the effect of flashover device is obvious after multiple applications in the field, which greatly reduces the flashover failure rate of Fushun area lines.

articleTitle: Intelligent Electronic Lock 'Security Guard' Based on STM32 Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the context of today's era, private and efficient identity recognition systems are widely applied, and more traditional security systems are moving towards intelligent and informational development. As a result, intelligent electronic locks have gradually entered people's lives, transforming from simple password locks to embody technological advancements, subtly changing people's habits. This design presents an intelligent electronic lock based on the STM32 microcontroller, which implements multiple unlocking methods such as password unlocking, fingerprint unlocking, RFID card unlocking, and Bluetooth unlocking. This intelligent electronic lock, controlled through touch and mobile devices like smartphones, greatly enhances the user experience in terms of control. Compared to traditional locks, it not only ensures the original security but also adds more functions that align with the present era, facilitating and enriching people's lives. It holds practical significance in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Prediction of Controller Human Error Probability in Flight Conflict Resolution Based on THERP-HCR
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: THERP method has the functions of qualitative and quantitative analysis. It can model the conflict resolution process of controllers and roughly predict the probability of human misbehavior. However, THERP method does not consider the influence of time variables on conflict resolution, which has the defects of incomplete qualitative analysis and large quantitative analysis error. Therefore, combined with the analysis ability of HCR model to unresponsive error behavior, the defects in THERP method are corrected. Through the analysis of a typical case of controller's failure in conflict resolution, it can be found that the method can carry out more detailed analysis, and the formed data is more instructive for the formulation of risk control measures.

articleTitle: Research on the Potential Assessment and Control Strategy of Air Conditioning Group Load Regulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Reasonable control of air conditioning group load to promote the balance of power supply and demand and ensure the stable operation of the power grid. Based on the historical data, the linear regression model fits the equipment characteristics of the air conditioner, combines the ETP parameter model of the house to which the air conditioner belongs to build an air conditioner load model, considers the allowable shutdown time of the air conditioner, and puts forward a method to evaluate the potential of air conditioning regulation.Focusing on the relationship between the power grid, LA and air conditioning users, a demand response mechanism is proposed.Set the minimum deviation between the power change of the air conditioning group and the demand of the power grid as the target function, and put forward an air conditioning control strategy based on the indoor temperature that does not exceed the reasonable range of user comfort.Finally, the particle swarm algorithm is used for example analysis, which calculates the adjustable control potential of the air conditioning group and verifies the effectiveness of the strategy proposed in this article.

articleTitle: Research on Circuit Parameter Model of DC Converter Based on Charge and Discharge Characteristics of Supercapacitor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, A type controller for supercapacitor bidirectional DC/DC converter control is designed. This project first constructs a complete state space modeling method for an integrated supercapacitor DC/DC converter system based on multicellular cells. An integral circuit is used to ensure that the output of the system is free from any steady-state error. Secondly, the control circuit is set to the optimal closed-loop pole and the inductance current observed by Kalman filter is used as the output signal to control the circuit. The LMI method is used to optimize the controller. The charge and discharge test of the supercapacitor is carried out to verify the feasibility and correctness of the control strategy proposed in this project. The system has high stability margin, good dynamic and static performance, simple parameter design and small calculation.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatching Method for Power System Considering Multiform Flexibility Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The uncertainty of wind and photovoltaic output has a large impact on power system dispatching. Considering the constraints of spatiotemporal coupling characteristics of small hydropower group, an optimal dispatching model of multi-flexible resources participating in power system based on scenario analysis method is established with the objective of minimizing economic cost as well as carbon emission. Finally, the validity of the model is verified by a regional power grid, and the analysis results show that the proposed model can consider the uncertainty of wind and photovoltaic resource output and realize the safe and stable dispatch of multi-flexible resources participating in the power system.

articleTitle: The reasons and improvement measures for the long time of replacing cross arm with 10 kV live
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Electricity has gradually become an indispensable source of energy in our daily life. In order to ensure the uninterrupted supply of electric energy, electric power enterprises explore the maintenance technology without power failure, namely live operation. Live operation is in the case of line without power failure, operators in the insulation, the line, equipment, etc., maintenance and replacement of the operation. Nowadays, it has become an important goal of the development of electric power enterprises to continuously improve the technology and efficiency of live work. Especially in the face of complex and tedious live work projects, such as "10 kV live replacement cross arm", we need to optimize the operation process, reduce the working time, save the physical strength of the operators, ensure the safety of live working personnel, which is the top priority of the development of electric power enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence Personal Training Terminal in Assisting Double Cycle Talent Training in Dawan District
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The development of higher vocational and technical colleges in Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao Bay Area has serious homogeneity problem in the field of AI. The focus is on "industrial robotics". This will limit the diversification and sustainability of AI in future directions. Combined with the actual situation of the Greater Bay Area, the overall design idea and related technical operation of the system are carried out. VS2013 is the design platform of the system, ASP. NETMVC is the architecture model of the system, C# is the language of the system, and SQL Server 2018 R2 is the background database of the system. A modified random forest algorithm is used to establish a model to evaluate the quality of talent cultivation. The function, module and process of the talent training system in the Greater Bay Area are studied in detail. The structure of a network interconnection equipment and the establishment of a simulation training system are designed and developed. Application examples show that the proposed method can effectively evaluate training quality and improve the accuracy of training quality evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on Investment Strategy Based on LSTM Neural Network Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A transaction decision model will be built with quantitative investment as the core. The moving average (MA) and the moving average convergence and divergence (MACD) is taken as the opening level signal. Based on Markowitz’s classical portfolio theory, the optimal portfolio with the weight on the effective frontier will be constructed, and the weight structure of each risk asset in the portfolio will be dynamically adjusted. A neural network model based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) will be established to predict the prices of gold and bitcoin, so as to modify the trading strategy.The results show that on the 40th day, trend tracking indicators (MA and MACD) and weight calculation methods can provide scientific guidance for transaction decision-making; on the 350th day, the LSTM model can predict price changes in a good manner. Finally, after 46 trading activities, the investment value will become $105,131.5864 five years later.

articleTitle: Research on the Recognition of Motor Imaging EEG Signals Based on the PSD and the SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the study of brain-computer interface, the EEG signal recognition classification method of motor imaging is one of the hot spots in today's research. In this study, we use frequency domain analysis based on the power spectrum density function to extract features from motor imagery EEG signals for two different motor imagery movements. We then combine with SVM to classify the features because BCI systems currently still have a low recognition rate accuracy. This study finds that employing the power spectrum in conjunction with SVM improves EEG signal classification when compared to alternative classifiers, such as random forest and convolutional neural networks. It can offer algorithmic assistance for the widespread use of BCI systems in everyday life.

articleTitle: Research on AI composition based on deep learning techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the recent wave of deep learning networks, its application in generating creative content, including music, grows wider. The research of automatic music generation, as a way of understanding human’s artful expression, and a promising field of high commercial value, has been progressed rapidly. Multiple networks have been used for music generation. Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) are most frequently used because of their advantages in processing time sequences and generating new creations. The results of diverse generative algorithms for intelligent composition vary greatly. This article analyzes some cases of RNN-based and GAN-based music generation methods, and discusses how the application of multiple networks, such as C-RNN-GAN, integrates the advantages of different networks, showing a trend in the future progress of music generation. It also discusses the necessity of building precise methods for evaluating generated music, and describes some cases where deep learning method has helped in this realm.

articleTitle: Research on ChatGPT Translation System of Computer Cloud Translation Platform Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a new method of proofreading English translation based on ChatGPT language. The main functions of this software include retrieval module, English translation module, English translation calibration module and user operation record. The ontological model is used to identify and control semantic information in machine translation. Establish a professional semantic library of standard GPT. A concept tree construction algorithm based on topic vocabulary is proposed. A semantic model is constructed for the English translation scoring system. The relevant information in the text required by the user is extracted from the English text. Experiments show that this system can efficiently complete online intelligent translation, which enhances the credibility and intelligence of machine translation.

articleTitle: The Application of PCA and K-means Model in Detecting Anomalous Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The stable operation of power transformers is the foundation for ensuring the power supply in various industries of society and the basic functioning of everyday life. Therefore, it is particularly important to detect anomalies during high-load operation of transformers. However, it remains challenging for traditional method to quickly and efficiently detect the anomalies in large-dimensional and large-scale power transformer dataset. In this paper, we optimize the traditional anomaly detection methods for power transformers by combining the advantages of PCA and K-means models. We first choose to use PCA to achieve dimensionality reduction and reduce the influence of noise on result. Furthermore, we propose an elbow method, by calculating WCSS (Within-Cluster Sum of Square) to address the uncertainty of the k value during the clustering process. Experimental results show that the combined model of PCA and K-means improves the accuracy of anomaly detection results by 139% compared to the traditional single K-means model in detecting anomalous transformers. This model not only optimizes the computational and time complexity during the clustering process when there is an increase of dimensions in the dataset, it also improves the accuracy of the result, making it more effective in detecting anomalous machines in large-dimensional and large-scale transformer dataset, which better serving practical applications in the real world.

articleTitle: Network Technology under Computer Big Data Network Information Security System Research
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes a secure data storage scheme for protecting network privacy. In the system hardware design, it is divided into interface module, basic service module and storage module. The three functional modules work together to improve the security of personal privacy data on the Internet. Establish a personal privacy database in software to ensure the security of personal privacy data. Asymmetric cryptography is used to encrypt and decrypt the data. Finally, the encrypted privacy information data is processed centrally to realize the combined storage of privacy information in the computer network. By comparing the safety and operation effect of the system, it is proved that the system has great advantages in safety and efficiency. The simulation results show that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Computer Virtual Reality Automatic Control Database System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, based on computer virtual reality technology, a real-time database system of multiple storage media is established. A real-time database in the configuration system is constructed by using DLL technology, and the data modeling and interface design of the database are carried out. The real-time data partitioning algorithm realizes the automatic and instant generation of data partitioning, and improves the system scalability and throughput by using the horizontal expansion mechanism of streaming computing framework. Finally, an example of realtime database class and related data model is given.

articleTitle: Courier Demand Forecasting Problem Based on BP Neural Network Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the popularization of online shopping, the demand for express delivery services is rising, stimulating the further development of our economy. Therefore, how to compress the cost of express delivery and plan reasonable transportation routes and storage sites is very important. First of all, the data are quantitatively imported into MATLAB, determine the input parameters as the date and city, and the output variable as the amount of goods, predict the number of express delivery on each line of 2019.4.18 and 2019.4.19, and sum up the predicted number of express delivery to get the total number of express transportation. Then the data are classified and summarized according to the city pairs, assigning the value of 1 for normal shipment and 0 for no normal shipment, and the data are initially processed and divided, and the BP neural network algorithm is applied to establish the model of predicted line status and the model of predicted transportation quantity, and the results of predicted line status and the number of express transportation are predicted. Finally, construct the adjacency matrix about the cost of railroad transportation network, determine the transportation cost between two points that is the weight value, realize the Floyd algorithm, and calculate the minimum transportation cost according to the data of the place of receipt and delivery on the same day.

articleTitle: Research on 3D Printing System Based on Computer 3Dmax Design and Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A 3D printing system based on ATMega2560 chip is proposed. The system uses A4988 as the power to realize the control of stepping motor and extrusion device. The JAKAZu7 collaborative manipulator was chosen as its implementation architecture. The SIMATICS7-1200 acts as the controller of the epitaxial device. The interface of the robot arm is developed again, the G code processing module and communication module are designed, and the structured processing of all kinds of data is realized. A software system model based on multiple views is proposed. The test system can work stably after three-dimensional simulation printing test. The system provides users of 3D printing with an intuitive, safe and effective operating environment.

articleTitle: Research on the Data Collection Method of Intelligent Vehicle Terminal for Production and Operation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Vehicles are essential tools to support business travel and production operations. The development of new technologies and the demand for convenience are accompanied by an intelligent transportation transformation. To connect multiple types of terminal devices based on vehicle terminals, we can achieve multi terminal linkage, and support applications in various production scenarios, which is an urgent need for enterprises. This paper researches on the data collection method of intelligent vehicle terminal for production and operation. The collected data includes terminal management, communication data, vehicle fault remote diagnosis data, positioning data, Beidou short message, DMS data, ADAS data, video data, third-party equipment data access support, voice data, etc. Through the research of this paper, the vehicle terminal becomes the unified entrance of production data, as a edge computing device. It can support the access of multiple supporting sensing terminals. Through the research of IoT access technology, this paper achieves multi-source device data collection to support the development of production tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Protection System under Computer Digitization Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A set of multi-mode integrated network attack defense system is established. The i6300A data acquisition machine is used, with a scanning engine, which can collect abnormal information in complex situations. Using 10/100 M interface and message switching mode, the large-scale information exchange is completed. A homomorphic cipher is proposed to ensure the security and integrity of information. Homomorphic cryptography can perform direct operations on cryptographic data. Homomorphic encryption can operate directly on encrypted data. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the calculation and communication overhead of the sensor, and also ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the data.

articleTitle: Detectable Absorption Range Measurement of SOF2 and SO2F2 Using a System Based on Tunable Diode Laser Absorption Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Detecting the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposition components SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and SOF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> can help determine the status of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> electrical equipment. articleTitle: Application of Deep Learning in Scalable Computer Network Design Software System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Computer network is a tool that can achieve information sharing, with strong interoperability and universality, and can solve various problems in communication systems. However, in practical applications, computer network design systems have many shortcomings, mainly manifested in their strong dependence on network design software systems. Once problems arise, they can lead to a decrease in network communication quality. Deep learning technology is a data-driven machine learning technology that has strong adaptability and significant advantages in solving computer network design software system problems. In this context, the article conducts in-depth research on deep learning technology and explores its application in computer network design software systems, thereby increasing the average reliability score of the system from 5.92 points to 8.59 points.

articleTitle: Prediction for Photovoltaic Power Generation Based on Multi Feature Gradient Descent Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Due to the crisis of non-renewable energy exhaustion and the need of environmental protection of the Earth, solar energy, as a renewable and clean energy, has become a highly recommended energy use. Although government agencies are attempting to achieve self-sufficiency through sustainable energy generation, accurate cost estimation is difficult to determine due to uncontrollable natural factors such as sunlight and wind speed, and the data throughout the year is not average If an intelligent algorithm tool can be designed that can predict the production capacity of solar energy in a specific region by analyzing factors related to annual solar production, it will greatly improve the efficiency of sustainable energy investment. This article designs corresponding photovoltaic power generation prediction algorithms, using support vector regressor (SVR), eXtreme gradient boosting (xgboost), and multilayer perceptron (MLP) neural networks for modeling and optimizing the corresponding models. The key is to compare different algorithms for photovoltaic prediction, and the evaluation shows that the model established using xgboost has the smallest error in the test set, with an accuracy rate of up to 97.5%.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Sliding Mode Attitude Control for QUAV
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A sliding mode control method is proposed for a quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (QUAV) that can be affected by external disturbances. First, a nonlinear disturbance observer is developed to address the negative effects of unknown disturbances from outside. Secondly, an event-triggered sliding mode control mechanism has been created to conserve communication resources on the premise of maintaining the system's consistent performance. Thirdly, the Lyapunov approach is applied for evaluating the stability of the system. To demonstrate the efficacy of the system, simulation outcomes are provided in the last part.

articleTitle: A Flexible Pressure Sensor with Multilayer Physical Crosslinking Structure Based on MXene
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rise of technology such as the Internet of Things and Rrtificial Intelligence, flexible pressure sensors have broad application prospects in fields such as artificial touch, health monitoring, biomimetic electronic skin, etc. Currently, there is still a certain gap between the sensitivity and stability of flexible pressure sensors and practical applications. In this article, MXene is used as a conductive material, a MXene flexible pressure sensor with a multilayer physical crosslinking structure is prepared using vacuum filtration and electrostatic self-assembly methods. The test results show that the prepared flexible pressure sensor has two linear response regions in the pressure range of 0-40kPa, with the highest sensitivity in the low pressure range (0-2kPa), reaching 18.19kPa<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>. It also has good piezoresistive sensitivity to the motion state of human limbs, This indicates that the flexible pressure sensor prepared in the experiment has good application prospects in the field of flexible wearable electronic devices.

articleTitle: Design of equipment cable detection equipment based on time-domain reflectometry technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A portable equipment cable test device based on time domain pulse echo (TDR) principle is introduced. The device is designed with a single chip microcomputer as the control core and FPGA as the test subject to transmit and receive pulses, collect the round-trip time of the pulse cable, and realize the measurement of the fault location of the cable. Firstly, the design theory is elaborated, and then the overall design block diagram, hardware realization and software testing flow of the system are introduced. The picosecond ultra-fast step pulse generation technology, pulse generator, ultra wideband microwave sampling technology, microwave sampler, high precision synchronous sampling technology and specific design methods of step sampling time base in hardware design are emphasized.

articleTitle: An Engineering Control Method of SCR Denitration System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The SCR denitration system has dead-time and nonlinearity, so a Fractional-order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> control method is proposed. The second-order linear active disturbance rejection control(LADRC) can be seen as a structure of a conventional PID and a second-order filter connected in series. However, the tuning ability of conventional PID is limited. Using fractional order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> and second-order filters are connected in series to improve ordinary cascade PID control, and the control system parameters are tunned using an improved Imperial Competition algorithm. The simulation results show that the fractional order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> and second-order filter in series can better reproduce the advantages of active disturbance rejection control (ADRC), and the control performance is better than ordinary cascade PID and the structure of conventional PID and second-order filter in series. The fractional order PI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sup>D<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">μ</sup> control system has a simple structure and easy tuning, which is worth promoting in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Artificial Intelligence Simulating Basketball Player Tactics System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper presents a basketball tactics collection system based on computer technology. A set of basketball skill bank is established, and the collected skill bank is compared with the match video in the database. Firstly, the athletes' facial features are extracted by using the complete convolutional decoding network constructed in advance. The Gaussian based method is used to plot the key points in the image. An adaptive method is used to draw heat maps. The radius of the Gaussian kernel can be changed with the height and width of the object, which accelerates the convergence of the neural network. The height, width and position of athletes are obtained by analyzing the thermal field map. Through the design of graphical user interface, level design, animation design, animation design, collision detection and other aspects of the design to make it better to help athletes.

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Protection Techniques for the Central Station Side of Distributed Power Dispatch and Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This research focuses on the study of network security protection techniques for the central station side of distributed power dispatch and control systems. It covers various aspects such as vulnerability discovery, information interaction security, device management, and threat tracing. The aim is to propose an integrated, multi-dimensional, and multi-level security protection system that combines active and passive data security measures and security analysis methods to ensure the safety and reliability of the distributed power dispatch and control systems.

Author Keywords: Distributed Power Dispatch and Control System

articleTitle: The Research on Server Signal Light Image Recognition Algorithm Based on SPD_YOLOV5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: For the detection of server signal lights in data centers, challenges arise due to the small size of the lights and various factors such as visual quality, diversity, occlusion, and interference, which can affect the accuracy of signal light detection. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved approach for object detection based on YOLOv5 to enhance the accuracy of signal light detection. The proposed method includes the addition of a small object prediction layer on top of the original network and the utilization of SPDConv as a novel CNN building block, which effectively extracts features from low-resolution images and small objects. Furthermore, the loss function is optimized by replacing CIoU with SIoU, reducing degrees of freedom and improving the robustness of the network. Experimental results demonstrate significant performance improvements in the detection and recognition of server signal lights achieved by the improved YOLOv5 approach.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Artificial Intelligence Interactive Labor Education and Training System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, virtual reality technology is embedded into the virtual skill assessment model, and a comprehensive training system framework is built. OpenCV’s and Multigene are selected as the development platforms of the virtual training system. A set of immersive virtual cooperative training system is developed through structural framework design, functional module design, database design and multi-person collaborative design. This paper proposes a vocational skill personalized learning based on tabu parallel genetic algorithm. The whole system implementation process from scene modeling to scene driven is discussed in detail. The application of the system can further improve the maintenance ability of the enterprise to the equipment, basic fault troubleshooting ability and overhaul ability, and reduce the loss caused by the wrong use and improper operation of the equipment.

articleTitle: Research on CNN-LSTM based on attention mechanism for wind power generation prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Due to the intermittent and random nature of wind power generation, the instability of the power grid can reduce the safety of its operation. Consequently, peak regulation of the grid system has become one of the new challenges for maintaining a stable grid operation. This research suggests an attention mechanism-based CNN-LSTM architecture-based wind power prediction model to address this problem. For projecting the output of wind turbines, this model considers a number of meteorological variables, including the speed and direction of the wind, air pressure, and temperature. The CNN-LSTM architecture is used to extract critical feature information from the data, while the attention mechanism assigns different weights to highlight the most critical features for more accurate wind power prediction. On the basis of the data gathered from a wind farm in northwest China, studies for predicting winds were done, and the prediction results of different models were compared using the goodness-of-fit and RMSE as evaluation indices. According to the findings, the CNN-LSTM model that is based on the attention mechanism has a goodness-of-fit of 0.89 and an RMSE of 18.03, proving that the model can effectively predict wind power. Therefore, the proposed method has a certain application value.

articleTitle: Research on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion method for intelligent ship navigation test
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In response to the problems of various types of parameters and significant differences in physical dimensions in the intelligent ship sea navigation test, and the related parameters mainly include platform steering gear, AIS, attitude, and wind speed and direction,etc. This article focuses on summarizing and analyzing the physical properties, sources, and categories of various types of parameters, in order to grasp the basic characteristics and data compilation methods of each parameter. A multi-source heterogeneous data fusion method for intelligent ship navigation systems based on simultaneous basis is proposed, and a navigation test data collection and fusion system is designed and developed, which can provide technical and data support for the evaluation of intelligent ship navigation performance.

articleTitle: Algorithm for seed counting of adherent buckwheat based on area estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: ResU-net network in the segmentation of adhesive buckwheat seed images, buckwheat adhesion degree increases will lead to a decline in the counting accuracy. In this paper, we propose a method based on area estimation and improvement, firstly, counting the area and roundness of the same buckwheat grain, clustering and setting the threshold; secondly, establishing a fuzzy inference system, input area and roundness, and output the number of grains; and finally, accumulating the output of all buckwheat grains. The experimental results show that the method can accurately count the adherent buckwheat seeds with an error rate of 2% or less, which meets the practical needs and avoids the waste of resources in expanding the dataset. This provides a solution for accurately counting adherent buckwheat kernels, which has potential for practical application.

articleTitle: Multi time scale scheduling strategy and modeling considering photovoltaic uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Optoelectronics' rapid development has challenged the regulation ability of conventional units due to its output’s randomness, fluctuation, and uncertainty. A multi-time scale coordinated scheduling model for power generation, load shifting, and energy storage is developed by taking into account the prediction error characteristics of optoelectronics at different time scales, as well as the benefits of load curve optimization and the flexible power regulation capability of energy storage. Currently, for the optimization of power systems containing optoelectronics, this article mainly adopts the scenario method, using typical scenarios with uncertain factors to replace all possible scenarios, Calculate the expected value of the objective function using the probability of typical scenarios, and establish an expected value model to seek an optimization plan for photovoltaic output that meets the constraints of typical scenarios and safe operation. This model aims to optimize the efficiency of resource utilization by jointly modeling transferable load, energy storage and conventional units, and comprehensively considering the dispatching cost of transferable load, energy storage degradation cost, penalty cost related to unit output plan change and photoelectric consumption efficiency.

articleTitle: Comparison between HEM and EDM in reflecting moisture information on oil-paper insulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the construction of the oil-paper insulation equivalent model, the identification of model parameters plays a key role in understanding the characteristics of oil-paper insulation medium, and the moisture content and aging state information contained in the dielectric response results can be effectively reflected by the change of model parameters, and the consistency between FDS curve and measured value curve after model parameter reconstruction is the standard for measuring whether the model parameters are true and effective. In order to prove that HEM can truly reflect the complex dielectric response of oil-paper insulation system compared with EDM, this paper identifies the parameters of the two models based on FDS data in different test environments, focusing on the comparison of the agreement between the measured curves and the calculated curves of the two models.

articleTitle: A Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network Model for Electric Vehicle Purchase Propensity Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Electric vehicles are gaining popularity as an environmentally friendly alternative to gasoline-powered vehicles. Predictions of propensity to purchase electric vehicles can provide valuable insights for the automotive industry, policy makers, and energy suppliers. At present, there is no comprehensive quantitative research on the influencing factors of electric vehicle purchase intention, and there is also a lack of explainable correlation between electric vehicle purchase intention and these influencing factors. In this paper, we propose a heterogeneous graph neural network model for electric vehicles purchase propensity prediction. This model uses a heterogeneous graph structure to process various types of data including charging infrastructure, environmental factors, brand recognition, etc., and encodes by analyzing the characteristics of different nodes to achieve different group embedding and obtain the final node embedding. The proposed model outperforms several structures on real-world datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in electric vehicles purchase propensity prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate Three-Dimensional Modeling Technology and Intelligent Mining in Coal Mines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article presents the background and demand for intelligent mining at the Buertai Coal Mine, operated by China Shenhua Shendong Coal, and addresses the challenges faced in geological condition identification during the construction of intelligent workfaces. To tackle this issue, the mine conducted comprehensive geological studies, with a focus on establishing a three-dimensional geological model of the working coal seam. The research involved collecting geological data from the workface, seismic tomography exploration, borehole permeability exploration, and other methods. By utilizing a discrete smoothing interpolation algorithm, accurate calculations were performed for the elevation of the roof and floor of the workface, leading to the development of a static three-dimensional geological model. During the dynamic modeling phase, the static model was continuously adjusted using real-time geological data, resulting in a dynamic model that reflects the workface’s geological conditions more accurately. Finally, based on the established three-dimensional geological model, an entity model was constructed and presented, providing real-time geological parameters for intelligent mining. The article also introduces a method for predicting the elevation of the roof and floor using the discrete smoothing interpolation algorithm, and validates its effectiveness through experiments. In summary, this research provides essential transparent geological support for intelligent mining in the coal mine, and it holds practical application value.

articleTitle: Application Research on Vehicle Mileage Calculation Based on GPS Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to realize on-line real-time monitoring of vehicle running status in enterprises, improve vehicle running supervision ability and vehicle mileage calculation accuracy, and improve vehicle compliance travel level, vehicle position positioning and track data collection are realized based on GPS positioning technology by installing vehicle intelligent terminal, and the positioning data are transmitted to the management platform through data communication service, real-time viewing and track playback of vehicle position and track are carried out through Siji map service through data receiving, processing and optimization processes. After filtering abnormal trajectory points, completing missing trajectory points and correcting trajectory, the vehicle trajectory can be fitted effectively, and the quality of vehicle trajectory data can be enhanced. Based on this, the purpose of vehicle mileage calculation optimization can be realized [1].

articleTitle: Active learning-based optimal strategy for Wordle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article describes a simulation model that utilizes a word bank to guess a puzzle answer and adjust the model in real-time based on results analysis. The model successfully predicted the percentage of the word "ERIRE" for each guess attempt. The presented algorithm classified words into three difficulty levels and analyzed the differences in each indicator. The article established a discriminant function to determine that guessing the word "EEIRE" was of medium difficulty.

articleTitle: Fatigue Detection and Early Warning System for Drivers Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: this paper introduces a deep learning-based driver fatigue detection system using a convolutional neural network (CNN). Unlike traditional methods, it directly extracts visual features from in-vehicle camera images. The dataset, annotated with severe, mild, and normal fatigue levels, undergoes data augmentation to avoid overfitting. A customized CNN, trained with dropout and auxiliary classifiers, achieves a high accuracy of 92.4% on unseen test images. The system offers real-time, non-intrusive fatigue monitoring, enhancing driving safety by alerting distracted drivers and preventing hazardous behaviors due to drowsiness. This advancement represents a significant step forward in intelligent vehicle safety technologies.

articleTitle: Some Improvements in Selection Sorting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Sorting is an important data manipulation in computer science. Sorting plays a very important role in data structures and algorithms. There are many kinds of sorting, and sorting by choice is an effective sort. This paper will introduce the selection method sorting, and improve, compare and analyze it.

articleTitle: Application and Improvement of RCS/PCS Type Fiber Optic Current Differential Protection Joint Trip Function
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: After an in-depth investigation of a 220kV line trip event that occurred in a 220kV conventional substation, the reason behind it was the improper logic of the 220kV line longitudinal differential protection action. Taking the RCS/PCS optical fiber current differential protection device in the tripping event as an example, the behavior of the 220kV line longitudinal differential protection action and joint tripping action is analyzed, and the logical defects of the joint debugging logic in operation are proposed. The technical method for correct improvement was established, and combined with this trip event, some reasonable suggestions and measures were put forward according to the operation mode and maintenance process.

articleTitle: Image Denoising Based on Median Filter and UNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Image denoising can improve image quality, improve visual perception, improve the accuracy of subsequent tasks, reduce image compression rate, and protect privacy information. In order to effectively remove the noise of real images, this paper proposes an image denoising method combining adaptive weighted median filtering algorithm, VGG and U-Net network. Firstly, the adaptive weighted median filtering algorithm is used to preprocess the input noise image, and then the VGG-16 network is used to extract the features of the image. On this basis, the U-Net network is constructed for encoding and decoding to obtain the denoised image. Experimental results on the SIDD real image dataset show that compared with other classical methods, the PSNR and SSIM values of the proposed algorithm are greatly improved, with PSNR reaching 35.57 and SSIM reaching 0.957. On the data sets with Gaussian noise standard deviation of 5, 10 and 20, the PSNR reaches 37.614, 35.241 and 35.249, SSIM reaches 0.974, 0.961 and 0.963, and MSE reaches 14.744, 31.985 and 36.120, respectively. The processed image has good visual effect, and the proposed algorithm can retain more image detail information while denoising.

articleTitle: Vision-Based Outdoor Garbage Collection Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Leaving garbage in the outdoor environment is harmful to nature, and traditionally, the collection process has been challenging, time-consuming, and labor-intensive. In order to automate the process of garbage detection and collection, I have designed this AI-powered garbage collection robot.
