The robot's chassis uses Mecanum wheels as the power source, enabling free rotation and translation on a flat surface. The detection method utilizes the YOLOv3 algorithm to identify the type, size, and distance of the garbage. The device has been tested in practical scenarios and can effectively recognize and clean small-sized garbage, reducing the burden on manual labor.

articleTitle: Byte-Sized Reviewers: Exploring Review Generation through LNRG-S
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The development of network technology has led to an explosive growth of user-generated comments. These contents are based on users' experiences after using services and products, reflecting users' evaluations. Automatically generating high-quality and controllable sentiment comments can help creators improve work quality, help service providers enhance service levels, and improve consumers' consumption experience. However, current methods have some limitations. Seq2seq models have difficulty maintaining semantic consistency and generating long texts, LSTM can maintain a memory state and generate coherent text, but is prone to overfitting, generating repetitive text, and having difficulty establishing local coherence. N-gram models text locally but cannot understand the global context. This paper proposes a hybrid architecture, called LNRG-S (LSTM N-gram Reviews Generator with Sentiments), which combines LSTM and N-gram to model both global and local dependencies, and trains separate LSTM generators for positive and negative samples to control sentiment polarity of generated comments. We computed the perplexity of comments generated by different models. LNRG-S has 43.93% and 18.89% lower perplexity than LSTM and n-gram respectively, demonstrating that LNRG-S generates more fluent and coherent text.

articleTitle: Power Fluctuation Suppression Method for WPT System Based on Additional Coupling Channels
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: At present, research on the suppression of power fluctuations in wireless charging systems mainly focuses on addressing lateral (X) and longitudinal (Y) offsets, while there is relatively little research on vertical (Z) offsets. This article proposes a new method to suppress power fluctuations in the wireless charging system of electric vehicles by using additional coupling channels to achieve closed-loop control. A rectangular coil mutual inductance calculation model has been established, accurately describing the relationship between two sets of coils. The higher-order components of the secondary side output are fed back to the primary side through additional coupling channels, and mutual inductance estimation and output calculation are achieved only at the power transmission end. On the basis of circuit analysis, the optimization design process of feedback loop is provided. Replacing the communication of closed-loop control with additional coupling channels, converting digital signals into analog signals, eliminating the stages of communication and data processing, and improving the real-time performance of the system.

articleTitle: Text Clustering Based on Binary Particle Swarm and Spherical K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Internet technology advancement has led to an exponential surge in text data. Among the pressing data types today, natural language data stands out. Leveraging natural language processing (NLP) technology, computers can comprehend human language and extract valuable information from extensive textual data. This paper introduces a novel approach for text clustering, combining binary particle swarm optimization with the spherical K-means algorithm. Empirical findings on a Chinese text dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the feature selection method introduced in this paper, effectively diminishing feature overlap and enhancing clustering precision.

articleTitle: Nonlinear model predictive control method for carbon fiber angle link weaving machine tension based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, a neural network-based nonlinear model predictive control strategy for carbon fiber angle link weaving machine tension is proposed. Firstly, the tension nonlinear model considering the opening disturbance is established. Secondly, considering the existence of nonlinear terms in the system, a radial basis function (RBF) neural network is proposed to approximate the nonlinear terms online to improve the control accuracy of the system. A tension nonlinear model predictive control(NMPC) is designed to achieve constant tension control under the driving torque constraint. And compared with the conventional nonlinear model predictive controller, the RBFNMPC improves the time to reach the steady state in the system state variation curve by 0.2s, reduces the overshoot of the three states in the state response curve by 19.1%, 6.1% and 12.3%, respectively, and effectively reduces the time to reach the steady state.

articleTitle: Research on the A-star Algorithm Based on Path Finding
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The A star pathfinding algorithm is one of the most commonly used pathfinding algorithms. This paper will introduce A new algorithm, which is improved on the basis of the A-star algorithm, and this improved algorithm reduces the interval complexity and memory consumption. The improved the A-star algorithm can find A smoother path more quickly.

articleTitle: Research and design of a parking Internet of Things device management platform based on Hadoop big data technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper focuses on the management of parking IoT devices and introduces the practice of using Hadoop and NB-IoT technologies for data processing and intelligent management. The paper describes the basic infrastructure and components of the Hadoop platform, as well as methods for implementing big data processing and analysis, while delving into the application scenarios and advantages of NB-IoT technology in IoT device management. Based on this, the paper constructs the architecture and functional modules of the IoT device management platform, including data acquisition, storage, analysis, visualization, etc., and proposes application solutions such as intelligent warning, real-time monitoring, and decision support. The research results have high reference value for the research and practice in the field of parking IoT device management.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Learning Motivation Classification: Fusion of LSTM and Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid expansion of online education and continuous advancements in information technology, in-depth analysis and understanding of students’ learning motivation have become increasingly critical. Students’ learning motivation may affect their participation and achievements, making accurate identification and classification of learning motivation significant. This study proposes an advanced integrated model that combines Long Short-Term Memory networks (LSTM) with Neural Ordinary Differential Equations (Neural ODEs) for the classification and analysis of learning motivation. The LSTM component focuses on capturing long-term dependencies in time series data, while the Neural ODEs part is responsible for modeling continuous dynamic processes. We delve into the mathematical properties of the model and provide comprehensive theoretical analysis through theorems, reasoning, and inference. Moreover, we designed a series of rigorous experiments using real online education datasets from the Tianchi platform for validation. The experimental results show that the integrated model significantly outperforms standalone LSTM, Neural ODEs, and the baseline Random Forest model on multiple performance metrics such as accuracy, recall, and F1 score. We also deeply analyze the contribution of different model components and discuss various implementation details and hyperparameter selections. The main findings and methods of this study not only offer new perspectives and tools for analyzing learning motivation in the field of online education but also provide valuable insights for other time series and continuous data classification tasks.

articleTitle: MMC-HVDC modeling considering the delay characteristics of control links and parameter optimization methods for improving stability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To reflect the impact of delay control on the operating characteristics of MMC converter control system and improve the operational stability of MMC HVDC, a MMC dynamic phasor model considering the effect of delay control was established. Firstly, the influence mechanism of MMC converter control link on its performance is analyzed. Based on the dynamic phasor method, a Small-signal model considering MMC internal variables is established; Based on the eigenvalue method, the system stability is analyzed to obtain the influence of various control variables on stability. On this basis, the control parameters are optimized to improve system stability. Building an MMC electromagnetic simulation model on the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform, conducting simulation tests on multiple types of operating conditions, verifying the correctness of the analyzed parameter influence law and the effectiveness of the designed parameter optimization method, reducing the risk of resonance generation.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Aspect-Oriented High-Speed Railway Database Connection Pool
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The potential value in big data offers significant help in enhancing intelligent transportation systems, improving user travel experiences, and other aspects of vehicular networking. However, the explosive growth of data poses challenges in processing and storage. The Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP) approach addresses the limitations of Object-Oriented Software Development in dealing with non-functional requirements. This paper focuses on the data access characteristics and proposes the application of Aspect-Oriented development principles in modeling and analyzing the high-speed railway database connection pool.

articleTitle: Research on Sales Forecasting Model Based on GRU Neural Network and Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In the age of big data, the retail industry generates a vast amount of sales data daily. Analyzing and mining these data can facilitate management decision-making and provide great benefits to enterprises. With competition intensifying in the retail industry, precise sales forecasts are essential to assist companies in effectively managing their inventory of specific commodities, developing marketing plans, and formulating timely and effective strategic policies to reduce costs and increase efficiency. In this paper, the STL method is combined with SVR and GRU to build a daily sales forecasting model for retail enterprises. The trend, seasonal, and residual sub-series decomposed from past sales are used to directly predict future sales to achieve a better forecasting effect, and are compared with some traditional models and STL-ML combined models based on the decomposition integration idea. The results show that the method used in this paper has higher forecasting accuracy, and the forecasting ideas proposed in this paper have important reference significance for the sales forecasting practice of retail enterprises.

articleTitle: Application of leakage detection based on acoustic emission technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The acoustic emission technology has high sensitivity and good stability, and is not affected by the condition of the specimen itself. Acoustic emission (AE) can be used to determine the damage of concrete structures and is an effective means of structural health monitoring. In this paper, wavelet analysis method is used to process the acoustic emission signal of underground engineering leakage, It achieves good filtering and signal extraction, By determining the time when the sound wave reaches the sensor, the positioning accuracy is improved and the location of leakage is better realized.

articleTitle: Light absorption improvement and mechanism analysis of single photon avalanche diode with metal gratings
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The single photon avalanche diode (SPAD) detector with metal nanograting structure is simulated, and light absorption mechanism in the near-infrared region is analysed. The period, thickness, dielectric layer thickness and other parameters of Ag gratings at 850 nm communication wave-length are optimized. Combined with FDTD optical simulation results, TCAD simulation was used to adjust the depth of pn junction to about 0.8 μm at the wavelength of 850 nm. The depth of depletion region and light absorption region are matched to improve the light absorption efficiency in the near-infrared region.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Data Mining and Processing System Based on Computer Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In this paper, a genetic algorithm for DSS modeling is proposed by integrating GA and DSS. Firstly, SOFM algorithm is used to convert the quantized sample information into semantic value. The decision system is transformed into a fuzzy set of semantic values. The original fuzzy interval is reduced by using fuzzy set similarity analysis and fusion method. This enhances the credibility of the model. Then genetic algorithm is used to further optimize the rules obtained. The corresponding data were selected from UCI database as the test object. The correctness of the method applied in quantitative data is verified.

articleTitle: Research on the Computer Aided Physical Education Distance Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper builds a network physical education system based on WEB services and SQL database. The architecture of the platform is divided into four levels: infrastructure, logic, support and distance learning platform. On the browser side, the Spring architecture is used to complete the control design. The Hibernate architecture and Spring JDBC wrapper classes are used to convert between the underlying database and business logic layers. The practical application and experiment show that the system can meet the needs of modern education technology. And it can integrate all kinds of learning styles well. The user interface is good. The physical education distance teaching system is a good man-machine teaching method.

articleTitle: The current situation of the investigation and improvement of the arc extinguishing coil fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The arc extinguishing coil is a compensation device for small current grounding system. By the arc extinguishing coil grounding directly affects the safety, reliability and stability of substation operation, has become the new era of substation operation and maintenance management of the top priority. But by environmental factors, wiring methods, etc., the arc extinguishing coil caused by arc grounding, ferromagnetic resonance and other safety accidents occur from time to time. In this paper, we investigate and analyze the current situation of arc extinguishing coil failure and propose improvement measures to reduce the defect rate of arc extinguishing coil, in order to form a scientific and efficient operation and maintenance management program and improve the safety performance of substations.

articleTitle: Taxi Passenger Flow Prediction Based on Hotspot Clustering and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the development of society and urban expansion, the increase in urban population has led to growing transportation pressures. Therefore, predicting passenger flow and consequently planning taxi routes have become urgent problems to solve. In this paper, Chengdu taxi GPS trajectory data is utilized. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are used to extract features from vacant taxi periods and locations. Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks and clustering algorithms are employed to predict and determine passenger hotspot areas based on data-driven approaches. By integrating neural networks with temporal and spatial distribution features of passenger flow, this method effectively reflects the dynamics of taxi passenger flow. Simulated experiments are conducted on Chengdu taxi GPS routes. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms existing methods. The findings indicate that the model effectively uncovers the spatiotemporal correlations in taxi passenger flow data, leading to accurate predictions.

articleTitle: Wordle Distribution Prediction Model Based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to get the distribution of the percentage of the accuracy of guesses, this paper uses Random Forest Regression to predict the percentages of (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, X) in a future day. First, this paper adds several attributes into pro-processing data. Then, this paper takes the new data’s row as inputs and exports the output distribution. In addition, this paper constructs the Distribution Prediction Model Based on Random Forest that contains normalization part, random forest part and the weighted averaging output function. Moreover, this paper analysis Pearson’s correlation coefficient and draws the heatmap to show the final results. After many experiments and stimulations, this paper can get the EERIE on March 1, 2023, percentage is (0.23, 2.97, 15.23, 30.94, 29.66, 16.38, 3.38). And this paper also makes sensitivity analysis to test its reliability.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Number of Wordle Report Results Based on ARIMA and BIC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to make predictions about the number of results reported by Wordle and to determine whether word attributes affect the percentage of scores in hard mode. This research is based on historical data, and the data are reprocessed first. Then, Auto-regressive Integrated Moving Average Model (ARIMA) prediction model based on Bayesian information criterion was adopted. Then, using stability tests and white noise tests, the parameters of the model were identified based on the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) to build a model for the prediction of the number of reported outcomes. Then Breusch-Pagan test and Pearson Correlation Analysis were performed. The forecast of the number of reports is finally completed. Finally, the number of reported outcomes by March 1, 2023 is predicted, and the percentage of word attributes that do not affect the difficulty score is determined. The results show that the fitting degree of the model is high, and the prediction accuracy complies with the requirements.

articleTitle: Application of InSAR Technology in Deformation Monitoring of Overseas Power Survey Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In view of the actual needs of deformation monitoring of overseas power survey engineering, it is of great scientific and practical significance to carry out the application research of deformation monitoring of InSAR technology. This paper reports a study that employs PSInSAR technique to monitor the deformations of a coal-fired power plant, Indonesia, with 31 Sentinel-1 images. The monitoring results show that the circular coal silo in the power plant area has a settlement of about -40 mm from October 2015 to July 2017, and other areas of the power plant are stable, which is consistent with the field survy results. This paper shows that InSAR technology has broad prospects in the deformation monitoring and disaster prevention of overseas power survey engineering.

articleTitle: Extracting Visual Semantic Information for Solving Visual Question Answering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Varies of language models exist, such as LLaMA, Chat-GPT3, and PaLM. These models display a striking resemblance to human cognition, exhibiting a robust capability to analyze images or videos, fully understanding and assessing the overall content and significance of visuals. This holds true for the VQA (Visual Question Answering) model as well, which heavily relies on language models to process and interpret visuals. GRiT, a new language model which can transform the image into text, can use some simple sentences or words to describe each part of an image, and can also provide an appropriate description of the image as a whole. This paper illustrates how to utilize the GRiT framework to extract localized information from an image (using a dataset derived from VQA), and provides a method for utilizing the Generate Region to Text converter to enhance object understanding in the VQA 2.0 dataset.

articleTitle: Research on Online Detection Methods for Emulsion Using Ultrasound
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Ultrasonic testing technology has developed rapidly in the fields of industry, agriculture and medical testing. Ultrasonic has good directionality, strong penetration ability and easy access to higher energy. As a non-radiation, safe and reliable imaging technology, it also shines brightly in food testing, mainly because it can penetrate the tested food medium, and has high accuracy, high efficiency, no pollution, no damage, and low cost for object detection. This study uses ultrasound to conduct online detection of emulsion. Through the relationship between ultrasound spectrum and parameter changes, the concentration and quality changes of emulsion can be quickly obtained, improving detection time and efficiency. It provides a high-quality method for green measurement of emulsion food and can also be extended to the detection of all substancessimilar to emulsion.

articleTitle: Construction of Computer Aided Model for Temperature Effect of Concrete Bridge
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Based on Struts and Hibernate technology, a set of bridge concrete quality monitoring system is established. The system is based on J2EE. Java as the main development language. Struts and hibernate, which are popular in Web system development, are used to accelerate the speed of development. In this system, the temperature information of bridge concrete under various environments can be quickly queried, modified and selectively output. The ADINA program was used to numerically simulate the temperature field of the beam under two conditions of hydration heat and sunshine temperature difference, and the results were compared with the real bridge tracking test results. The effect of temperature stress on beam bridge is obtained. It is found that the results obtained by finite element method are in good agreement with the actual measured values.

articleTitle: A Method for Predicting Carbon Emissions in Regional Power Systems from a Systematic Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In response to the lack of basic data on carbon emissions in regional power systems, insufficient analytical capabilities for carbon emissions measurement, and a lack of basis for the decomposition of carbon emissions "dual control" goals, this article proposes a method for training and generating a systematic perspective of the electricity carbon measurement model using historical electricity data, energy consumption data, and product output data. This method clarifies the key parameters and inputs for training the electricity carbon measurement model by extracting features from electricity measurement data, constructing typical scenarios of carbon emissions in the power system, analyzing the driving factors of carbon emissions and their correlation with major economic activities, and mining the value of electricity and other data. It overcomes the problem of lacking basic carbon emission data and can achieve various industries in the power system The prediction of production process levels and energy activity levels in various regions, as well as the calculation of carbon emissions, support the power system to comprehensively grasp its own carbon emissions level. This method can be applied to the calculation of carbon emissions in power under the background of "dual carbon", and can also provide technical support for the power system's own carbon emissions level.

articleTitle: Design of Security Defense Mechanism for Worm Virus Attacks in Power Information Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Smart grid is inseparable from digitization, informatization, and intelligence, and it is even more inseparable from digitization, informatization, and intelligence security. Attacks on the network are becoming more complex, unpredictable, and difficult to effectively control. Worm attack is a relatively effective and well-known network attack method. How to detect and block worm attack in time is one of the important propositions of network security. At present, many researchers have devoted themselves to the solution of worm attacks, and it is necessary to briefly summarize the existing research on worm defense. First of all, this paper introduces the characteristics, action mechanism and life cycle of worm attacks, and focuses on artificial intelligence technology and existing worm detection methods. Secondly, this paper proposes a network security defense mechanism combining global and local. Finally, this paper summarizes the content of this paper and discusses some current problems in the field of network intrusion detection.

articleTitle: Load Forecast Based on RF-PSO-VMD-Transformer-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of model prediction of load, a prediction method based on random forest, particle swarm optimization, variational modal decomposition, Transformer-LSTM time series prediction model, and interval prediction is proposed. Firstly, the random forest algorithm is used for feature selection, and the variational modal decomposition algorithm based on particle swarm optimization is used to decompose the load time series into several components with different center frequencies. The time series is stabilized and linearized. Secondly, the Transformer-LSTM prediction model is established for prediction, and the prediction results of each component are superimposed. Finally, the interval prediction method is adopted to obtain the final load prediction data. Results show that, compared with several other typical time series forecasting models, the evaluation indicators of the proposed forecasting method are significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Media Application System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A digital media design system based on computer artificial intelligence technology is proposed. The design uses TMS320C6657 and DDR31333 as the hardware core of the system. At the same time, the high-speed external memory is used to expand the massive data transmission channel. The software uses a plug-in architecture to develop image plug-in and sound plug-in. The various functional modules are integrated together in the form of plug-ins to form a complete overall framework. In this paper, a virtual reality-based digital media production platform is developed by using the method of joint development of software and hardware. The analysis of the actual operation of the system proves that the system works stably and reliably, and the realization of each function module has reached the design index of the system.

articleTitle: Application of Computer 3D Image Vision Technology in Intelligent Retrieval System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article introduces the shortcomings of the current search engine. A personalized information retrieval system model based on 3D image vision technology is presented. This paper proposes a personalized information search architecture based on intelligent agent. The method uses the upper computer to calculate and operate, the bottom computer to interact with the user and display the query results. The general framework of the software and the concrete implementation scheme of each function module are given. In this method, a semantically based association model is constructed using the existing markup data, and it is integrated with the visual characteristics of the image. Thus, the correlation feedback is efficiently completed on two levels. The experimental results show that the method is fast, accurate and reliable.

articleTitle: A Market Transaction Model Based on Blockchain Technology for Multimicrogrid Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to solve the reliability and security problems of multi-micro-networks participating in market transaction data, a multi-micro-network market transaction model based on blockchain technology is proposed. The multi-microgrid system and the models of wind turbines, photovoltaic units and energy storage in the microgrid are analyzed. The blockchain and its main technologies are introduced, and the multi-microgrid public chain model is analyzed. The Nash bargaining method is analyzed, and the microgrid cost model and transaction model are established, with the goal of minimizing the cost of microgrid alliance and maximizing the profit distribution rate of multi-microgrid. The simulation analysis of the model established in this paper shows the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Research on Electronic Commerce Visualization Intelligent Information System Based on Computer 3D Image Vision Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This paper proposes an enterprise information system module architecture based on e-commerce platform. The front end uses High charts to visualize the data. The background uses DPI to extract e-commerce data from network traffic to establish a user shopping behavior database. At the same time, the use of web crawler to establish e-commerce product information database. The results can be dynamically updated and visualized, and the validity of the EDVM model is preliminarily verified by experiments. This article focuses on the performance of the intelligent control system for network information transmission rate on e-commerce platforms, This article builds a rigorous experimental process based on simulation experiments. Finally, through data analysis and comparison, it is verified that the e-commerce platform has advantages in network information transmission rate, and this intelligent control advantage can effectively optimize the design of client buffers. The system has excellent significance.

articleTitle: Health status assessment of scraper conveyor electrical system based on cooperative game theory and cloud model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The paper is based on cooperative game theory and cloud model theory to evaluate the health status of the electrical system of the scraper conveyor in the underground fully mechanized mining face. Firstly, establish a hierarchical analysis model for the electrical system of the scraper conveyor, and use a cooperative game method that combines Analytic Hierarchy Process, Entropy Weight Method, and Grey Correlation Degree Method to calculate the composite weights of each indicator. Then, the membership formula is combined with cloud model parameters to obtain the membership values of each indicator corresponding to each state level, and the maximum membership method is used to obtain the final evaluation result. The research results indicate that the proposed health status assessment method can intuitively obtain the health status information of various indicators in the electrical system of the scraper conveyor, and effectively complete its health status assessment.

articleTitle: Improved Grey Wolf Optimization Algorithm Based on Secant Inertia Weight Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Given the low solution accuracy, slow convergence speed, and easy entrapment in local optimal solution of Grey Wolf Optimization Algorithm (GWO) in solving function optimization problems, this paper introduces the secant function and proposes an improved Grey Wolf Optimization based on secant inertia weight strategy (SGWO). Compared with six other swarm intelligence optimization algorithms, the simulation experimental results on five standard test functions demonstrate that SGWO can effectively balance the global and local search ability, and significantly improve the convergence speed, accuracy, and stability.

articleTitle: Multi-time scale coordinated control strategy for frequency regulation of doubly-fed wind turbines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of system inertia reduction and frequency modulation capacity reduction caused by large-scale wind power replacing some traditional generators, a multi-time scale coordinated control strategy of doubly-fed wind turbines and traditional synchronous units jointly supporting the system frequency is proposed, so as to improve the system frequency stability and rationally utilize frequency modulation resources. According to the frequency modulation reserve capacity of traditional synchronous units and disturbance power, the system frequency modulation demand in different scenarios is analyzed, and the multi-time scale coordinated control strategy to actively support frequency of doubly-fed wind turbines is proposed. And based on the reserve capacity of traditional synchronous units, the frequency modulation dead zone value of doubly-fed wind turbines is designed, so that it can adaptively switch the inertia support and primary frequency regulation for different scenarios, and realize the full use of the frequency modulation reserve capacity of traditional synchronous units while giving full play to the rapid response ability of doubly-fed wind turbines. The frequency dynamic response characteristics of doubly-fed wind turbines with additional frequency active support control are analyzed, which further proves its superiority. Finally, the large-scale wind power grid-connected system simulation model is built based on RTLAB real-time digital simulation platform, which verifies the effectiveness of the control strategy in this paper.

articleTitle: Exploring Deep Learning-Based Visual Localization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This comprehensive review paper explores the state of the art in visual localization and navigation, drawing on the principles and methodologies of three significant deep learning networks: Visual Localization Network (VLocNet), Deep Fusion Network (DFNet), and Hybrid Frontend Network (HFNet). Each of these networks demonstrates the application of deep learning to spatial awareness and navigation tasks in unique and significant ways. Rather than an exhaustive dissection of these networks, the paper provides an encompassing overview, illuminating their underlying principles, architectural design, and their relative performance within the field. Additionally, the paper delves into the practical implications of these networks, examining their applications in diverse real-world scenarios. It underlines this examination with a comprehensive analysis of existing literature and experimental results, intended to impart a profound understanding of these networks' strengths, limitations, and potential application areas. Ultimately, this review aims to present a valuable compass to researchers navigating the evolving landscape of advancements in visual localization and navigation, thereby fostering enriched understanding and facilitating future exploration and development in this compelling field.

articleTitle: Exploration on Multi Network Monitoring Platform of Power System Based on Genetic Optimization Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the continuous development of power system, the scale and complexity of power grid are increasing. In order to ensure the stable operation of power system, the construction of multi Network monitoring platform becomes more and more important. Genetic optimization neural network is an effective method to establish power system multi Network monitoring platform. This paper successfully realized the construction of power system multi Network monitoring platform by integrating the knowledge of genetic algorithm, neural network and monitoring technology. Using the model analysis of power system monitoring, genetic optimization algorithms for different user numbers were compared through experiments. The experimental results indicated that the transmission time of the fault management module required 0.36 seconds and the processing time required 1 second. The error of genetic optimization learning algorithm was also relatively small, which can effectively improve the safety and reliability of power systems, and has high practical value and promotion prospects.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning-Driven Disease Classification Method Using MIMIC-III Database and Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The automated encoding of medical diagnoses from clinical records is an indispensable task in healthcare management. This study proposes a deep learning-driven method for International Classification of Diseases (ICD) coding, derived from clinical narratives using the MIMIC-III database. The proposed approach leverages a Label Attention Model for ICD coding from clinical text (LAAT), and explores the effectiveness of various loss functions, notably focal loss. ICD codes are classified according to their frequency, and model hyperparameters are optimized separately for each category. Empirical results demonstrate that the integration of focal loss significantly bolsters the performance of LAAT in ICD coding, achieving an Area Under the Curve (AUC) of 0.92131 and a micro-F1 score of 0.98658 for the entire MIMIC-III dataset. Additionally, the data suggests that fine-tuning hyperparameters for specific label groups, based on their frequency, fosters further performance enhancements. The developed approach can facilitate precise and efficient ICD coding from clinical notes, providing invaluable insights for healthcare practitioners and investigators.

articleTitle: Analysis and Improvement of the Current Situation of Power Cable Handover Test
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Power cable is an important power transmission carrier to support the safe and stable power supply of the power system. Ensuring its good performance is the fundamental purpose of cable testing, to facilitate the timely discovery of various problems in the cable and eliminate potential risks. However, at present, due to the complexity of the working environment and the existence of defects in the cable itself, resulting in repeated testing of the cable occurs from time to time. In this paper, we analyze the current situation of the existing power cable handover test and propose improvement measures to reduce the repetition rate of the cable test in order to improve the reliability and safety of the distribution cable handover test.

articleTitle: Measures to Improve the Pass Rate of Power Distribution Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The cable is a device that balances the forces of all aspects of the distribution line and resists wind pressure to prevent the toppling of the distribution line. The cables on the transmission and distribution lines are always protecting the safe and stable operation of the power grid. In the construction and maintenance work of the transmission and distribution lines, if the construction technology is not standard and the maintenance method is not correct, the line tilt and rod fall accidents will occur. Therefore, once the cables are damaged, the power grid accidents will be caused. It is very important to improve the pass rate of power distribution line. In this paper, through the investigation and analysis of the unqualified type of the cable once made, it is found that the key problem causing the low qualified rate of the cable once made of distribution lines is the large distance between the tongue plate and the strand. Based on the analysis of the main reasons, the measures of increasing the applying force and unifying and standardizing bending methods are put forward. The distance between the tongue plate and the steel strand is shortened effectively, and the pass rate of the power distribution line is increased, which provides the foundation for the safe and reliable operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Real-time Fuel Efficiency Prediction and Optimization Using Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet of Vehicles (IoV) and deep learning technologies, real-time optimization of fuel efficiency has become an important yet challenging problem. This paper proposes a joint optimization model based on Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Reinforcement Learning (RL) specifically designed to address this issue. Through theoretical analysis, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the model in achieving global optimality. In the experimental phase, we validate the model using the Auto-mpg dataset. The experimental results show that our model reduces the loss value by 25% and improves the AUC value by 15% compared to the baseline model. These numerical results demonstrate a significant advantage of our model in terms of prediction accuracy and optimization capability compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: A lightweight biomedical named entity recognition with pre-trained model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Biomedical Named Entity Recognition (BioNER) is a specialized subfield of Named Entity Recognition (NER) that focuses on identifying and classifying named entities in biomedical and clinical texts. The goal of BioNER is to extract essential information, such as genes, proteins, diseases, drugs, et al., from scientific literature, electronic health records (EHRs), biomedical databases, and other biomedical text sources. The recognition and classification of these entities are crucial for various biomedical and healthcare-related tasks, including information retrieval, data integration, knowledge extraction, and drug discovery. Traditional BioNER methods typically involve rule-based approaches or machine learning algorithms, et al. These methods have been widely used before the advent of deep learning and transformer-based models. Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) is a groundbreaking transformer-based language model. It has revolutionized various natural language processing (NLP) tasks by capturing contextual information and obtain optimal results in multiple benchmarks. A lightweight BioNER optimized model from traditional BERT (LWNER) is proposed in this study, which can capture contextual information and its knowledge transfer from pre-training on large-scale text corpora without relying heavily on feature engineering and handcrafted rules. Fine-tuning BERT on biomedical-specific data helps adapt the model to the nuances and terminology of the biomedical domain. We conduct the method LWNER on BioCreative dataset, BC2GM, BC4CHEMD, BC5CDR, especially the chemical entity in BC5CDR achieve F1- score 91.3%. We construct an online web tool based on LWNER to identify the arbitrary text from scientific literatures for building knowledge graph.

articleTitle: Prediction of hospital stay for patients undergoing partial hip replacement surgery based on machine learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Partial hip replacement surgery is a common surgical method for treating severe hip joint diseases. Accurate prediction of the length of hospital stay for patients undergoing partial hip replacement surgery is of great significance for optimizing rehabilitation planning, resource utilization, surgical safety, and improving healthcare quality. Due to the complexity of factors involved in partial hip replacement, traditional clinical experience-based predictions have subjective limitations. This study aims to construct a predictive model for the length of hospital stay for patients undergoing partial hip replacement surgery based on clinical data using different machine learning algorithms. The performance of different algorithms was evaluated, and the results showed that the backpropagation neural network (BPNN) demonstrated good performance in predicting the length of hospital stay after partial hip replacement, providing accurate prediction results and decision support for healthcare teams.

articleTitle: Kinematics of Parallel Legged Biped Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The traditional parallel structure platform was improved, and the general structure of the parallel legged biped robot was constructed by using SolidWorks. Taking it as the research object, the parallel structure and its degree of freedom analysis were described in detail. The space Cartesian coordinate system is established on the structure model of the robot, and then the inverse solution equation of the parallel mechanism is derived based on the position relationship of the parallel mechanism. On this basis, the solution process of the forward kinematic position solution based on the discrete Newton iteration method is given. Finally, the control system of the parallel legged biped robot is designed. Visual Studio software and QT software are used to write the program and design the control interface. Finally, conduct a sine wave test to verify the accuracy of the experimental testing.

articleTitle: Research and development of intelligent decision support system for distribution network planning based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: the complexity of distribution network planning is manifested in the characteristics of large scale, uncertainty, imprecision, many factors and wide fields involved. It is far from satisfying the requirements of modern distribution network planning by relying only on the planning experience of planners. Therefore, developing an intelligent decision-making system for distribution network planning can not only reduce the labor intensity of the planning staff, but also improve the scientific decision-making level of distribution network planning as a whole, which has important academic and practical significance. The introduction of Geographic Information System (GIS) platform into distribution network planning system can greatly facilitate the collection and management of planning data, improve the labor productivity of planners, and make the planning process more intuitive and interactive. This paper discusses the basic principle and overall structure of the intelligent decision support system for distribution network planning based on GIS, and focuses on the method of applying GIS to the optimal planning of distribution network.

articleTitle: Incorporating BERT with Naive Bayes into Neutral Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid increase in online text data, sentiment analysis has become increasingly important in various applications. However, current research on neutral sentiment analysis is relatively limited, and there is still no effective method for accurately identifying neutral emotions. While Bert has shown superior performance in classifying positive and negative emotions compared to traditional approaches like the Naive Bayes algorithm, its accuracy in identifying neutral sentiment remains a challenge. To address this, we propose a method that combines Bert with the Bayesian algorithm and employs a sentiment dictionary constructed from the text data in the database to calculate correction weights for the two sentiments. This approach aims to improve Bert's accuracy in identifying neutral sentiment texts and thus enhance the overall performance of sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: A Cost-Effective Single-Input and Adjustable Dual-Output Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: A single-input with independently regulated dual-output (SIIDO) wireless power transfer (WPT) system is proposed. The system achieves two different levels of constant voltage (CV) output, through a full-wave rectification circuit and a half-wave rectification circuit. A closed-loop control strategy is presented to control the two outputs. After adjusting the system parameters, the output voltage is set to 300V and 48V. Simulation has confirmed the correctness of the proposed method in this paper.

articleTitle: State-fitting based field test method for fast-acting distributed feeder automation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In response to the significant challenges encountered in conducting the field test of fast-acting logic for distributed feeder automation in power distribution networks, this article proposes a state-fitting-based testing methodology for feeder automation, and establishes a comprehensive testing platform composed of a state-fitting test scheme generation system, a testing monitoring system, and multiple testing instruments. The feasibility and practicality of this testing approach are validated through its application in field testing of a distribution network in Xiong'an New Area.

articleTitle: Research on face expression recognition with subdivision structure based on depth learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: As an important part of emotion analysis and computation, facial expression recognition has been widely studied and applied in many fields, such as education, medical treatment and so on. At present, the method of facial expression recognition based on depth learning has the advantages of automatic extraction of facial expression features, fast computation speed and high recognition accuracy, and has become the main research direction of facial expression recognition. However, current convolutional neural network can not accurately extract facial features in key areas. Another difficulty in the task of facial expression recognition is that facial expressions change slightly, and different expressions are similar and difficult to distinguish, and different individuals express expressions in different ways, this makes it difficult to improve the accuracy of facial expression recognition. Based on the theory of deep learning, the methods and applications of convolutional neural network in facial expression recognition are studied in this paper. The main research contents of this paper are as follows: aiming at the polymorphism of facial expression images in the real world, the different expression modes among individuals, the similarity of different expressions and the difficulty in distinguishing them, etc., a method of facial expression recognition based on subdivision structure is proposed. This method first makes a rough classification of the facial expression images on the REXNET-F network, and then uses the subdivision structure to compute the class center of each class during the training process of the convolutional neural network, using the information of the context, therefore, the facial expression images which were misclassified before were corrected and the effect of facial expression polymorphism on recognition task was weakened. On RAF-DB and FERPLUS data sets, the accuracy of facial expression recognition was 88.00% and 88.50%, respectively.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Price Prediction with LSTM and Transformer Models Leveraging Momentum and Volatility Technical Indicators
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Accurate cryptocurrency price prediction is essential to investors and researchers for analyzing trends and advising financial decisions, as price prediction is fundamental to making beneficial investment decisions. Due to the high volatility and unpredictability of the cryptocurrency market, it is difficult to predict these prices based on cryptocurrency time series data accurately. This research paper presents a two-fold analysis of the effectiveness of neural networks and deep learning to predict cryptocurrency prices and proposes a novel approach to cryptocurrency price prediction. This is done by considering Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) and Transformer neural networks that use historical price features in addition to volatility and momentum technical indicators, along with historical price features, and testing these models on Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH) and Litecoin (LTC). Momentum and volatility technical indicators such as Relative Strength Index (RSI), Bollinger Bands %B and Moving Average Convergence/Divergence (MACD) are not commonly used in cryptocurrency machine learning models. Still, the addition of these features can give better insight into the general trend of the price. By adding volatility and momentum features to our LSTM and Transformer models, we see a significant increase in price prediction accuracy, and we also find that Transformers tend to outperform LSTM models in price prediction and trends of cryptocurrency data.

articleTitle: Generation and detection technology of intelligent building engineering based on digital twin and deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: With the rapid development of building information modeling and deep learning technology, as well as people's increasing demand for virtual reality and intelligent construction projects, time-consuming and inefficient manual building modeling methods are far from meeting engineering needs. Plane detection is also gradually unable to meet the needs of building earthquake resistance. This paper proposes a generation and detection technique for intelligent construction projects based on digital twins and deep learning. First, using digital twin technology, the building plane is obtained through the Boolean intersection operation between geometric objects, and then the main body, external working conditions, environment and other entities are faithfully reproduced in the building information model; Contour; Finally, based on the Boltzmann machine of deep learning, the contour outside the building plane is input into the trained anomaly detection neural network algorithm model, and the recognition result is fed back. The experimental results show that the algorithm model has greatly improved the recognition rate of the abnormal detection of concave-convex irregular building plans, and is more in line with the actual needs of intelligent building construction.

articleTitle: Research on Dispersion Profiles of Liquid-core Polarization-maintaining Fiber
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: The researches on dispersion profiles are prominent for nonlinear optics, optical communication and spectroscopy. A highly birefringent, low-loss fiber is designed in this article by introducing a double elliptical air hole in the x-direction. Furthermore, the influence of birefringence and dispersion with the structure parameters and wavelength have been demonstrated. To realize the application in nonlinear optics, we have filled the fiber core with SC2 and the effective mode area and nonlinear coefficient have been calculated to verify the performance in nonlinear applications. We consider that the proposed bias-preserving fiber is highly forward-looking in the design of high birefringence fiber and dispersion-compensating fiber when applicated in nonlinear fiber optics and optical communications.

articleTitle: Infrared ship target detection method based on YOLOv5

articleTitle: An improved SIRS model based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional propagation model (SIRS model) cannot accurately simulate the actual information dissemination problem. In this paper, genetic algorithm is combined with the mathematical model of propagation. The parameters in the SIRS model are optimized by genetic algorithm to obtain the best fit to the data set, and the final results are compared and visualized. After several experiments, our GA-SIRS model achieves the highest coefficient of determination (R2) of 97.54% for the data and outperforms the BP neural network and support vector machine in predicting information dissemination problems. Therefore, the proposed method can be a feasible solution to the problem of information dissemination prediction.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Cloud-edge Resource Security Management Scheme Based on Zero Trust Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: This article first introduces the security requirements of the current State Grid for edge site resource management, and then introduces the current edge platform and zero trust architecture. Next, a cloud-edge resource security management scheme based on zero trust architecture is introduced, and relevant tests are conducted on the scheme. The experiment shows that the scheme has achieved the expected design effect and has good performance. Finally, combined with the current promotion of Digital transformation of the State Grid, the next research direction is pointed out.

articleTitle: A Novel Eye-tracking and Audio Hybrid System for Autism Spectrum Disorder Early Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 3rd International Conference on Data Science and Computer Application (ICDSCA)
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a lifelong neurodevelopmental condition marked by challenges in social communication and the presence of repetitive behaviors or limited interests. The early diagnosis of ASD is crucial for enhancing the quality of life for those affected and maximizing the effectiveness of early intervention strategies. This paper presents a novel approach that utilizes hybrid eye tracking and speech data within a supervised learning framework, aiming to enhance accuracy and accessibility for the early detection of ASD in children. A dataset containing both of these data modalities was collected from 30 ASD and 78 non-ASD children. Data processing methods, such as scanpath visualization for eye tracking data and Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs) extraction for speech data, were employed on our collected dataset. Classifiers such as XGBoost and neural networks were then applied to this altered dataset to develop predictive models for ASD classification, with a classification accuracy of up to 82% obtained. The results demonstrate that our multimodal approach significantly outperforms the models trained on individual data types alone, showcasing the potential of this approach for early, cost-effective, and scalable ASD screening.
